As the nibwhip dragon returned from a fruitless search to continue its task, the lokilure dragon puffed out its chest and raised its beak with pure pride.
dragons.Goal: Whether it's in jest or a joke, it's without malice or malevolence.

dragons.Name: Trepak
dragons.Description:
Winter Saga: Chapter 9

Trepak dragons are a dignified bunch and it's not just the uniformity of their coat. They enjoy organizing the efforts of their fellow dragons. So when one trepak dragon had seen Valers and dragons working together, it was beyond delighted. It sought out the cauldron of chocolate brew to taste it, but it had grown cold. It then tried to find the carolers that had adopted a libretto dragon in their vocal vocation. All it could find were frightened singers who had disbanded and sought shelter to avoid a threat from above. The trepak dragon then ventured toward the triumphant treat display that would soon garner much attention, but what it found was a few smashed desserts on the ground where an entire table had apparently been stolen. The trepak dragon snorted and marched straight to the dragons that apparently left evidence of their participation in these shady shenanigans.
dragons.Goal: Regimented diligence must have been your marching orders.

dragons.Name: Jadice
dragons.Description:
Winter Saga: Chapter 10

It was almost midnight and the Vale was quite quiet. A jadice dragon perched high on a mountaintop, looked at the moon, then down to the blank venue that should have been fully decorated by this time. It could see by the faintest of sight, a trepak dragon had gathered a somewhat peculiar group of dragons in the center of town. The jadice dragon swooped in, right in the middle of an apparent stare-down. The jadice dragon approached the trepak dragon and intercepted the glare. Avarice, gulletail, lokilure, and burglehoo dragons all stepped back with reverence when the jadice dragon separated the group. Just then, the jolliest of wizards interrupted. It was Sandakloz and he wanted to set things straight. Witches and wizards gathered to hear him speak.

He explained how no dragon is wholly bad and no dragon is purely good, much like the witches and wizards they lived with. Sandakloz gave each dragon a medal with the letter “N” emblazoned upon it and said, “Remember, each day we have the option to be naughty or nice. But no one except ourselves, can be the bearer of that change.”

From that moment on, dragons of all kinds and magicfolk from around the Vale worked together to revive the Vale. As dawn snuck up, a winter wonderland was revealed! That night forged a tradition that still thrives to this very day. The festival may have a different name from time to time, but the spirit remains the same.
dragons.Goal: You didn't let it go and broke through the frozen obstacle!

dragons.Name: Ghostly Plant
dragons.Description:
This ancestral dragon was summoned from realms beyond.

People will love to come see your plant dragons play in their beautiful green habitat. They are the friendliest of all the dragon breeds and make great pets!
Opposite: Metal

dragons.Name: Ghostly Poison
dragons.Description:
This ancestral dragon was summoned from realms beyond.

The poison dragon loves people. Not for breakfast, it just thinks they're great company. Unfortunately, people don't often react well to their deadly neurotoxin. Best to watch it play with its own kind from a safe distance.

dragons.Name: Ghostly Flower
dragons.Description:
This ancestral dragon was summoned from realms beyond.

The bright flower dragon is a favorite among dragon hobbyists. Though they sometimes get carried away, they aren't really dangerous. Just remember that they only bite because they think it's playing. It's important to train them not to bite before they get too big.

dragons.Name: Ghostly Tree
dragons.Description:
This ancestral dragon was summoned from realms beyond.

Few people are comfortable watching a tree flying in the sky, which is perhaps why this hybrid is misunderstood as ancient and unknowable. The older ones have been known to offer a helping hand to those lost in a forest, or a friendly conversation to those wandering alone.

dragons.Name: Ghostly Moss
dragons.Description:
This ancestral dragon was summoned from realms beyond.

The unusual two legged moss dragon is truly one of nature's marvels. Capable of living in the harsh extremes of the desert, it is also found wandering through forested regions. This beast wanders the world blind and happy as an adult.

dragons.Name: Ghostly Evergreen
dragons.Description:
This ancestral dragon was summoned from realms beyond.

First found in the forests of Farn, the evergreen dragon is one of the few dragons known to roam in large groups. Coming across them in the wild may be a sight to behold, but beware; evergreen dragons are particularly prickly and properly protective of their progeny.

dragons.Name: Ghostly Lichen
dragons.Description:
This ancestral dragon was summoned from realms beyond.

Lichen dragons can be found on the highest mountain peaks and furthest polar reaches throughout the world. Our wizards say that the unique substance growing on them is some sort of strange plant that feeds the dragons using sunlight. Or something. I didn't really understand it myself. Oh and be sure not to confuse lichen dragons with any other kind of supernatural beings, they've been known to take offense to that.

dragons.Name: Ghostly Coal
dragons.Description:
This ancestral dragon was summoned from realms beyond.

It is said that before the discovery of magic, humans relied on far more crude ways of meeting their needs. They burned a black stone called coal, named for the coal dragons whose skin it so resembles. This time of year, the wizards exchange coal dragon eggs with each other to remember hardships endured by those who lacked the companionship of dragons.

dragons.Name: Ghostly Gift
dragons.Description:
This ancestral dragon was summoned from realms beyond.

These crafty creatures snuck into the bag of holding of the magical toymaker Sandakloz. After being studied over the holidays, the wizards have found a way to counteract the singularity magic that prevented more than one existing in the same place at the same time. Clever wizards.

dragons.Name: Ghostly Trinket
dragons.Description:
This ancestral dragon was summoned from realms beyond.

A longheld wintertime tradition around the Vale is for witches and wizards to gift each other trinket dragon eggs. Supposedly, the trinket dragon is rumored to have a magical aura that brings good luck when it comes to receiving gifts. The jury is out on whether this dragon really brings good luck, but it certainly brings joy and adorable companionship!

dragons.Name: Ghostly Krampus
dragons.Description:
This ancestral dragon was summoned from realms beyond.

If little wizards and witchlings start to get too excited for the winter festivities, parents often use the krampus dragon to keep them in line. “You better behave, or the krampus dragon will gobble up all your iceberries!” is heard fairly often this time of year. Unfortunately, this gives the sweet krampus dragon an undeserved reputation. It would never eat your iceberries! That long sticky tongue is actually used to sip up sweet nectar from blossoms in the far north.

dragons.Name: Ghostly Kringle
dragons.Description:
This ancestral dragon was summoned from realms beyond.

The story of one of the first encounters between dragons and wizards is believed to have involved the kringle dragon:

A long time ago, in ancient times past
Arose a fierce storm with winds that did lash.

From inside the storm there came a deep moan
That frightened all folk, from small to full grown.

The moan did continue all through the night
Even when the storm passed come early morn's light.

A brave soul did leave the warmth of his home
To see what could make that sad, lonesome groan.

It didn't take long, there up in a tree
A dragon was stuck, struggling to be free.

Fetching a tool from his wagon,
The wizard quickly released the dragon.

And the dragon was freed, so it is said,
That dragon became the wizard's best friend.

And thus is the tale, or so I've been told,
Of how kringle dragons came in from the cold.

dragons.Name: Quintessence
dragons.Description:
Dragons in the Vale,
necessary for true balance.
Their inherent magic,
dormant at a quick glance.

But this is merely a misunderstanding;
powers are used in moments of need notwithstanding.
Valefolk can be overt and garish,
when sorcery is used to solve problems.
But the first known quintessence dragon
quelled a 500-year storm in perfect form and fantastic fashion:

The storm brought wicked winds, torrential rain, hellacious hail, and violent lightning. It caused chaos and panic amongst the witches and wizards. The Vale was fraught with disaster… until a quintessence dragon descended from the sky, with wings fully spread in total glory.

It saw fires sparked by lightning strikes and unleashed water breath magic to extinguish the rampant flames. It saw magicfolk slipping into floods and roared with earth magic to raise the ground underneath the afflicted. Using the power of plant magic, the quintessence dragon conjured a path of leaves for Valers to follow to safety. Once they were all gathered in a single safe zone, the dragon shouted louder than any living creature ever had. Metal sheets emerged from the ground and surrounded the Valefolk to protect them from fierce winds. Then, with a final touch, the quintessence dragon spat a tiny fireball down to ignite a campfire. The witches and wizards kept warm and protected while the storm passed.

This is why quintessence dragons are so revered and pampered; not just as repayment for the Vale's survival, but to keep them close for the next tempest… should one arrive.
dragons.Goal: You've found the 500th dragon! It might need extra wing space in its habitat...

dragons.Name: Festive
dragons.Description: Valefolk youth can't quite wrap their heads around the festive dragon. "How does its tail work?!" they exclaim when they see the bouncy, bell-tailed baby. "Magic," Nogard always replies with a wink, despite others' insistence that such an answer is no answer at all. Sure, he's right, but what KIND of magic? And how does that magic work? It seems like only young ones are concerned; the rest of the Valers are completely delighted by this aptly named dragon. Ribboned and baubled and bearded, to boot—it doesn't get much more festive than that! ...or does it? Just wait until you see this dragon's happy dance!
dragons.Goal: Tis the season for this dragon to join your park!

dragons.Name: Tusk
dragons.Description: If the tusk dragon could speak, one might imagine it to have the voice of a droopy-faced dog with long, floppy ears. Despite looking morose, however, this dragon seems to be perfectly content to waddle through its habitat, patiently awaiting feeding time. If it ever uses its tusks for anything, it's a mystery to most magicfolk; the tusk dragon is one gentle giant.
dragons.Goal: You got straight to the point finding this toothy pal.

dragons.Name: Knarr
dragons.Description: The rare knarr dragon is so named for its resemblance to the ancient ships that once navigated the currents of The Surface's oceans. While those ancient ships were lost in The Cataclysm, the knarr dragon remains, a symbol of perseverence and strength. One of the most beautiful sights on The Surface is a fleet of knarr dragons floating off into the sunset!
dragons.Goal: This drifting friend is both seaworthy AND sky-worthy!

dragons.Name: Shiver
dragons.Description: Dancing atop frozen lakes is a sight Valefolk cherish: as far as the eye can see, herds of shiver dragons skate in snowy spirals along the ice. How are they able to achieve this magical movement? The key, according to experts, is in their talons. "The talons seem to produce a special oil that helps them slide on slippery surfaces," researchers wrote in numerous tomes. A recently found editorial scroll belabored the point, "Isn't it amazing? Quite cool, I would say."
dragons.Goal: Think nothing of this dragon's name; it's summer every day underneath that thick coat.

dragons.Name: Daffadowndilly
dragons.Description:
Gardenia's Color Guard: Earth

After the color had been sucked out of the Vale, Kaleni wandered around in disbelief. He had never seen such a drastic hex take hold. Gardenia was one of the most powerful witches and if this magical force expelled her, how would they ever fix it?

While Kaleni was lost in thought, he saw a flower that was green, yellow, and purple. He walked closer with mouth agape. As he reached down to touch the plant, a part of it popped up from the ground. It wasn't a flower at all, but a dragon's head!

At that moment, Kaleni knew there was hope. If a dragon could hold on to its color, maybe it could help fix the whole Vale. The dragon sniffed and looked around, confused and out of place. Kaleni didn't recognize it. It looked like a daffodil but didn't respond to the name. Kaleni tried several variations until arriving at daffadowndilly. The dragon excitedly ran around him in circles.

After having figured out its proper name, Kaleni showed the dragon a scroll with Gardenia's picture. The daffadowndilly dragon jumped up and down and ran back to where its head was stuck. It tried digging into the ground, but all it found was dirt.

Kaleni contacted other House Witches and Wizards and spread the word that these undiscovered flower dragons may hold the key to Gardenia's disappearance.
dragons.Goal: There's no doubt this dragon is your new pal.

dragons.Name: Petunia
dragons.Description:
Gardenia's Color Guard: Fire

Nogard was tromping through the woods looking all around for any smidgen of color. He was looking up to the grey sky when he heard a gravelly roar that nearly caused him to topple over in fright. He turned to see a pair of gleaming eyes in a bushel of petunias.

He steadily backed away, but the dragon leaped out to greet him. This time Nogard did fall. The petunia dragon snarled, stared, and then sniffed the wizard. The dragon backed up and let the wizard stand. Nogard unfurled a scroll with Gardenia's likeness inked on it and showed it to the creature. The petunia dragon looked and raised an eyebrow at Nogard.

The dragon looked around and pointed toward a cave with its snout. Nogard bowed as a sign of deferment and the petunia dragon led the way. At the mouth of the cave, the dragon waited for the wizard to catch up. It simply stared as Nogard looked into the dark void. The dragon tapped a talon and waited for the wizard to do something. Nogard realized the creature was waiting and drew his wand. “Oh, right. Sight might be useful.” Nogard cast a spell and turned his wand into a torch. They ventured into the cave together.

The petunia dragon grunted and ran ahead of Nogard, but was consumed by darkness. It angrily roared which shook the cave, along with Nogard's sense of safety. The wise wizard took it as a sign and quickly conjured sheets of fire to cover the entire labyrinth of cavern walls. The petunia dragon was visible again and smirked.

Hours later, they emerged with heads hung low. Nogard flipped over the parchment with Gardenia on it and summoned a map to show all other cave locations. He marked an X on one and pointed to another. He and the petunia dragon looked at each other and nodded.
dragons.Goal: With a ton of moxy and no regret, this dragon is bold, so don't you forget.

dragons.Name: Fever
dragons.Description: No one knows what climate fever dragons prefer. They appear to shiver in hot, balmy conditions and seem to sweat in chilly environments. It's taken Valers a long time to understand that these dragons aren't suffering in the slightest. They merely have an idiosyncratic tic that is triggered by temperature. It's possible that's why these dragons were named after a sporadic ailment of magicfolk.
dragons.Goal: No cure needed for this dragon... just room in a habitat.

dragons.Name: Brilliant
dragons.Description: Magicfolk are usually responsible for beautifying the Vale, but brilliant dragons like to share the care. At first, Valers thought their neighbors were responsible for ornate shrubbery sculptures that seemed to appear overnight. This perception was dashed when one teenage witch stayed up late to keep watch over her lawn. Sure enough, a jittery brilliant dragon snuck over and scanned its surroundings for witnesses. When it was clear, the dragon used its unique spikes to shave and shape a large bush. In no time at all, the plant was transformed into a statue of a longhaired wizard. The young witch was shocked and muttered “Genius…” under her breath. It's pretty clear how these dragons got their name.
dragons.Goal: You must be pretty clever to find one of these dragons...

dragons.Name: Begonia
dragons.Description:
Gardenia's Color Guard: Cold

Lumi sped over hilltops and around trees on a dangerously fast ice sled. This normally brought joy to the pint-sized witch, but she was dedicated to the search of her dear friend. She heard a fiery blast in the distance and turned to locate the source of the sound. CRASH! Her ice sled collided with a frozen patch of begonias and sent her flying headfirst into a snow bank.

When she pulled herself out, a baby begonia dragon charged toward her with the widest grin. The baby dragon tackled her and pushed her completely through the snow bank. It licked her face incessantly until Lumi was a cacophony of laughter and tickled gibberish.

They were so enamored with their instant bond, they chased each other, played hide and seek, and cuddled in the cold. The begonia dragon smelled food in Lumi's pocket and jabbed its nose in, unabashedly searching for the snack. Lumi writhed with giggles until her wand fell to the ground. It landed on ice, glowed, and projected a hologram of Gardenia decorating for the Gathering of Roses.

Lumi and the baby begonia dragon stopped playing and watched. The baby dragon saw Lumi's smile fade to a frown. While Lumi got lost in her grief once more, the baby dragon continued to rummage through Lumi's pockets. Lumi was not amused, but soon saw the dragon pull out a star pod treat. It gobbled it down and instantly grew into a juvenile.

The begonia dragon lowered its wing, which was now three times as big, and beckoned Lumi to climb on. She did and they continued their search from the sky with proud proficiency.
dragons.Goal: Have you ever heard of a therapy dragon? This one will quell your concerns with a cozy cuddle.

dragons.Name: Smoulderbrush
dragons.Description: Some witches have seen smoulderbrush dragons pushing herbs and flowers around with their snouts. Most of the time, these creatures are left alone to pursue their somewhat blind and peculiar wandering. One witch needed specific foliage for a complicated potion, yet all she could find were bare plants. After venturing into a deep valley, she saw several smoulderbrush dragons sleeping quite soundly. In the middle of the gathering was a dwindling, crude campfire. She tiptoed to grab a few untouched plants, but stumbled and bumped her knee on a log. She let out a yell then stifled herself, but no dragons stirred. She shrugged and gathered her desired ingredients without disturbing a single sleepy soul.
dragons.Goal: Breathe easy now that this friend has been found.

dragons.Name: Derecho
dragons.Description: On a crisp and clear day, the ambitious wizard Volell was dreaming up new ideas for island architecture. He looked to the clouds for inspiration and saw one moving at an incredible speed. It was a peculiar sight as he had spent most of his work expanding the Vale further into the skies and had never seen such a thing. He was just about to cast a remedy spell on himself to alleviate what must had been a hallucination hex, but he dropped his wand when the cloud came roaring toward him. It came to a sudden stop right in front of him, and that's when it became clear: this was a derecho dragon getting its kicks from surfing the high winds. The dragon winked and rocketed off. It continued its thrill-seeking routine as Volell stood there dazed and confused.
dragons.Goal: No, it's not time to fly a kite. This dragon might make YOU fly instead!

dragons.Name: Cyclamen
dragons.Description:
Gardenia's Color Guard: Lightning

A giant phantom eyeball scanned the Vale in every direction above the treetops and buildings. It rotated all around, constantly surveying until it locked on a location. It then descended slowly toward the ground and melted into the raised wrinkly hand of the wizard Whitbee.

Whitbee opened his eyes and decidedly marched toward the spot his spell had marked. He hobbled through brambles and branches and arrived at a still pond. The grey water was an unlikely place to find Gardenia and when that observation sunk in, Whitbee sighed heavily. He heard gurgling and pounded his chest as if it were indigestion, but he soon looked up to see bubbles surfacing in the middle of the pond.

He pointed his gnarled staff at the water and summoned several lightning strikes around the perimeter. The water was instantly evaporated. Down at the bottom was a single gathering of cyclamen flowers. Whitbee dropped his staff to his side and muttered, “What did I expect?”

As he walked away, a raucous flapping deafened him and a wild blue blur landed in his path. Whitbee froze. As he gathered his wits, he determined it could only be a sullen cyclamen dragon. It stared at the wizard, but didn't blink.

Whitbee transmuted the head of his staff to represent Gardenia, pointed to it, and gestured all around them with a shrug. The cyclamen dragon's eyes watered and it walked away. Whitbee didn't understand and was left alone. He stumbled to keep up with the dragon and found it had stopped at a lake. The cyclamen dragon nodded toward the water. “I guess it's worth a shot,” Whitbee mumbled. He blasted the lake with lightning, but there was nothing at the bottom.

The dragon led Whitbee to a river, then a stream, and even a puddle. But there was no point. Nothing was under these bodies of water. Whitbee sat on a log, exhausted. The cyclamen dragon lied down next to him and rested its head on his lap.
dragons.Goal: We all get the blues once in a while... this one can't help it though.

dragons.Name: Silverline
dragons.Description: Silverline dragons have a remarkable knack for looking on the bright side. This perspective is obvious when they seek out their favorite snack, a dark purple berry with juice sweeter than anything in the Vale. It doesn't even have a name because magicfolk dare not venture into the thorny thicket that guards the fruit. When silverline dragons emerge from a foraging feast, they're covered in spines. A good shake usually jostles most free, but the ones stuck in the tail are stubborn. These dragons don't mind and use it as a comb for grooming their scaled coats back into a pristine condition.
dragons.Goal: Optimism often overcomes obstacles.

dragons.Name: Amaryllis
dragons.Description:
Gardenia's Color Guard: Plant

Noel DePlante knew Kaleni was scouring the soil, Nogard was embroiled in spelunking, Lumi was scanning from the sky, and Whitbee was searching for sunken secrets. So Noel decided to go back to where it all started, Gardenia's fractured island.

He spotted a vibrant mass sticking out from the broken ground. He cast a spell to dissect the rock and what emerged made his jaw drop. A pristine and fully-grown amaryllis dragon levitated in between the two island halves.

Soon, a flood of roses poured out from the hole where the dragon was stuck. They were red, bright red! Against the vast starkness, this was monumental. The amaryllis dragon, with eyes closed, flew in circles and created a vortex that lifted the roses up. Noel acted quickly and cast an entanglement spell that bridged the two halves of the island with vines. It caught the falling roses and carried them safely to solid ground.

The amaryllis dragon flew next to the wizard and laid out its wing to direct Noel's attention to the pile of red roses. On the ground, browns and greens were growing brighter! Noel picked up a few blossoms and threw them around. Everywhere a rose fell, color spread.

The amaryllis dragon, still sightless with eyes shut, gestured to the entire colorless Vale. Noel smiled and conjured a sack made of leaves. He tied it to the dragon's back and filled it with roses. He tore the bottom open and waved to the dragon.

The dragon took off flying around all the islands of the Vale. Roses fell one by one. When they touched the ground, color was restored. Noel watched with glee as his home returned to its natural state: bright and full of energy.

Noel laughed with glee then squinted to see something in the distance. It looked like a green hat with a purple sash atop blonde hair…
dragons.Goal: Rise above and enjoy the moment! This companion will always look out for you.

dragons.Name: Busby
dragons.Description:
Busby dragons are known for their constructive directive, but a particular colony was suffering from destructive motive. They were building a new home to house their whole community, but every adult wanted to create their own section single-wingedly. This spread chaos and confusion until the entire project was in disarray.

One baby busby dragon witnessed the breakdown and waddled into the middle of the mess. It started humming a tune and dancing. Every adult dragon stopped and stared at the energetic hatchling. One, two, then a few, started dancing; before long they were all in sync. The baby busby dragon orchestrated them to work together in perfect harmony, all the while dancing. In no time at all, their new home was finished and fantastic.
dragons.Goal: Feel the sting no more. This humble bumble is making a home in your park.

dragons.Name: Dittoglide
dragons.Description:
Zoom! An adult dittoglide dragon zipped across the surface of a river with its clear reflection creating an illusion of a tandem stunt show. It did loops, barrel rolls, and even flat spins. A group of baby dittoglide dragons caught sight of the fascinating flight and meandered closer and closer to the river. The adult was oblivious to the enraptured audience and continued its routine.

The babies hopped on a log that stretched out into the river for the best seats possible. As they sat hypnotized, the log dislodged and floated away from the river bank. The babies all squealed with fright. The adult dittoglide dragon lost focus and fell from the sky. It looked around and saw the log floating quickly downstream. It lowered its head and rocketed toward the helpless hatchlings. The adult looked ahead and saw sharp rocks that were bound to tip the log over. The dragon sped ahead, looking for a solution. It saw piles of dead leaves on the river banks and flew in circles faster and faster until a cyclone formed. The adult dittoglide dragon drew the wind and leaves over the river and stopped. The cyclone ceased and the leaves dropped into the water, forming a padded dam in front of the hazard.

The log gently hit the makeshift blockade and the babies stayed safely aboard. They all sighed and one by one, waddled off the log to solid ground.
dragons.Goal: The self-awareness of this dragon feels like deja-vu...

dragons.Name: Faux
dragons.Description:
A slumbering faux dragon lay still on a tree branch, snoring louder than a roar. CLANG! BANG! CLANG! BANG! The faux dragon was so startled by the sudden clatter that it fell from the tree and landed in a heap. It jumped to its feet and scowled in every direction. BANG! CLANG! The dragon marched off toward the boisterous disturbance. Little did the dour dragon know, the source of the sound was actually a wizard building a new path into the untamed wilderness.

The faux dragon fanned its wings out to mimic a monstrous face and jumped through bushes to greet its newly found enemy. The construction connoisseur jumped back in fright and accidentally summoned a brown color cube behind him. THUNK!

The intimidating dragon saw the effect it had and quickly dropped its wings down and bowed. The wizard stood up straight, dispelled the brown cube behind him, and returned the bow. The faux dragon left the wizard to continue his work, but the sweaty Valer summoned a sign on the unfinished path that stated, “Under Construction”, and shakily walked back home with wobbly knees.
dragons.Goal: This pal only portrays its prank when pandemonium proves to be pesky. Otherwise, it's really quite friendly.

dragons.Name: Gildamane
dragons.Description:
A cluster of gildamane dragons was growing too large for its cozy valley and needed more wing-room. The oldest and wisest gildamane dragon saw the plight of its community and ventured out to look for more fruitful land. It soared and surveyed for several days until it finally discovered a luscious green oasis.

After the senior's return, it gestured for every gildamane dragon to follow it. When the adults started flying out in droves, the hatchlings crawled at an unbelievably slow pace. The old leader saw the aimless babies and corralled them into a single file. He marched and they followed.

Some magicfolk say they saw this journey take place, but no one would believe that the wizened old gildamane dragon played leapfrog with a parade of babies.
dragons.Goal: All that glitters is not gold, but maybe a group of gildamane dragons.

dragons.Name: Rhinotorch
dragons.Description:
A trio of rhinotorch dragons were flying over the Vale when they saw a dust storm sweeping over dry treat farms. They landed near a wizard who stared at the barren fields with a frown. The wizard drew his wand and attempted a rain spell, but the water drops just sizzled and turned to steam as soon as they hit the ground. The three rhinotorch dragons looked at each other. One spotted a gigantic snowbank high atop a nearby mountain and made the other two aware of it.

The three dragons charged up the mountain, ran head first into the wall of snow, and disappeared. Moments later, the snow grew bright red and melted with haste. A raging river formed and flowed down the mountain, straight toward the drought plagued fields. The fresh cold water soaked the dirt and saturated the ground. Instantly, burgeoning buds popped up everywhere. The proud, yet soaked, rhinotorch dragons looked down at their success and simultaneously cooled their searing scales.

They heard a faint voice from below yell, “Thank you!”
dragons.Goal: The burning desire to befriend this dragon should be subsiding by now... unless you want more of them to guard your Gem stash.

dragons.Name: Violetta
dragons.Description:
A wonderful wand-making witch was transporting her wares when her weighted wagon toppled over. Hundreds of freshly crafted spell-makers spilled everywhere. Unfortunately, one wand splintered and cast a cracking spell. It split another wand and that one cracked another, and so on and so forth until random spells were firing off in every direction.

A calm violetta dragon saw the fireworks in the distance and flew straight for the calamity. It saw the witch taking cover behind her wagon and quickly started picking up malfunctioning wands with its mouth. It dropped them in a nearby pond and dodged more aimless magic to continue the clean-up. Busby, rhinotorch, dittoglide, gildamane, and even faux dragons started helping after catching sight of the uproarious scene and the righteous violetta dragon.

In no time at all, every busted wand was floating in the pond. The witch peeked out over the wagon and cast a freezing spell. The water froze into a single block of ice, encasing the lot of damaged wands. The witch thanked the dragon helpers and they happily roared back in acknowledgement.
dragons.Goal: Vibrant and voluminous, this friend is loyal, royal, and virtuous!

dragons.Name: Serket
dragons.Description:
A baby serket dragon with a rumbling stomach found a robust tree bursting with bright red berries. It was too short to pluck the succulent treat from the branches, even whilst standing up on its hind legs. Since it had not grown wings yet, the hungry hatchling resorted to utilizing its top-heavy tail; the creative creature thumped the stump and looked up. The branches swayed but no fruit fell. THWACK! It took a second try and this time a few rained down. One berry split open and red juice leaked out. It sizzled and disintegrated blades of grass underneath it.

The starving serket dragon licked the volatile berry juice. It grinned with delight and devoured the other felled berries. With a palpable taste for the unreachable treat, the serket baby unleashed a flurry of tail-strikes. In no time at all, a deluge of fruit came pouring down. The baby tried to gobble it all as fast as it could, but there was too much.

The cascade of poisonous berries rolled down a long hill while the serket dragon ran to keep up with it, snatching up snacks as it ran. In the midst of its unbridled joy, the dragon saw a group of Vale youth playing at the bottom of the hill. The dragon trampled a few berries while it was distracted and saw the corrosive effect once more.

It curled its tail, formed a circle, and rolled faster than it could run. When it came to the bottom, it spun around and opened its mouth as wide as possible. Every berry tumbled down and into its mouth until all were captured. The wizardlings cheered and laughed at the sight of a serket dragon. The baby chewed and swallowed the sudden feast. It turned and smiled at the children but was surprised by a spicy and fiery belch.
dragons.Goal: Stingers and claws may make you run, but these sneaky friends just want to have fun!

dragons.Name: Morpho
dragons.Description:
Morpho dragons love to keep their extremities cool in thick, sticky mud, preferably on a mountainside where the breeze stays constant. Sometimes hundreds of them will cling to the same patch, though it's difficult to spot such an occurrence as they blend so completely with the canvas of dirt. This was exactly the scene not too far from Kaleni's Burcadian Breeding Cave, when the growing heat hex began to liquefy their beloved mud pad.

The gigantic group lost their footing and began to cascade down the mountain. They all flapped their wings to pull away from the mudslide and suddenly the mountain shimmered with brilliant blue flashes all over. The aimless morpho dragons caught sight of Kaleni casting wind spell after wind spell at the baking breeding cave. They flew to his aid and surrounded the afflicted area. Kaleni didn't know what to expect. He had never seen so many morpho dragons in his life. They formed a giant cylinder, held their wings outstretched, then simultaneously flapped. They sent a cyclone of air spinning around the Burcadian Breeding Cave and it pushed Kaleni somersaulting into the back of the cave.

Kaleni vanished with his own spell and appeared on a nearby island, next to a wishing well, panting and sweaty. Ellie skipped by with an egg in her arms and saw the determined dragon display. “Are they okay?”, she asked innocently.

Kaleni said, trying to catch his breath, “Yeah, they're just blowing off some steam.”
dragons.Goal: Magnificent! Have you ever seen a more demure dragon just waiting for its moment to flourish?

dragons.Name: Trilobite
dragons.Description:
While hundreds of morpho dragons were trying to cool down the Burcadian Breeding Cave, the ground of the island's spire began to crack with the drastic shifts in temperature. From these cracks, certain sections mysteriously writhed.

Several massive trilobite dragons broke loose from the ground and stretched their ancient wings, crackling and groaning in unison. They flew up high and observed the entire Vale as if for the very first time. Every newly discovered chrysalis dragon observed the awakening of the trilobite dragons and instinctually travelled to their location. With the innate understanding that danger was lurking, the trilobite dragons chased the remaining Valers to an overgrown magic portal. After the magicfolk were safe on other islands, the trilobite dragons formed a shield with their bodies while floating in midair and blocked the Vale from potential rogue effects.

The other eight dragon types unleashed their varied breath magic at the Burcadian Breeding Cave… but nothing happened. The trilobite dragons stayed vigilant with their guard even though progress was not made. The dragons kept firing their breath at the cave until all became winded. At that moment, something sparkled high above them…
dragons.Goal: You don't have to be old to be wise, but trilobite dragons are both... even the babies.

dragons.Name: Rigel
dragons.Description:
Of all the wizards in the Vale, Tolzar was probably the luckiest in recent times. While hanging out in his Optical Oracle, he saw a dragon egg punch through the Rift Gate and fly through the air.

Tolzar thought his goggles trapped a bug so he cleaned them hastily then put them back on, but it was indeed an egg. He stumbled up and kicked his flying vehicle into gear. He flew it around the Cooperative Breeding Cave and saw the egg was hurtling toward a Galaxy Island. He parked in the egg's path and stood at the edge with arms wide open. Unfortunately, the egg cracked and started hatching mid-flight.

Tolzar's eyes widened and he quickly rummaged through a chest of inventions. He heard a loud CRACK and popped up holding a giant net. He saw a baby rigel dragon emerge from the broken shell. Tolzar cackled with glee, but the baby dragon saw the net and zipped over to the Galaxy Island. It eagerly scooped up a mouthful of Dragon Treats as it continued to tumble through the air.

It instantly grew into a juvenile but still couldn't control its newly discovered wings. Tolzar was determined to save this lost, haphazard soul so he raced his vehicle in the dragon's path yet again. Right before the rigel juvenile hit Tolzar's net, the dragon created a portal and disappeared into it. ZAP! There was no sign of it.

Tolzar shrugged and flew away. He was disappointed he couldn't save the dragon from such a random fate. ZAP! A portal opened back up and the shockwave sent Tolzar's Optical Oracle spiraling out of control. Tolzar yelped with panic until a fully grown adult rigel dragon flew in front of him and gently stopped his careening contraption.

The now confident rigel dragon winked at the strange wizard who had offered futile help earlier in its life.
dragons.Goal: If this dragon wanted to have its cake and eat it too, it probably could with the power of portals.

dragons.Name: Pearlescent
dragons.Description:
No one had ever seen a pearlescent dragon, up until the day chrysalis dragons were sidled with the challenge of saving spring.

While nine newly discovered chrysalis dragons were battling the heat hex of the Burcadian Breeding Cave, a glittery and colorful bubble descended from the clouds. Across the Vale, every dragon, witch, and wizard stopped to watch this technicolor anomaly.

As the apparent bubble pierced through a low hanging cloud, it split into the magnificent wings of a pearlescent dragon. Some say, they heard a collective gasp escape from every living creature. The pearlescent dragon stretched out like a rainbow sail and craned its head downward. It unleashed a single blast of glitter and colors that inundated the cave with unmatched force. A glowing orange sphere was illuminated around the cave.

On an adjacent island, Kaleni could see the orange sphere materialize while peeking between blocking trilobite dragons. His jaw dropped. “I don't believe it”, he blurted out.

“Believe what?”, the young witch, Ellie, replied.

Kaleni simply said, “It WAS my fault.”

The pearlescent dragon fired off another sparkling blast. It made contact with the glowing orange sphere and amplified it to a searing red. It pulsed hotter and brighter until it shattered into a thousand pieces.

The trilobite dragons dropped their guard, the pearlescent dragon landed, and all the chrysalis dragons stood on the ground together. They looked at each other with grins and sighed. They instantly tensed up again when they heard a rustling from inside the cave. The pearlescent dragon opened its mouth again ready to unleash beauteous fury. Before more magic breath was loosed, Kaleni came running out. The dragons relaxed.

“My friends, I'm so sorry this happened. Next spring will be different. I promise. If you ever get hungry, just stop by my treat farm. No questions asked.”
dragons.Goal: What a sight to see! This dragon is fabulous, fantastic, and fierce! It's glittery too!

dragons.Name: Ignite
dragons.Description: An ignite dragon is a curious friend that appears to pursue a calling not many would assume. These dragons can be observed observing muse dragons while they are in observance of magicfolk inspiration. With quite a different skillset comprised of fire and lightning magic, these fledgling motivators try their best at helping Valers reach their full potential. Unfortunately, ignite dragons' tactics normally result in a sudden burst of heat and light that startle witches and wizards into action. Maybe someday ignite dragons will learn the power of subtlety, but for now they can't hold a candle to their idols.
dragons.Goal: Looking before you leap is usually ideal, but if you take too long, this dragon will nudge you in the right direction... hopefully.

dragons.Name: Drifter
dragons.Description:
There was once a great songsmith name Aubrey The Bard and one of his favorite pastimes was to write songs from the perspective of dragons. The following text was found on tattered parchment and is believed to be an excerpt from a ballad titled, “The Drifter Dragon”:

… They say I'm a loner, a floater,
I'm a vortex of misnomers.
But what they don't know is, I'm none of those.
I'm a drifter, baby!
Go my own way, make my own waves,
Just don't call me a knave or brave.
I come and go as I please.
I drift and drift and drift away…

Let it be known, this was most likely performed with an iron-made guitar.
dragons.Goal: After a rowdy debut, this dragon may want an encore... but only if you're loud enough.

dragons.Name: Xanthium
dragons.Description:
The young students of the Vale favor a game comprised of throwing zazzberries at cacti-snacks. If a zazzberry sticks on a thorn of the cacti-snack, the thrower shouts, “Spike!” and all other contestants must run a lap around the target. This was a light-hearted game until one day…

A group of students spotted, nestled in a large bush, the biggest cacti-snack they'd ever seen. They immediately started playing and threw a volley of zazzberries at the target. “Spike!”, said one boy and the rest ran toward the gigantic cacti-snack. As they rounded the thorny fruit, a rumbling snort bellowed out of the supposed dragontreat. The youth screamed in horror and ran. Two eyes popped open and the spiky treat jumped up. It was in fact a slumbering xanthium dragon! After being unexpectedly roused, it turned toward the fleeing students and roared.

The spiker stood still and watched as the sour dragon, spotted with zazzberry splats, tried to shake off the impaled fruit from its back. The boy slowly approached it with his hand outstretched. The xanthium dragon locked eyes on him but didn't move. The boy managed to get close enough and plucked the zazzberry off. He held it out for the dragon to eat and the xanthium dragon snatched it up with a quick snap of its tongue. The dragon smirked and rolled over for a belly rub. The boy gave it a pat and signaled to his friends to come over and join.

Xanthium dragons can be quite prickly if they feel disrespected, but if you try to smooth things over, they'll show a softer side.
dragons.Goal: Don't judge a dragon by its scales... or something like that.

dragons.Name: Outrider
dragons.Description:
The Secret of Flight


Bursting through cloud after cloud, an outrider dragon saw the poorly constructed island in the distance. A soft glow pulsed from it and the dragon sped up. As it flew through more purple fog, the dragon noticed its wings started changing; they thinned out and sharpened at the tips. Its head grew sleek adornments and the dragon tried to look up to see what was happening.


The outrider dragon accidentally barrel rolled while trying to view its new form and quickly realized its augmented flying proficiency. It created a sonic boom as it made an expedited trip to the pulsing island.


As soon as the outrider dragon approached the island, it saw a darcowl dragon waving its tail while alternating forms. The darcowl dragon pointed down with its tail and the outrider dragon looked. It shook its head and shouted. The darcowl dragon motioned again. The outrider dragon dove straight down piercing fog with increasing density until it popped through and saw the Zephyrlands, a region once categorized by ancient wizards from the Surface.


A giant cliff loomed over the land and was split down the center, violently spewing purple fog into the air. The outrider dragon sped to the leak and zoomed in circles near the source. The aimless energy was captured in a cyclone and was prevented from rising up. The outrider dragon stopped to stare at its accomplishment, but the cyclone quickly dissipated, and the energy continued to flow up. The dragon started back up and maintained its perpetual and circular flight pattern…


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Spellform.
dragons.Goal: Faster than a speeding bubble dragon! More powerful than a colosseum! Able to leap tall Treat Farms at a single bound!

dragons.Name: Darcowl
dragons.Description:
The Secret of Stealth


A piece of rock whizzed through the sky and slammed into another. BANG! Another collided, then another; each one with a structure on top. One building's sign swung violently from the commotion and it read, “Bizarre Bazaar”. A darcowl dragon peeked out from behind the building and looked around with wide eyes.


Ellie walked by and the darcowl dragon darted back behind the building. It waited for her to pass then slinked out to observe more of this new environment.


SQUISH. The darcowl dragon lifted its foreleg and saw smoky, purple fog clinging to it like goo. It tried to shake it off but instead it spread back to its tail and up to its head. Instantly, the dragon changed forms and blended in with a nearby shrubbery.


Ellie walked by again and the dragon stood as still as possible. Ellie kept walking without pause. The darcowl dragon looked at itself and saw more purple fog seeping up and over the edge of the island. It ran to the edge, clung to the ground, and peered off into the distance. It couldn't see anything except a sea of purple fog. It crept down onto the spire, close to the clouds, and poked its head through.


Four distinct and massive plumes of purple fog billowed up from the Surface. Lightning strikes blasted throughout the sky. The darcowl dragon's eyes glazed over and its mouth fell agape.


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to equip Spellform pieces.
dragons.Goal: It will prowl, it can howl, it will amend all that is foul; its name is darcowl.

dragons.Name: Quantum
dragons.Description:
The Secret of Physics


While the skies darkened and sporadic energy formed clouds, a quantum dragon lay asleep on a chunk of land floating up toward the Vale. The purple fog around this dragon floated closer and closer, converging on the slumbering creature. The fog clung to the land, then rolled along the sod. The quantum dragon slowly awoke and saw something fuzzy crawling on its tail. As soon as the dragon leapt up and shook incessantly, it glimpsed the open chaotic skies while floating on a tiny island… and fainted.


The perturbed dragon awoke yet again, but this time there was no chunk of land under it. It was levitating without any support. The dragon spun in all directions looking for solid ground. It looked up and saw a huge island; it scrambled in the air to stop levitating. After managing to avoid a collision, the quantum dragon saw a gray figure lean over the edge of the island. It smoothly moved closer to the edge, then suddenly fell. It toppled toward the quantum dragon and an invisible shot of energy reflexively emanated from the creature.


The dragon furrowed its brow and saw the object coming back down. The quantum dragon let out another wave of unseen force and followed the figure in flight. With one last blast, it landed the statue safely to the ground. Staring back at the dragon, was the face of Nogard; he was petrified… encased in stone.


The quantum dragon wiped a smattering of purple energy off Nogard's face and took off with a loud screech toward the Surface…


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Spellform.
dragons.Goal: The obscure wizard, Shrowdynga, would have loved to discover this dragon and he would have never turned his back on it. Take note.

dragons.Name: Riptide
dragons.Description:
The Secret of Fluidity


A baby riptide dragon swam in a lake, splashing about and chuckling to itself. The ground shook and a loud crack echoed. The baby dragon stopped and watched the water. It rippled and then another load CRACK startled the creature. The ground broke apart at the edge of the lake and water poured over the edge like a waterfall into nothingness.


The baby riptide dragon saw an outrider dragon dive down into the deep dark sky, followed shortly by a quantum dragon. The baby buoyed up and down giggling again and swam to the waterfall. Kai caught sight of the baby dragon about to swim off into the sky and he cast a grasping spell.


The spell couldn't hold it back and the dragon slipped off. As it fell, the falling water around it slowly turned purple. The grasping spell interacted with the now liquid energy and the baby riptide dragon was surrounded by a bright aura.


Giant teeth emerged and the aura shattered. A fully-grown riptide dragon with a strong jaw and ominous scales took form and roared with a deep belly laugh. It could now see the Surface and a gorge filled with water.


SPLISH! The dragon had a seamless entry and popped back up. It looked around Silverfalls Gorge, a wide expanse of fresh snow, dense forests, and crystal-clear waterways. Nearby, bubbles percolated, and smoky energy released with each pop. The riptide dragon dove down, looking for the source.


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Spellform.
dragons.Goal: This fearless water-breather might take the breath out of you when it changes forms...

dragons.Name: Armament
dragons.Description:
The Secret of Strength


A giant metal slab rumbled on the kid-conjured island, created to combat rogue spellform energy. The metallic formation shook again. A crack split open, sending splinters in all directions. An armament dragon's head emerged and roared with great power. A darcowl dragon's tail slapped over the shouting dragon's mouth. The armament dragon furrowed its brow as the darcowl dragon revealed itself and slowly removed its tail.


The darcowl dragon broadened its stance and morphed into its organic spellform, creating a veil in front of its newfound friend. Seconds later, Kai walked by to collect the Parade Gardens' Magic accrual. The armament dragon broke out of its immovable trap and roared in triumph. The darcowl dragon again muzzled the loud-mouth dragon with its tail.


After Kai moved on to check Gardenia's Gamery, the darcowl dragon attempted to usher its friend to hidden safety, but it wouldn't follow. The armament dragon peered off into the dark purple sky and wandered closer and closer to the island's edge. It was if the dragon was following a call no dragon or wizard could hear.


The darcowl dragon tried to grapple the wandering dragon's legs. The armament dragon was too strong and kept lumbering toward imminent calamity…


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Spellform.
dragons.Goal: This epitome of brute force is not without its own form of grace.

dragons.Name: Dash
dragons.Description:
The Secret of Agility


THWIP. THWAP. SWISH. SWASH. A dash dragon, on two strong legs, sped through a thick forest breaking branches and mangling bushes. It emerged close to the edge of an island and seamlessly jumped through the air to the next island. It careened toward the Bizarre Bazaar and stopped dead in its tracks.

It sniffed wildly around the perimeter of the market like a blood hound on a trail. It poked its head through the front doors. From inside, a voice screamed, “Ahhhh!” The dash dragon pulled itself out and shook its head as if trying to rid the noise from its ears.

It continued sniffing at the foundation and located a particularly strong scent. It dug frantically into the ground and kept digging until only its tail was sticking out. Snorts and sniffs echoed up from the hole, then silence set in. A young wizard emerged from the Bizarre Bazaar and looked down through the hole… it went right through the island.

Floating through the sky, the dash dragon was encased in spellform energy with only its head poking free. The cloud carried it into the dark unknown, so the dragon pushed its legs through the energy and began pedaling midair. It managed to change the trajectory of the energy cloud and touched down safely on a desert land known to some historians and lorebrarians as Briar Flats.

The dash dragon took its first step on this strange land and noticed its legs had bright green and sleek black feathers. It instinctually took off at top speed and was at least twice as fast as its former self. It ran until it hit water, turned back, and ran another direction. It ran three more laps until it realized there was no dragon, witch, or wizard in sight.

It looked around and simply sat down with its head hung low…

*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Spellform.
dragons.Goal: If this dragon was a bug, you might expect it to have eight legs... but it makes due with two.

dragons.Name: Sparkles
dragons.Description:
The Secret of Voltage


Lost in the spellform energy clouds, a sparkles dragon flew aimlessly, seeking shelter wherever it could. It heard a loud whirring and the occasional yelp. The dragon flew toward the sound, still hindered by limited visibility. It broke through a cloud and saw a spellformed outrider dragon caught in a looping flight pattern. The sparkles dragon squinted, arched its shoulders, and sped toward the victim in the wind. It cut through cloud after cloud until it pierced the last one in between it and the outrider dragon. ZAP! A bright bolt of lightning struck the sparkles dragon while energy encased it.


The sparkles dragon went limp and plummeted. The passing air ruffled its fur and tossed its limbs. It was feet away from the hard ground when it suddenly stopped falling. Its body levitated and righted itself. When its arms tensed, blue lightning emanated from its talons. Now, with smoky gray scales and untamed electricity seeping out, the dragon's eyes popped open. It focused on the split mountain spewing purple energy so bright and constant, that it looked like a sun.


The sparkles dragon flew straight to the mountain and charged its entire body. Jagged blue arcs grew and grew, creating an electric aura. When it became three times as big as the dragon, it unleashed the high voltage ball at the split mountain. It collided with the rocky mass and instantly shattered. The Surface formation crumbled on itself and the bright purple energy leak definitively ceased.


The outrider dragon was still circling as if nothing happened, until the sparkles dragon joined it and flew alongside. The outrider dragon broke its daze and looked at the powerful dragon next to it. They both looked at the collapsed mountain. The outrider dragon slowly came to a stop, slumped over, and heavily exhaled. The sparkles dragon gave it gentle pat on the back with its tail.


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Spellform.
dragons.Goal: Do you hear the hammering thunder that follows this electrifying dragon? No? You must be a mere mortal then.

dragons.Name: Vanguard
dragons.Description:
The Secret of Invention


While the Vale became more engulfed in suffocating Surface energy, a vanguard dragon monitored the youth trying their best to stave off destruction. The dragon saw an airship detach from the dock and flail wildly in the turbulent wind. The vanguard dragon saw a young witch clinging to the mast and flew straight to her aid.


The dragon rose underneath the airship and clamped it between its massive wings. It escorted the ship back to the dock and locked it in place. The witch profusely thanked the dragon and ran off it to find a portal to safety. The vanguard dragon raised a wing to acknowledge the thanks and saw gold gleaming bright on the tips. The dragon looked back at the path it took and saw a hole punched through a giant energy cloud. The vanguard dragon smirked and took off, diving through as many clouds as possible with its wings spread out.


The dragon could see the gold glow emanating from its entire body. It looked around and realized it had flown so low the Surface was in sight. The vanguard dragon could see Silverfalls Gorge with such clarity that something was visibly splashing around a lake.


The vanguard dragon sped toward the mysterious being in distress and saw a riptide dragon porpoising up a mountain, only to fail and slide back down into the lake. The vanguard dragon saw a small pond nestled high in the mountain that was spewing energy out from the water. The riptide dragon yelped at the hovering vanguard dragon and nodded its head toward the pond.


The vanguard dragon flapped over to the mountain and stood firmly between the lake and the pond. The riptide dragon dipped under water and swam away. The vanguard dragon watched intently as its new partner turned around and torpedoed as fast as it could toward the edge of the lake. It leaped out of the water and sailed through the air straight toward the vanguard dragon. The gilded creature compressed its wings on its back and when the riptide dragon came flying down on it, the vanguard dragon's wings sprung up, catapulting its swimming companion back into the air. The riptide dragon dove seamlessly into the pond, unleashed a high pitch frequency, and sealed the energy leak under water.


The riptide dragon emerged and laughed. The vanguard dragon saw the energy geyser sputter to a stop and joined in the laughter. Silverfalls Gorge echoed with their uproarious satisfaction.


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Spellform.
dragons.Goal: To tell the truth, this dragon was a warrior before it found its Spellform. Now, it has beauty to match its brawn.

dragons.Name: Psyche
dragons.Description:
The Secret of Telepathy


Ellie stood on the island she and Kai summoned and watched the creeping energy consume the perimeter. She gripped her wand tight and closed her eyes. Light pink tendrils appeared around her wand, then her entire body. Ellie was so focused she didn't see the curious psyche dragon floating down above her to catch a closer look. Suddenly, the pink tendrils shot out in all directions and decimated the creeping energy. It also consumed the psyche dragon above her head.


The dragon had instantly transformed into a mesmerizing array of green and white scales with geometric pink flare. It scanned the island intently and spotted a rambunctious armament dragon ignoring a darcowl dragon. The psyche dragon's stare intensified and quickly thereafter, the armament dragon walked off the island's edge. As it fell through the sky, panic took hold of the flightless being… until the psyche dragon flew alongside it.


While they both descended at an incredible rate, they saw the Surface's Glimmerverse come into focus. It was a vast, shimmering expanse filled with crystalline formations, rainbows, glittery meadows, and even more energy leaks. The psyche dragon locked eyes with the armament dragon and they leaned left simultaneously. The non-flying friend curled up into a ball and targeted a crystal ramp below it. The armament dragon hit the ramp and rolled speedily onto solid ground. The psyche dragon caught up with it. As soon as the armament dragon came out of its tucked position, it ran at full speed toward a giant crystal with energy spewing out from its base. CRASH! The behemoth creature demolished it and sealed the leak. It kept pace, trampled a field of toadstools, and ran toward another crystal. The psyche dragon floated to several more leaks and the armament dragon sealed each one in succession with deliberate destruction.


The two of them continued until no leak was left in the Glimmerverse. There were few crystals that survived the demolition derby, but order was restored… or at least it appeared so.


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Spellform."
dragons.Goal: Yes, dragons can't talk, but this unique friend has found a way around that...

dragons.Name: Snootroot
dragons.Description: It's a wonder it took so long to discover the Snootroot dragon, considering how it loves to flaunt its fluff. Known to spend half of its day preening, and the other half brandishing its pompous coiffure, researchers still aren't sure when this dragon actually sleeps. Then again, the wizards may have been too mesmerized by the Snootroot's fancy flairs to actually do any research.
dragons.Goal: This dragon really shows you how to strut your stuff!

dragons.Name: Fury
dragons.Description:
During the calamitous incidents known as the Secrets of Spellform, there was a being that may have been the cause of it all. Deep in the Surface, a bundle of condensed energy became somewhat autonomous. Its sole purpose was to escape, but the pent-up energy could not break through to the open air above. It was deflected every time it came close to piercing through. After every attempt, the sentient energy mass dissipated and reappeared in another underground region of the Surface.


This unfortunate soul repeated the same cycle over and over, creating geysers of energy leaks across the Surface, until a massive amount of energy pooled around it. The entity pulsed and grew. It aimed upward once again and propelled through the earthy quagmire.


On the flat, desolate ground of the Briar Flats, a lone dash dragon sat sulking. The ground cracked. The dragon tilted its head. The crack grew slowly then spread wildly. The dash dragon perked up and ran in circles, trying to escape the fierce fissure.


A vanguard dragon flew in and landed with a riptide dragon on its back. An outrider and sparkles dragon sped in and hovered. A quantum and psyche dragon levitated in alongside an armament dragon floating in a translucent force field bubble. They all surrounded the seismic event preparing to seal the largest energy leak on the Surface…


Before they could act, the subterranean energy burst through the ground. It appeared to survey the spellform dragons around it and began to change. The energy took the shape of a dragon with four legs, sharp talons, and dismal fur. It was indeed a dragon spawned from a furious inception. The psyche dragon approached it in the air and signaled with pink flares. The fury dragon snorted, turned away, and flew toward the Vale.
dragons.Goal: Sometimes it's hard to conquer your strongest predisposition, but that is where friendship flourishes.

dragons.Name: Bastion
dragons.Description:
The Secret of Inspiration


While the other eight spellform dragons were witnessing the birth of a fury dragon on the Surface, the lone darcowl dragon in the Vale was combating increasingly hostile energy alongside Kai and Ellie. More and more kids started casting spells to push back the purple fog. Even the dragons without enhancements rose to the occasion and used their magic breath to bolster the unified defense.


Just then, the fury dragon rose high above the Vale and proudly floated with a scowling observance of the chaos. It smirked. The Surface energy walloped the darcowl dragon and sent it into a stupor. Ellie ran to check on it as Kai fired suppressing spells to keep her safe from the onslaught. The fury dragon's smirk faded when all it could see was children and dragons fighting an endless battle. Another wave of energy hit the darcowl dragon and it tumbled off the island's edge. The fury dragon rocketed straight down toward the helpless being. The darcowl dragon vanished below an energy cloud and the fury dragon followed it blindly.


High above the Surface, the group of spellform dragons flew up while the non-flyers hitched a ride. They were looking for the furious one, when two dragons burst through a cloud above them and collided with the group. A bright light exploded from the epicenter of the collision.


As the light faded, a new dragon appeared. Its bright blue wings and staggering aura magically held the stunned dragons in mid-air. Much like the fury dragon was created from raw rebellion, the bastion dragon was created from pure hope. The bastion dragon flew up to the safety of the Vale and gently descended with the dazed dragons still in tow. As they landed, the immaculate force emanating from the bastion dragon quelled all of the Surface energy. The purple fog faded, and a clear blue sky framed the rising sun for dawn to grace the Vale once again.


The petrified House Witches and Wizards broke free from the spell and witnessed other adult magicfolk appearing from thin air. Nogard looked around and saw a boy jumping for joy, “Young one. What happened here?”


The young boy said, “My name's Donlo, Mr. Nogard sir. The dragons did it! They saved the Vale!”


Nogard looked over and saw the newly pink-maned fury dragon stand up in the middle of the spellform dragons. The group closed in on the fury dragon and huddled together, resting their heads and wings on each other. The bastion dragon enveloped them all with its brilliant wings. Kai and Ellie watched and smiled as the warmth of sunlight spread.



*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Spellform.
dragons.Goal: The last ounce of hope is usually the strongest like this iconic dragon shielding others from despair.

dragons.Name: Sailback
dragons.Description:
A snoring sailback dragon slept belly up on the sand of a paradise habitat. Small waves crept in and splashed its head. Its eyes slowly opened and blinked to get the water out. The sailback dragon sluggishly rolled over and stood up, stretching its back and tail as far as it could. A heavy groan escaped its mouth.


As the sound of waves grew louder, the dragon's jaw dropped…


THE NIGHT BEFORE


The sailback dragon was decked out in its glowing style and performed dazzling acrobatics in the middle of a sea of tiki torches. A magicfolk audience chanted, “Sailback! Sailback!” The dragon caught sight of a pile of blushrooms, danced over to it, and dove in headfirst. It ate the lot and emerged with a face splattered in blue.


The crowd cheered. A nearby armament dragon observed the spectacle and chuckled. The sailback dragon ran around to make sure everyone could see its blue face before it jumped into the water.


While the exuberant dragon was in midair, someone shouted, “You can't swim!” Panic hit the sailback dragon's face before it belly-flopped in deep water…


PRESENT DAY


The sailback dragon stared at the water and slowly backed up. It stepped in a shallow puddle and yelped. The dragon scampered away and didn't look back.


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Style
dragons.Goal: This friend gets a bit overhyped at night but manages to unwind in daylight.

dragons.Name: Monte
dragons.Description:
As it walked through the Vale yawning, a monte dragon stumbled upon a giant mess of chopped, diced, and smashed beanstalks. It bent down to take a taste, mostly to determine if it was still good to eat. It smacked its beak with appeasement and went in for another bite…


THE NIGHT BEFORE


The monte dragon flew high above a crowd of Valers and dragons, diving and swooping between the tall beanstalks of a large treat farm crop. The Valers held buckets over their heads and the dragons watched intently. The monte dragon snapped and chomped at the beanstalks. Chunks flew in the air as sugary juice rained down into the buckets. The magicfolk emptied the buckets in a giant trough for the spectating dragons. A darcowl and an outrider dragon sidled in and lapped up some fresh beanstalk juice. They smiled at each other with dripping jowls.


The monte dragon kept flying and slicing beanstalks until the trough was overflowing. The witches and wizards below tried to signal for it to stop, but the dragon saw what looked like a rowdy good time. Soon, everyone was knee deep in beanstalk chunks.


PRESENT DAY


The monte dragon took a second look at the mess and may have blushed… it would be hard to tell. It pushed all the beanstalk pieces together with its wings and assembled a pile. It picked up a large leaf in its beak and placed it neatly on top. As it walked away, it stopped and turned back for one last bite for the road.


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Style
dragons.Goal: A full cup puts a smile on this dragon's face.

dragons.Name: Toco
dragons.Description:
High atop a skytree, a tired toco dragon rolled over on a leaf and almost fell to the ground. It planted a wing on the edge and pushed itself back, but for some reason, there was a busted bongo drum encircling its fruit-colored feathers. It tilted its head at the mysterious musical instrument that looked more like a bracelet…


THE NIGHT BEFORE


The toco dragon was taking a calm evening flight when an intriguing and rhythmic beat echoed up from the ground. A circle of magicfolk were pounding drums with joy!


The dragon landed right in the middle and looked at each drummer with a smirk. The music overwhelmed the dragon in such a way, its only avenue to distribute the positive energy was to run in circles, waving its wings wildly. The Valers laughed and kept the beat going. One wizard soloed on some bongo drums and it caught the dragon's attention. The wizard stepped aside to give the toco dragon a chance… if it would even recognize what the Valer was offering.


The toco dragon raised its wings and beat the bongos with fervor. The circle of players encouraged it and cheered. Even a dash and psyche dragon started nodding their heads. The toco dragon got so animated, it punched right through the drum with its wing. The dragon might have apologized if it could, but it immediately flew away with the drum trailing its flapping wings.


PRESENT DAY


The toco dragon still gazing at the drum, shook its wing violently to rid itself of the embarrassment. Unfortunately, it heard some Valers below talking just as the drum flew off. The dragon tried to catch it, but it crashed to the ground and caused the witches to look up. The toco dragon scrambled to hide amongst the leaves and sheepishly peeked out.


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Style
dragons.Goal: To love music is never a shame; ruining a groove changes the game.

dragons.Name: Vibe
dragons.Description:
As the sun rose, a vibe dragon sauntered across the vacant Dragon Dance Floor. It spotted a sizeable scorch mark on the edge and tapped its foot on top, presumably to see if it was dangerous…


THE NIGHT BEFORE


The vibe dragon walked near the dance floor and could hear infectious beats. There were too many witches and wizards around to get a good look, so it climbed to the top of a canopy. From there, it could see two dragons stamping around to the rhythm. As the sun set, the dancers receded into darkness… until the vibe dragon's pulsing style activated.


The dance floor exploded with an intricate pattern, basking the dancers in a soft orange glow. The dancing dragons gleefully roared. The vibe dragon's head started nodding to the beat as it directed the light show with its entire body.


High above, a sparkles dragon noticed the illuminated display and landed right next to the vibe dragon. The newcomer started bobbing its head in unison with the vibe dragon. Lightning spread across the sky and yellow flashed down on the dancers. The lightning increased, creating a vibrant and choreographed light show that amplified the scene with electrified hype.


Suddenly, a bolt of lightning touched down on the edge of the dance floor. The lights stopped and the dragons froze. The vibe dragon looked at its lighting partner and shook its head. The vibe dragon started its style up again and the party continued.


PRESENT DAY


The vibe dragon glazed over the scorch with intense breath magic then wiped it clean with its tail. With the floor being properly mended, it looked like nothing ever happened.


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Style
dragons.Goal: It doesn't matter how smooth your moves are if it's too dark. Always bring this illuminating friend if there's dancing to be done.

dragons.Name: Elegant
dragons.Description:
A bedraggled elegant dragon slinked up to a pond and bent down to take a sip. It caught a glimpse of its disheveled reflection and stumbled back. The shocked dragon leaned in again to confirm its appearance in the water…


THE NIGHT BEFORE


A crowd of magicfolk were talking about the Secrets of Spellform while several dragons milled about a flower-covered patio. The witches and wizards stopped all conversation and the dragons stood perfectly still. Every head turned in the same direction to see an elegant dragon gracefully gliding down a grassy knoll.


The chic presence made its way down to the patio, gently making a trail on the flowered floor. A riptide dragon poked its head out of a nearby lake and stared blankly at the flowing peace of the elegant dragon. The now giddy riptide dragon dove down and popped up high in the air. It flipped over and over, let out a whistle, then straightened for a perfect dive.


A gigantic splash of muddy lake water landed on the elegant dragon. Muck and flowers were pasted all over its body and face. An audible gasp rippled through the crowd. The dripping elegant dragon looked up at the blushing riptide dragon. With one swift flick of its head, the elegant dragon displayed its style. The frills around its neck and tail flung the muddy mess in all directions into the crowd.


Music kicked on and the elegant dragon started dancing. Everyone joined in.


PRESENT DAY


The elegant dragon, still looking at itself, snickered and dunked its whole head in the water. The mud and flowers washed away, and the dragon snapped its head back to dry off. A spitting sound was heard seconds later. The dragon turned around to see Kaleni wiping water off his face.


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Style
dragons.Goal: Make no mistake, this dragon loves to look good, but it will never sacrifice fun for beauty.

dragons.Name: Terracotta
dragons.Description: On the eighth anniversary of the first visitor in DragonVale, an unusual dragon came to pay homage. The terracotta dragon, which seemed to be molded out of earthen clay, was spotted shuffling in a definitive pattern. The ever balanced and determined dragon kept at it until one wizard claimed it was drawing the symbol for infinity. He went on to say it was a declaration of permanence for the bond between magicfolk and dragonkind. Others said it was a sideways eight. Either way, it marked the anniversary in an unmistakable and memorable fashion.
dragons.Goal: Calm diligence pays off eventually even if those around you see differing results.

dragons.Name: Ruckus
dragons.Description:
A baby ruckus dragon woke up in a meadow and stumbled to its feet. As it lost its balance, it smacked up against an invisible barrier. The dragon shook its head and attempted to walk. It banged right into an apparent obstacle yet again…

THE NIGHT BEFORE

The rambunctious ruckus dragon bounced around admiring a gathering of spellform dragons. It hopped to each one, surveyed their impressive stature, and flicked its tongue out. It arrived face to face with a quantum dragon and grinned ear to ear. The ruckus dragon pogoed and incessantly bugled its buzzing kazoo of a tongue. This went on far too long as evidenced by the dreary look on the quantum dragon's face. Soon, every dragon in the vicinity was staring at the obnoxious display.

The quantum dragon waved its wing in front of the ruckus dragon and the noise stopped instantly. When it jumped, the precocious dragon bopped its head on an invisible force field. It tried to escape the incomprehensible enclosure but could not. The quantum dragon relaxed and sighed, but the ruckus dragon was clearly not amused anymore and voiced its dissatisfaction even though no dragon could hear it.

PRESENT DAY

The quantum dragon woke up to see its bubble shield still intact. It gritted its teeth and winked. The invisible field dissipated, and the ruckus baby was free. It looked around and spotted the guilty spellform dragon. The enraged baby trumpeted a furious buzz from its unfurling forked tongue. It sounded very different than the previous night.

*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Style
dragons.Goal: It doesn't seem to matter what makes this dragon happy or angry; either way it gets all riled up.

dragons.Name: Razzle
dragons.Description:
A razzle dragon sat on the edge of an icy pond, soaking its long legs. It stretched both out of the ice bath, winced, and set them back in…

THE NIGHT BEFORE

The razzle dragon, limber and spry, ran through the Vale gathering attention with mouth-clicks, chirps, and exuberant wing flapping. A nearby vanguard dragon snickered at the peculiar display.

On the outskirts of the Vale, A lumberjack of a wizard had cast an auto-axe spell and watched it methodically chop a tall oak. The razzle dragon sped by and caught the working wizard's eye. He walked away from the spell with only inches left intact on the trunk. The swaying tree released a loud CRACK and alarmed the amused vanguard dragon. It came running around the corner just in time to divert the falling tree with its strong wings. THUD! The tree struck the ground a few feet from the Hibernation Cave.

On a thick wooded trail, an ignite dragon led a pack of baby dragons on a hike to wild dragon treats. The ignite dragon blasted branches and thorns out of their path with precision breath magic. The razzle dragon flew overhead, cawing and gesturing to anyone below it to follow. The ignite dragon got distracted and followed the hoopla. The baby ignite dragons stopped walking when they were faced with an impenetrable thicket. The dutiful vanguard dragon appeared shortly thereafter and landed near the hatchlings. It cleared a path for them but in turn became encased in thorns and prickly branches.

In the center of town, a witch was as busy as a busby dragon painting her house when the razzle dragon skipped by squawking and waving. The witch thought something important must be happening for this fabulous fanfare, so she followed the rabble-rousing razzle dragon too. Unfortunately, the velocity of the witch's levitating paint globs increased as soon as she left. It appeared as if her neighbor might be the recipient of an unwanted home makeover, until the resourceful vanguard dragon flew in front of the rogue paint and flapped its enormous wings. Of course, the paint went straight up in the air and rained down on the poor, selfless soul trying to help avert disaster.

When the winded, scathed, and painted spellform dragon caught up with the razzle dragon, it loudly and proudly waltzed into the Colosseum. The vanguard dragon stopped, shook its head, and turned around.

PRESENT DAY

The razzle dragon stepped out of the ice bath and calmly stood on one leg to dry off. It tucked its head under its wing and snoozed away.
