*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Style
dragons.Goal: The one, the only, the can't stop won't stop dragon that elevates, exaggerates, and downright celebrates anyone it wants, is here for your everlasting party needs.

dragons.Name: Dazzle
dragons.Description:
In the middle of an empty Colosseum, a dazzle dragon slept atop a bed of flowers and confetti. It grunted and kicked its feet as if it were immersed in an intense dream…

THE NIGHT BEFORE

Outside the Colosseum, Zola gave a pep talk to the dazzle dragon as it ineffectively hid behind a tree. “Just give ‘em an act with lots of flash”, she said. Just then, a razzle dragon hurriedly escorted an elder earth dragon out of a heated contest. The dazzle dragon's eyes darted from the massive arena to Zola.

Zola paused, then snapped her fingers. Shiny black bangles, spikes, and shoulder pads appeared on the dragon. Zola rubbed her chin while observing the outfit then twitched her nose. A sleek pair of sunglasses coalesced on the dragon's head.

The dazzle dragon walked out from behind the tree and admired its new look. It let out a squeaky roar and jumped back behind the tree. Zola looked at the setting sun and twirled her quill. She waved her writing utensil at the ever-shy dragon and cast a magic mic spell. A conjured golden microphone levitated in front of the dragon's mouth. It released a curious groan and it was instantly translated into a melodic and lyrical vocalization that any witch or wizard could understand.

The dazzle dragon hopped back out from hiding and held its head high. It nodded at Zola, then marched into the Colosseum. The razzle dragon flew around the crowd and swooped down to announce the arrival of the headlining dazzle dragon. It took center stage and bellowed a verse. Zola flicked her quill and a beat-heavy track backed the vocals.

The crowd was stunned… too stunned to properly react. Then, a bastion dragon flew in, activated its conjured spellform, and danced in the sky. The crowd snapped out of its stupor and cheered louder than the Colosseum could contain.

PRESENT DAY

The dazzle dragon awoke suddenly and immediately moon-walked across the Colosseum floor. It looked around and saw not a single Valer nor dragon was there. It promptly went back to sleep with its sunglasses by its side.

*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Style
dragons.Goal: From humble beginnings to a riotous debut, this rising star has captured the hearts and minds of an entire generation... well that's what the wizarding press wrote after this dragon's first concert.

dragons.Name: Eldritch
dragons.Description:
The Hunt Begins


As old wizard Whitbee put the finishing touches on the Airship of Ghouls late at night, a dark mass materialized in a blue portal behind him. This was the same blue portal he had made every year as part of his themed décor, but it was never functional.


The mass propelled from the portal, creating a rush of wind that blew Whitbee's hat off. He bent down to pick it up and saw the mysterious entity rush into a forest before losing sight of it. He nervously twisted his hat.


Whitbee decided to research this phenomenon in the Dragonarium and while browsing bookshelves from floor to ceiling, he stopped dead in his tracks as one tome pulsed. He retrieved it with a levitation spell and quickly thumbed through the pages. He arrived at a depiction of a shadowy figure dubbed the Eldritch Dragon. Upon reading more, he found that after escaping its home realm, only the Shrouded Cavalry could usher it back to its proper plane of existence. A dragon's shadow spread across the wall behind Whitbee, unbeknownst to him as he pondered the implications of the text.


Just outside the Dragonarium, Gardenia, Nogard, Kaleni, and Lumi were searching for a lost baby lycan dragon. Everyone had their wands set with torch light. As soon as they discovered the wandering baby, it began to howl. “Well, that's one heck of a howl, little one,” Nogard declared.


Lumi looked up at the full moon and said, “It must be a natural reaction.”


Gardenia chimed in, “It's so cute! It sounds like it's saying ‘looooo.'”


“Like, let's name it Moony-Loo, then,” Kaleni announced. Before anyone could agree, the eldritch dragon flew past them with a gusty force. “Yikes!” yelped Kaleni.


The gang hid behind a tree, including Moony-Loo. They saw Whitbee follow in the creepy dragon's wake with a book tucked under his arm. Nogard deduced, “I've got a feeling, Whitbee might be planning something a bit too scary for some of the Valefolk this year.”


*This dragon must be level 4 or higher to wear a Shroud*
dragons.Goal: It may be strange, and it may be scary, but maybe it's just looking for a place to call home...

dragons.Name: Charlatan
dragons.Description:
The Hunt has Hope

Nogard, Lumi, Gardenia, Kaleni, and Moony-Loo followed Whitbee back to the blue portal near the Airship of Ghouls. “You know, I've been thinking. We need a name,” Lumi proposed.

“A name for what?” Kaleni blurted.

Lumi continued her thought, “For this. What we're doing right now. It's quite the mystery we're chasing.”

“How about… Magical Mystery Team?” Nogard suggested.

“Loooooo!” the baby lycan dragon howled.

Gardenia piped up, “Sounds like a winner!” Just then, a deafening whirlwind was unleashed. The team stumbled behind a large rock and peeked around it. Whitbee was holding a book and recited an incantation.

The only word they could hear was, “… charlatan!” As soon as it was uttered, a broad winged dragon shot out of the portal. It looped around and hovered in front of Whitbee. The whirlwind died down.

“Find the Eldritch,” Whitbee commanded. The charlatan dragon took off in a streak of blue and gold. It majestically searched the land from high above. Moony-Loo ran after it.

Kaleni followed and cried, “Wait up, Moony!”

In a bustling neighborhood, the charlatan dragon circled while witches and wizards decorated their homes with jack-o-lanterns and cauldrons. Kaleni and Moony arrived just when everyone collectively witnessed the charlatan dragon. They oohed and aahed at the aerial display.

Moony-Loo caught sight of the eldritch dragon on the outskirts of the neighborhood and chased it. The charlatan dragon saw the same thing Moony did and dove straight down into the midst of gawking magicfolk. It weaved in and out of homes, dodged innocent bystanders, and went straight after its target.

Kaleni busted through a bush just in time to see the charlatan dragon sweep over the Eldritch with its wing. Moony watched intently as blue, gold, and white took root on the eldritch dragon's tail and hind legs.

“L-L-Let's get outta here!” Kaleni stammered to Moony-Loo.
dragons.Goal: This dragon may look composed, but just wait until it sees something it wants...

dragons.Name: Fulgurite
dragons.Description:
Fulgurite dragons have a disputed origin amongst argumentative magicfolk. Some say they are mud dragons that have gotten into a physical kerfuffle with lightning dragons; permanently altering their scale structure from an electrical current. Others say they are sand sculptures, made by wizarding youth, that have been animated by natural lightning strikes. And there's one ornery, strange wizard that swears it's a dragon with rock-like scales and a foul mouth. No one really talks to him much anymore.

It is very likely that none of these theories are correct. If you're lucky enough to spot a baby fulgurite dragon, you'll see they possess earth and lightning magic from the very beginning of their cloistered lives.
dragons.Goal: Not everyone has a complicated backstory. It's best to keep your expectations grounded when meeting new friends...

dragons.Name: Scourge
dragons.Description:
The Hunt is Plagued


Kaleni came running back to the Magical Mystery Team after witnessing the charlatan dragon chase down the Eldritch. “Guys, this is getting serious—,” but before he could finish his sentiment, they all witnessed a sharp, black beak poke through the blue portal. A scourge dragon with yellow eyes and sallow fur awkwardly flew into the Vale and touched down in front of Whitbee. The wizard pointed to the charlatan dragon's path. The scourge dragon twitched and craned its head sideways. With a muted guttural shriek, it hobbled away on hoof.


Nogard cut the tension, “I think we should follow this one together.” The team exchanged glances and nodded in agreement.


“No way!” Kaleni blurted. “After what I saw, I'm staying right here.” Moony-Loo nuzzled up against the frightened wizard and Kaleni gave him a pat on the head. Nogard conceded but instructed Kaleni to send up a signal flare spell at the first sign of trouble.


As the team followed the scourge dragon, they saw treat farm crops wilt and dry out almost instantly. Gardenia gasped so loudly that the scourge dragon snapped around to look behind it. Lumi cast a camouflage spell around the crew just in time. The scourge dragon continued. Gardenia, on the other hand, huffed and started slinging regrowth spells at the wake of withered crops.


Alone in a glade, the eldritch dragon stared at its tail and hind legs covered in a charlatan shroud. It looked up to see the trees all around it shrivel and dry. The grass turned brown and quickly encircled the eldritch dragon. As the unknown magic was inches away from the dragon, it flew up and out of harm's way.


Just outside the forest, Lumi pointed up at the eldritch dragon flying out of the spreading danger. The scourge dragon rose up and flew over the escapee. Their wings touched and the eldritch dragon saw a grayness spread. Its wings wilted and resembled those of the scourge dragon.


Just then, a bright, red flare shot high in the sky.
dragons.Goal: A frightful face fleetingly facilitates fear, a blighted being burdens beauty beyond belief.

dragons.Name: Barbarous
dragons.Description:
The Hunt is Imperiled

The team of wizards raced back to the portal where they left Kaleni, following the glow of the flare in the sky.

They found their companion ducking behind a bush and joined him in hiding. Gazing up, they saw that the light in the sky was no flare, but a fearsome-looking dragon, wreathed in metal and flames. It was then joined by a dark shape circling in the air - it appeared that the eldritch dragon had followed them back.

As they whirled together in the dark sky, the eldritch dragon suddenly burst alight and took on a flame-filled form, causing the shadows in the square to dance and flicker wildly. The eldritch dragon drew its now burning wings together and, with a blinding flash, rocketed away.

Just then, Whitbee emerged from the darkness and pointed his wand at the fire-lit trail left by the eldritch dragon. The armored, fiery dragon seemed to heed the order and darted away across the landscape, a cantering, conflagratious countenance. Whitbee took off after it, and the other wizards followed, sticking to the shadows.
dragons.Goal: It make look fierce, but this dragon knows what it's good for.

dragons.Name: Macabre
dragons.Description:
The Hunt is Ending

As the gang watched Whitbee teleport to follow the flaming streak left by the ignited eldritch dragon, the portal behind them began to change color to a silver-flecked sickly green. A pale, decaying dragon with enormous scythe-like horns emerged from it and sensing its brethren and the escaped dragon they sought, it darted into the dark sky, to head off its target and direct it back to the portal.

The macabre dragon rounded an enormous colosseum, banking North and cut off its prey. Seeing the black and red streak of the eldritch dragon turn sharply in its direction, it rocketed past and as it did so, the eldritch dragon's colors changed yet again, now resembling the pale and sickly green of the macabre dragon.

At the Bizarre Bazaar, Nogard surmised that they should start to clean up the mess that had been created in order to help Whitbee. Using their wands to repair and clean, Kaleni conjured up some snacks so that no one would go hungry.

Whitbee reappeared just in time to see the eldritch dragon land in the clearing in front of the portal as the other dragons followed suit. Sensing that the ordeal would soon be over, Whitbee sighed in relief, until Lumi, visibly exasperated by now, exclaimed, “you accidentally summoned that dragon didn't you!? Then you summoned the four apocalyptic hunters to assist you right”? Sheepishly, Whitbee replied, “yes, I did, but I wouldn't have gotten away with it if it weren't for you meddling wizards, and for that I thank you”.

The shrouds that covered the eldritch dragon began to phase in and out of view blinking faster and faster until they disappeared entirely leaving a very awkward eldritch dragon standing there. “You know, this poor dragon didn't really do any harm to the Vale, and could stay if it likes”, said Gardenia. “It can leave any time it wants as can these four hunters!” In an attempt to lighten the mood, Kaleni declared, “I'd make an apocalypse pun right now, but armageddon the feeling it wouldn't go over well”. Kaleni laughed, the gang groaned, and Moony-Loo let forth a “Moony-loony LOOOOOOOO”!
dragons.Goal: The goal isn't to go on forever, the goal is to create something that will.

dragons.Name: Venture
dragons.Description:
Winter in the Vale is not time for wandering or exploring, unless you're the venture dragon.
This dragon loves to ramble far and wide, searching for rare, forgotten sights and relics. A big part of the Jolly Jubilee celebration every year is the moment when all the wizards and witches come together to hand out and share the rare items collected by the venture dragon's intrepid travels.
It's said that Nogard's own walking stick is an ancient, powerful artifact brought to him by a venture dragon many years ago. In fact, many of the head wizards possess items of power found by these brave exploring dragons. Though not all of the trinkets brought back possess magical properties, each is special in its own right and a prized possession of whichever witch or wizard it was given to.
The venture dragon is so known for these wondrous gifts it brings, that the some wizards have taken to calling it the “Secret Sandakloz”.
dragons.Goal: Its travels are done for now, the venture dragon has come to live in your park!

dragons.Name: Reminiscence
dragons.Description:
Travelling far into unknown tundra, Lumi looked for an ancient dragon that would know of lost Jolly Jubilee traditions. Though the snowy wilderness was lonely, memories of hot zazzberry cider, the game bazaar, and the Winter Wizard Ball kept her warm. Lost in thought, she practiced her waltz across an icy lake, and with each dance step a mysterious glow below her grew brighter and brighter.
With a wind spell she blew the snow away and revealed a glittery dragon frozen beneath the ice! In its shiny wings she could see her happiest memories. After breaking it free they became fast friends, flying back to the Jubilee together.
The reminiscence dragon shared everyone's memories they had of the Vale, growing more warm, sweet, and rich with the passage of time.
dragons.Goal: You'll remember this moment for seasons to come!

dragons.Name: Harmony
dragons.Description:
The special properties of the harmony dragon really help it live up to its name. It is said whenever there is conflict near a harmony dragon, it sings a magical melody that spreads peace and calm to all nearby.
This was especially helpful this year when the head House Wizards and Witches were arguing about how to best organize the Jolly Jubilee festivities. The grand hall of the Dragonarium was filled with racket of arguing voices. Nogard and Whitbee were shouting over each other about decorations while Lumi stood on a table and yelled for attention. Even the usually serene Kaleni was raising his voice about table settings.
Fed up with all the fighting, Gardenia went out and brought back her harmony dragon. Slowly, the tranquil tune from the dragon spread throughout the hall and, one by one, the arguing wizards were quieted. The rest of the night was much more productive after that and, thanks to the harmony dragon, everyone was able to come up with the perfect plan for the holiday together.
dragons.Goal: You might notice your visitors being a little nicer to each other around this dragon.

dragons.Name: Yule
dragons.Description:
The Jolly Jubilee was approaching, and the wizard Kaleni could hardly contain his excitement. Every year the wizards' feast was overflowing with treats like pumpermelon pie and berry bauble bonbons. Just the thought of all those tasty goodies was making Kaleni's stomach rumble.
One day, Kaleni decided to go check in the larder, just to make sure that there were enough supplies for impending celebration. But to his abject horror, Kaleni found the larder nearly empty! This state of affairs was completely unacceptable to the wizard, and he was determined to make it right. He hitched a sleigh to his trusty Yule dragon and the two made their way out into the cold.
The snow outside was piled all the way to the roofs and the wind blew with biting force, but the steadfast yule dragon plowed through it all. The pair stopped at each house and the yule dragon roared a melodious tune to get the residents' attention. Kaleni explained their plight to the wizards they visited and each one gave generously.
By the end of the night, the treat pile on the sleigh was so tall that the yule dragon had to balance carefully to keep it all from toppling over. Once the last of the treats were loaded into the larder, Kaleni looked at the hoard of generous donations and sighed with content. The feast was saved.
His work complete, Kaleni tucked in for the night, but not before grabbing a couple Fiery Fig Fritters for a well-deserved snack.
dragons.Goal: With a clamp clomp and a jingle jangle, the Yule dragon is here!

dragons.Name: Spellmason
dragons.Description:
It was three nights before the Jolly Jubilee and Whitbee couldn't figure out what gift he would bring. He locked himself away in the highest tower of his castle, surrounded by snow and dragon gargoyles, to craft a spell for summoning a new dragon.
No matter what perilous potions or magical mutterings he tried, he had no luck. Through the window he could see the first aurora borealis of the season and decided to take a break. Soon after he opened the window and snuggled up with a good blanket, a frightening shape flew into the room! It was one of the gargoyle dragons brought to life by hearing all his magic spells from nights before! The dark creature flapped its vibrant wings and revealed a myriad of shapes, sharing all the creative colors hidden from the winter season.
The spellmason dragon is now here, inspiring everyone in times of darkness to keep creating what they love for years to come!
dragons.Goal: Multicolored mosaics shine with the splendor of the season!

dragons.Name: Frond
dragons.Description: When spring arrives in the Vale and the snowy hills melt into shallow lagoons, the Frond dragons emerge from their hibernation. These permanently relaxed dragons like to soak in the cool pools and bask in the warm sunlight. They're so laid back that you could even join them for a dip if you wanted! Just don't cause a ruckus, or they might splash you with their mighty tails!
dragons.Goal: Your visitors are sure to be fond of this one!

dragons.Name: Thrasher
dragons.Description: From toco to sandstorm, the Vale has no shortage of draconic music enthusiasts. However, some musical trends take longer to catch on than others. The thrasher dragons use the sharp edges of their wings to create a shrill, metallic melody. Though older witches and wizards don't care for it, it's gained quite a following among the young ones, who say they appreciate its ‘edginess'.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is going to the top of the charts!

dragons.Name: Bouldershock
dragons.Description: The bouldershock dragon is known for being able to channel latent static energy in the ground. The resulting tremors often follow the dragon's moods and can be pretty potent when the dragon is upset. A moody bouldershock can even trigger small earthquakes on a local scale, so you don't want to miss this dragon's feeding time! After a few close calls with the hatchery, we try to house this dragon well away from any fragile items.
dragons.Goal: The arrival of this dragon is a seismic event!

dragons.Name: Shockproof
dragons.Description:
It is SHOCKing how blinding lightning is proven to be… Luckily, shockproof is in the Vale to protect the wizards! What made it shock proof you may ask? According to Whitbee, it all started with a bang!
Up there in the Frozen Highlands of the North mountains, snowy storms at high altitudes were making everything so appalling for Whitbee.. All of a sudden the deafening crackle of thunder stunned him. With the blink of an eye, an apocalyptic picture unravelled! Lightnings everywhere, piles of snow covering the ground…. it was scary!
With its little legs, Shockproof rushed into the open and was Hit by, Struck by a smooth… Lightning Strike. This resulted in unique appearance and got it this amazing name.
Shocking, right?
dragons.Goal: This dragon is thundering its way to the top of the charts!

dragons.Name: Wick
dragons.Description:
From Fire and Light this dragon came forth.
Its secrets Wizards and Witches tried to unfold.
From youth to adult they studied it all.
Only in mysteries and puzzles to fall.
To bother the Wick they wanted no more.
Some tales are better to stay forever untold.
dragons.Goal: This dragon looks so slick on the top of the charts!

dragons.Name: Aquacorn
dragons.Description: Once upon a time, in the far away kingdom of Whitedragon, the beautiful princess Eris was collecting wildflowers again near the pond where she first saw her dearest chromacorn dragon. Eris sat on a river stone and gazed at her reflection in the water, visualizing all the cherished memories she has had with her best friend. Suddenly, Eris' reflection in the water started moving and a beautiful aquacorn dragon emerged from the water! Its colors more beautiful than a magical sunset, gliding gracefully through the water and bathing in the sun rays, the aquacorn felt immediate connection to the princess and rushed to her.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will be wave-ing you from the top!

dragons.Name: Daylily
dragons.Description: If beauty and grace were to become a living creature, they still wouldn't compare to the daylily dragon. Don't let its calm demeanour fool you though - this dragon has a touch of spice. And like its namesake, it doesn't really look like a dragon. But definitely is one. Trust us - we are Dragon specialists. We know best.
dragons.Goal: This dragon be-leaves it looks best on the top!

dragons.Name: Whirlwind
dragons.Description: When a whirlwind appears, the basic instinct is to seek shelter. In times like this, wizards in the past have asked themselves what could be the cause of the terrifying wind. They travelled far and wide to study this phenomenon and no matter where, and how many different legends they have heard, the name of the whirlwind dragon would always come up. From stories about unrivalled mayhem and destruction to the slightest breeze or gust of wind, it was believed that this dragon was the source of it. There were many speculations about its appearance, as it was the common conception that it appeared only during the apex of the storm. Few were unfortunate or brave enough to weather such conditions, and they told a different tale. In the bleakest moment, the whirlwind dragon would always appear and protect the whole Vale from a catastrophy. All this time, it was not causing havoc, it was defending its home...
dragons.Goal: This dragon will wind you up to the top!

dragons.Name: Poshwing
dragons.Description: The poshwing dragon is accustomed only to the finest lifestyle. Most often you will find it attending the choicest galas or browsing the fanciest boutique merchants. Many envy it for its style of living, but little do they know, that the "posh wing" is just a curious overgrowth of a pretty shrub.
dragons.Goal: This dragon loves being on the top!

dragons.Name: Triple Leap Year
dragons.Description:
All good things come in threes - three-course meals, three little kittens, triple cheeseburgers, live laugh love signs and of course - three-headed dragons. Because three heads are better than two!
Let's celebrate our third leap year together with the mesmerising triple leap year dragon. Because the third time is the charm, right?
dragons.Goal: This dragon is quickly leaping to the top!

dragons.Name: Spectrapod
dragons.Description:
Spectrapod dragons live in underwater burrows where they spend most of their time. They come out on occasion to find sources of food and are really good at hide and seek, especially when they are seeking something that isn't really hiding. They can detect twelve color wavelengths, nine more than your average wizard. Try to imagine a color you can't even imagine. Now do that eight more times. That is how a spectrapod dragon sees you, as a thermonuclear bomb of light and beauty.

A spectrapod dragon has battering ram hands that they use to punch basically everything. They can deliver a blow with 1500 Newtons of force, which tells you what kind of weak punch a wizard must have. That punch is so powerful that even kaiju dragons can't handle it. Water moves out of the way so fast that little vacuums are formed, creating a shockwave of light and heat. Talk about a one hit wonder. Their limbs are so resilient in fact, that researchers have been studying their cellular structure for use in the development of sturdier dragon habitats.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is a living fossil of the prehistoric clown, that all modern clowns evolved from. Both beautiful and terrifying.

dragons.Name: Flickerflame
dragons.Description: The great researcher, professor Dravin spent numerous days observing the flickerflame dragons for his book The Origins of Dragons part III. But the opposing dual nature of this dragon confused him so much, that all he could come up with is that you will be hot and you will be cold, and you will literally be on fire in the presence of the flickerflame dragon.
dragons.Goal: This dragon's burning desire is to be on the top!

dragons.Name: Void
dragons.Description: Void dragons serve an important purpose in their own pocket of reality, namely, keeping the very fabric of time in check. And this very purpose is what has brought these sentinels of time here. Tracking Kairos all the way to the Vale to have him right the wrongs he has done to their cherished timeline. Expecting a fight, the void dragons were pleased to find him in a more than cooperative state. Kairos was already waiting for their arrival and was preparing to help them, he is the Dragon of Time, after all. Some void dragons have remained in the Vale since then, serving their new purpose as envoys from the Void. Envoids.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is creeping to the top!

dragons.Name: Woodvine
dragons.Description: While on the seemingly endless quest to fight boredom, the wizard Loracles decided to try out his thumbs in gardening. Secluded away in his tower he spent every waking hour going through countless scrolls and graphs, detailing the mystical Nipong art of dragonsai. Having gone through the texts more times than there are stairs in his tower, he was ready to tackle this newfound beast of a hobby. Now all that was left was to wait for the dragonsai trees to sprout and grow. As the days went on and anticipation grew, it was clear he was losing the battle against boredom. He knew he would either have to speed this up somehow or buy already grown dragonsai plants, and where is the fun in that? Quickly he sprung into action, concocting a potion that would hasten the plant's growth. He poured the first potion's contents into the pot and waited in silence to see what would happen. He was shocked to see that absolutely nothing happened. Frustrated by this failure, he tried again and again, potion after potion until the pot was overflowing with all kinds of chemicals, but sadly nothing seemed to work. Having exhausted himself and all of his options, he decided to hit the sack. The next morning he was met with a rude awakening as his tower was teeming with small bouncing tree-like critters. Worried they would devour his newly sprouted plants, he stormed to the workshop only to find that these critters are the plants themselves, come to life as woodvine dragons.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is slowly taking over the top!

dragons.Name: Clairvoyant
dragons.Description:
Clairvoyant dragons and their curious spheres have sparked a lot of interest in the Wizards. Despite their greatest efforts to study them, they have been unsuccessful in obtaining one, as the dragons and the spheres are inseparable from the moment they hatch. Could they be the source of the clairvoyant dragon's magic? A tool for interspecies communication? It may take years until we learn more and until then we can only marvel at the secrets of this dragon.
Then again the sphere could just be a chew toy.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is extraordinary, it has been foretold.

dragons.Name: Minchi
dragons.Description:
Evolution is a remarkable thing! A never-ending race to perfection and this dragon is one step closer. With the Wizards and other dragons catching on to the stoneshell's camouflage it was only a matter of time before evolution kicked in! The minchi dragon cleverly disguises itself as a cracked egg, not so much to avoid detection as much as to avoid interest in itself.
A fresh, seemingly abandoned egg is far more interesting to passersby than a broken mystery egg. And the lighter eggshell wings are a boon as well.
dragons.Goal: This dragon looks eggstraordinary on the top of the charts!

dragons.Name: Glyph
dragons.Description: One beautiful day, Kaleni was helping around with yet another Egg Hunt. The hunt was so eggxausting that he decided to take a quick nap onto something that looked like a comfy rock with some moss on it. You know, when you're tired even a rock looks good enough for a quick rest, don't judge! Few seconds into a light nap, and the rock behind Kaleni's back started moving! He promptly got up and started investigating the movement. And you know, curiosity killed the cat, but satisfaction brought it back - to his surprise that "rock" was actually a long lost monolith dragon. The Burcadian lore was full of stories about a special breed of dragons that are so lethargic that they curl up and sleep throughout the winter. This one seems to have gotten quite the snooze if moss and other stuff started growing on its back...
dragons.Goal: This dragon is going to break the top charts!

dragons.Name: Hedera
dragons.Description: Very few magics are more powerful than nature. This is best observed with our new findings of one very curious dragon, the wizards later discovered was part of the monolith family. More primal than its kin, this dragon is nature's masterpiece. Deemed the bully of winter, this dragon will be your personal bodyguard and will always love you. According to the Burcadian lore, its primary job is to keep the Vale from all things bad, including winter. It's said to be the bringer of spring. Since it was doing its job quite well, the Burcadians put ivy wreath on it, but with every good deed, a new leaf will appear, until one day they just started growing out of its skin. Don't let its size fool you though - the hedera monolith is as sweet as they come. And it looks like it hits the Burcadian gym often as well, amirite.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is creeping to the top!

dragons.Name: Pixie
dragons.Description: You thought the last pink monolith dragon is a crazy monolith color.... Check out this one! On first glance, it looks like pixie's first date was in a spring garden, but surely this wasn't the case. This dragon was recently discovered by the Burcadians, and they liked its looks so much, that even started believing it has magical powers. Everyone started putting flowers in close proximity to it, thinking it's working similar to a wishing well - you put a flower and your dream comes true. Well, I don't know about that, but surely the pink monolith brought the spring to the Vale! Magic or just normal passage of time - it's up to you to decide.
dragons.Goal: The top is covered in flowers and joy with this dragon!

dragons.Name: Vipera
dragons.Description: The vipera dragon appears untrustworthy, but looks can be deceiving. Many wizards often tend to stay away from it, but not because of its appearance. However, it is actually very sweet and kind in nature, little spicy sometimes and veeeery very clingy. It will give you a little peck on the cheek if you dare to get close enough, and soon after it uses “clinch location” to find you for more snuggles, just like its predecessors. Vipera kisses and best wishes to everyone in the Vale!
dragons.Goal: This dragon is coiling to the top!

dragons.Name: Swiftgrace
dragons.Description: In the Vale it is common belief that the swiftgrace dragons' magic comes from within and that its magical energies flow through its beautiful wings. Every flap of their wings sends waves of magic echoing through the air and every living thing. These waves are invisible to the naked eye but can be felt by those sensitive to their energies. This makes some of the more pessimistic wizards wonder - is the swiftgrace dragon a very powerful creature or is it just pleasant to look at.
dragons.Goal: This dragon adorns the top charts!

dragons.Name: Solis
dragons.Description: It is unclear how the solis dragon influences the Vale, but it is definitely the star of the show. Wizards and witches from distant places have tried to study it and figure out why it is so bright on the inside, but never found out as looking at it for too long makes your eyes water. Some theories claim that the solis dragon is responsible for the wonderful climate and weather in the Vale. Others speculate that someone gave it special magic potions that are very dangerous mixed together, but thanks to hydrostatic equilibrium it is safe to be around. So many wild theories, but no one ever considered that maybe it was just very hungry and swallowed a giant glowing ball.
dragons.Goal: A fiery ball from the sky is in your park now.

dragons.Name: Lunis
dragons.Description: Someone once told the Valers that the lunis dragon is a great companion - it just loves being around others. Its origin is unknown, but it's known to be a creature of the night. It has a side of it that shows only to its own kind, and deep inside hides the spark of life. Maybe if you get close enough to it, you might be able to see all of its beauty, but no one has ever done it, as it is kind enough on the eyes from afar.
dragons.Goal: Rise above and enjoy the moment! This dragon is the best companion for you.

dragons.Name: Stella
dragons.Description: Stella dragons are extremely stealthy, but only during the night. When darkness triumphs in the Vale, they often fly out and merge with the night sky thanks to their unique coloring. Their whole body is covered in beautiful sparkly stars on a clear summer sky, and that's a real pretty picture to look at. During the day though, things are different as these same sparkly bits are so bright that you wouldn't need a seriously-magically-tricked-out-telescope to catch a glimpse of their glimmer.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is such a stella-r phenomenon.

dragons.Name: Lightmatter
dragons.Description: Although the lightmatter dragon appears to disperse the rainbow over the Vale and be active during the day, it often interacts with its counterpart dragon - darkmatter. This creates a precedent as usually dark and light are allergic elements. Still, their love for each other is phenomenal.
dragons.Goal: The astronomancers did a better job at naming this one.

dragons.Name: Tranquil
dragons.Description: In the quiet and serene expanse of space countless stars exist. Countless more come into existence in the blink of an eye. And in a very time consuming process, they will also leave existence, to be scattered across space after their final phase. With a bit of magical knowhow and a pinch of luck, however, these stars can instead be reborn as proud and magestic tranquil dragons. Attracted by the cosmic and magical energies of the Vale, they have chosen to call it their new home.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is so peaceful, I could chill with it all aftermoon.

dragons.Name: Darkmatter
dragons.Description: The darkmatter dragon is believed to account for approximately 85 percent of the matter in the Vale. Though many have seen its beauty, some astronomancers are hesitant to admit its existence. But in the end, it doesn't really matter, does it.
dragons.Goal: A dragon out of space and time. And matter.

dragons.Name: Moriante
dragons.Description:
A tired moriante dragon was softly snoozing atop a large stone, when a loud thud woke it up. Alarmed by the sound, it decided to get up and have a look at what happened. It went to the edge of the stone and tried to push itself forward and fly away, but it instead leaped to the ground because its whole body was covered in some sort of sticky substance and the wings simply wouldn't move.


THE NIGHT BEFORE

The moriante dragon was taking a calm evening flight when it stumbled upon a circle of astronomancers having a party. They were singing, dancing and celebrating the longest day of the year, surrounded by endless barrels of sugary beanstalk juice. Even though it was getting late, the moriante dragon decided to join them and show everyone how it's done.

A crazy skillful wizard was in the middle of the circle dancing to the music coming from nearby, and that really caught the dragon's attention. The wizard stepped aside to give the moriante dragon a chance... Ever since it's hatched, the moriante dragon is said to be very peaceful and calm, but it adores dancing. But little did they know, due to its rather chubby appearance, it is not always as graceful as it thinks.

The more interesting movements the dragon made, the more the crowd was applauding. Few minutes into the dancing fiasco though, the dragon tried to gracefully walk towards the public, but tripped on its tail and fell right into the barrels full of juice. Many of them broke under the weight and the whole thing was pouring onto the ground, and soon, everyone was knee deep in beanstalk juice.

PRESENT DAY

The moriante dragon slightly blushed at the state of its body... Few astronomancers were cleaning the mess and carefully collecting the barrels pieces. It swiftly cleaned itself up and jumped to sweep all the wooden pieces together with its wings into a neat pile. While no one was looking, it quietly flew away without looking back, ashamed of last night's clumsy performance.
dragons.Goal: Don't judge a dragon by its colors.

dragons.Name: Grove
dragons.Description:
THAT NIGHT

The grove dragon was dragged to the party by its friends. It's not usually a party dragon (despite being very good friends with the party dragon), but after hearing it was an outdoor party, it happily agreed to go. The grove dragon loves nature and being outdoors. It wants everyone to go out and enjoy the beautiful nature, so you'll often see it trying to convince a group of friends to go do something outside or go explore somewhere. It is super chill, wise and connected with its environment. And doesn't take life too fast, so on the way to the party it would constantly stop and smell every flower the group passed by. By the time they reached the beach, the party was over, but the grove dragon was happy - it got to spend all evening surrounded by nature and shared that with its friends.
dragons.Goal: We should go camping sometime.

dragons.Name: Hanno
dragons.Description:
THAT NIGHT

The hanno dragon was invited to the party by multiple Valers, because of its interesting persona. It spent the whole day partying by the beach with a beverage in hand, jokingly teasing everyone around it and asking passers-by to dare it to do something weird. Later, it was observed in its natural habitat, walking a bit weird and swimming in the water like a pro. It doesn't fly, but as the wizards say, it's not a bird of paradise, but a dragon of paradise. When nighttime came, the hanno dragon finally met with the frond dragon that dared it to do a handstand. Everyone gathered in a circle around them and the show began. There was some teasing and taunting between the two but they gave it their best. Hanno claimed til the end it's gonna win, because frond couldn't do the handstand at all. In reality it just couldn't see well what was happening because of its haircut. It is still unclear who had won that day, as both insist they beat the other.
dragons.Goal: Cool story, bro.

dragons.Name: Oaris
dragons.Description:
THAT NIGHT

The oaris dragon isn't usually very social, but the night of the party it decided it's time to go and meet someone special. Wizards tell you that you should never meet your idols, but oaris really wanted to meet the dazzle dragon, who famously overcame its shyness. Oaris was also very shy in nature, very quiet and would prefer to hide behind a tree or stay at home, but the amazing performance that dazzle gave in the Colosseum inspired it to come out of its shell. When it approached dazzle, it saw it talking to razzle and, with its huge ears, overheard them discussing how this party is a little boring. Summoning all it's courage, oaris decided to speak up and suggest we take this party to the next level by givin' it the ol' razzle dazzle treatment. What proceeded can only be described as EPIC. Few hours later, oaris was still covering its head with wings, but was beaming with excitement that the party had livened up again thanks to it speaking up. But let's not burst some dragons' bubbles by telling them they imagined the whole conversation.
dragons.Goal: They have such big ears so they can hear you better.

dragons.Name: Delicia
dragons.Description:
THAT NIGHT

The delicia dragon lived very close to the beach party, but still came in late because it spent a lot of time making itself prettier and preparing to look its best. When it arrived, an epic dance off was happening, and it decided to sign up. Delicia dragons are known for their beauty inside and out, with valuable personality traits, such as kindness, compassion, optimism, sympathy and confidence. When the time came, the delicia dragon was called on the stage and faced its opponent. Loud music started playing, the crowd was cheering, and some very interesting dancing was happening. The delicia dragon was on fire, dancing like crazy and the more intricate moves it did, more eyes were glued to it. It was having the best performance of its life. But the reason why so many were looking at it was because it was just flailing its wings and tail around and twirling all over the place. It still won, though.
dragons.Goal: Turn up the music and watch them spring into action.

dragons.Name: Exandrew
dragons.Description:
Class - Exandrew Dragon
Background - orange
Experience points - yes, please
Strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, charisma - occasionally
Personality traits - shy, clumsy
Family history - veeeery distant relative to tiamat and bahamut. But like so distant that it doesn't even count
Likes to - disguise self and sneak attack
Loves to - roll for initiative
Best at - comprehending languages


THAT NIGHT

The exandrew dragon was being what it would describe as extremely sneaky. It was hiding behind some bushes that most of the time were way too small, and was spying on Tiamat and Bahamut. They're distantly related, but exandrew was so behind on things and wanted to absorb some of the mythic dragons' manners. It would try to fly majestically in the sky, but would often fall and try to act like nothing happened. It would also go as far as painting the same dice pattern on its wings. The mythic dragons acknowledged its presence at some point and handed it a cup of nectar at the party. To this day, exandrew would go around and tell the story of how it partied hard with Tiamat and Bahamut, which was a tiny bit away from what actually happened.
dragons.Goal: Biggest fan of Tiamat and Bahamut.

dragons.Name: Flowerhop
dragons.Description: As per tradition every year a bunch of nature loving wizards would go up to the Lavarza lake to celebrate the Summer Solstice. This little gathering often gets out of hand and some even spend weeks there, enjoying the nature, drinking up on that sweet sweet nectar and dancing around until sunrise. Everyone enjoyed going there because of the gorgeous flower-covered meadow and because it was just the perfect opportunity for a light physical activity after the long winter days. This year was no exception to the tradition, and a bunch of wizards headed towards the lake, but when they arrived an unusual picture unravelled before their eyes. The meadow with the flowers was looking very different. The grass was completely crushed, the flower stems broken in half, the bushes dried out without a single berry on them…. The wizards couldn't believe their eyes as this was the territory of the flowerhop dragons, and they were usually taking extremely good care of the surrounding nature. It didn't take the wizards too much time to figure out what had happened, as they quickly focused on an oval flowerhop dragon laying under a now receding bush of zazzberries and eating with delight. Flowerhop dragons had a sweet tooth for zazzberies and started consuming them in enormous quantity this past year. Soon enough when they tried to hop onto the flowers, the stems would just break in half under the weight which resulted in a chonky dragon rolling down the meadow. Hopefully these wizards will help them out a bit, because otherwise we will have to go out and discover a treehop dragon…
dragons.Goal: This dragon is buzzing to the top!

dragons.Name: Tebori
dragons.Description:
THAT NIGHT

The tebori dragon is fond of many things, but it especially likes being on the beach during a hot sunny day. So, when the wizard that discovered it, Donlo, invited it to the party, tebori didn't even hesitate for a second. Tebori was fairly new to the Vale and upon arrival it got many double takes, but only because everyone was mesmerised by the beautiful patterns on its body. Some wizards speculate these are powerful spells written in tebori's native language, others claim it's a map to a different Vale. No one dared to ask what they were though. As the night progressed, everyone was enjoying themselves, but tebori was keeping its distance, as it was feeling a bit down because of all the looks it got at the start. That was until the chromacorn dragon arrived and went straight to it to say ""Hi"". Both friends ended up catching up for lost time and having fun all evening at the beach. No one was looking at their direction anymore, which is a pity because they looked so perfect standing there together.
dragons.Goal: Dude! This dragon is so cool!

dragons.Name: Alffa
dragons.Description:
THE OTHER NIGHT

The alffa dragon was sitting on a log bench in front of the fire and was listening to the stories of its friends. Its age is unknown, but wizards guess it's been around for quite some time. Its interesting name doesn't stand for leadership, but for wisdom and timelessness. Many would look up to it and ask for advice on different occasions, because this dragon is said to be all-seeing. There isn't a single Valer, witch or wizard it doesn't know or hasn't heard of. For that reason everyone loved it and invited it to multiple different gatherings. And that night was no exception. Alffa met with its friends oaris, exandrew, hanno, grove, delicia and tebori on the beach and they ended up chatting all evening. They met up on the same beach last year's party was, so they can all talk fondly about their sweet Memories of Paradise.

The alffa dragon didn't speak much at first, but was patiently listening to its friends' stories. One by one, all of them shared their most amazing memory of the night of the party, and when everyone turned to alffa dragon to ask for its best memory, it just let out a small laugh. As it was all-seeing and witnessed everything that happened that night, it started explaining that not everything happened as they remembered it. First turning to oaris dragon, alffa explained that the big party was already being planned and it never approached razzle and dazzle for a talk. Then, turning to exandrew dragon - the mythic dragons turned its direction because of the loud thud that followed one of his attempts to fly. Hanno's hair prevented it from seeing how good frond's handstand was. Grove's friends were a little bit annoyed with how slow it was moving. Delicia's dance was not as good as it remembered it. And tebori - everyone was looking at it, not because it was different, but because they were in awe of the beautiful patterns. Still, everyone had a great time that night and even the other night, and some new memories of paradise were created.
dragons.Goal: What ancient secrets can we learn from this wise dragon?

dragons.Name: Mylio
dragons.Description:
Everyone in the Vale knows that if you're feeling a little down, you go to the Oreze lake where some mylio dragons live. Despite their gloomy appearance, their favourite thing to do is make you laugh. All you have to do is just put a nice little picnic blanket on the grass next to the lake and watch. You will see a mylio dragon's weird, but rather funny, mixture of dancing, acrobatics and other movements that no wizard can do. Shortly after, a wave of calmness and serenity (and maybe some splashed lake water) will embrace you. Surely, mylio dragons would give great calming hugs. But they don't have any limbs. Sadly.
P.S. Oh, and it's pronounced ""my lee oh"".
dragons.Goal: A (manta) ray of sunshine!

dragons.Name: Combustion
dragons.Description: There's a rumor that the combustion dragon had a heated argument with the air dragon, but that's not confirmed. A wizard went to its best buddy - the heat dragon - to ask what the combustion dragon is like. And for an hour, heat couldn't stop explaining how warm and good of a dragon combustion is. Let's take its word for it, as getting close to any of these dragons is not recommended.
dragons.Goal: Look at the steam coming out of it!

dragons.Name: Gryphus
dragons.Description: A tale as old as the Vale claims that the gryphus dragons posses an invaluable treasure. Another suggests that the gryphus dragons have the largest library in the centre of their lair, that's said to contain the answer to everything Vale. To settle the disagreement between the two claims, the bravest of the Valers decided to go and see for themselves. Days and days of venturing into a deep valley passed, and our adventurers happened upon several gryphus dragons sleeping quite soundly. In the middle there was an enormous pile of what looked to be letters and parcels. Little did our Valers know, the gryphus kind were once trusted messengers, with maybe not so great habit of keeping their charge for themselves. Thus, the legend of a vast hoard of knowledge was born. Technically, it still is a source of information, just not the kind everyone thought of.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is flying to the top!

dragons.Name: Pouke
dragons.Description: Just as the weather starts getting warmer is the perfect time to go to the river meadow and have a lovely picnic or even a camping trip. But if you notice a few items missing or misplaced, do not be afraid. That is simply the doing of the pouke dragon. This mischievous dragon likes to play small pranks on visitors, but that only means that it likes you, and that is its way of showing it.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is flying to the top!

dragons.Name: Woven
dragons.Description: Every witch and wizard was preparing for the ninth anniversary of the Vale. Everyone had a different task, and Kliff Moore volunteered to go collect some Dragon Treats. While looking for blushrooms the morning of the celebration, he heard an unusual sound coming from behind the nearest bush. He walked slowly to it and slowly moved its branches to uncover a bunch of playful woven dragons. No one has ever seen them before, which is weird considering how strange of a sound they make when moving. But now, they're a preferred company in the Vale, because of their personality. They're so transparent that you can see right through them. But in a good sense, of course.
dragons.Goal: There's always loom for more.

dragons.Name: Atramento
dragons.Description: The Motto of the House of the Hidden Bolt is "Sparking Curiosity". And atramento looks like a curious dragon, don't you think? So curious that it went on an adventure to another dimension or used its brilliant hiding skills to win some games of hide and seek. Either or, we don't really know, but if asked maybe it will share its tail. Um, tale.
dragons.Goal: Just a smudge of color!

dragons.Name: Coldcoil
dragons.Description: Motto of the House of the Icy Torrent: "We Do Not Sink". And with the new addition to the house, the coldcoil dragon, we can safely add "We Do Not Stop If An Opportunity For Dragon Treats Is Presented" to the motto. Long story short, a group of magicfolk were quietly admiring their beautiful garden full of Zazzberries, when they noticed something sneaking out of the nearby lake. They went closer to inspect only to find a large shell on the ground, but didn't think much of it. Until the shell grew legs. And headed towards the nearest Zazzberry bush.
dragons.Goal: You are very spe-shell to this dragon!

dragons.Name: Apex
dragons.Description: The apex dragon might not exactly be "Strong and Shining", but it is without a doubt a great addition to the Mountain Sun house. And that is exactly why it was chosen to represent its house on Camp DragonVale. It is not as calm as its distant cousin, the mountain dragon, but since it also lives in a very peaceful environment, wizards say it's pretty... chill.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is always on top of things!

dragons.Name: Frons
dragons.Description:
In old school style, frons is the answer to yet another riddle in the House of the Iron Blossom:

What is thin and flat,
Can sometimes be in unusual format,
Is light as a feather, but is metal,
And it's not very mettle?

Oh, and it used to look quite different.
dragons.Goal: This dragon be-leaves in you!

dragons.Name: Ignis
dragons.Description: We all know the motto of the House of the Blazing Gale: "Unscorched, Untethered, Untroubled" and how the blazing gale dragon is usually unbothered by Pi Roh's poor attempts for a beautiful firework shows. Unbothered, but loves to crash and over-shine them. Well, did you know that ignis dragon was the one to fire up blazing gale's desire to show off like this? So, which one was the first to come - blazing gale or ignis? Or was it the egg or the chicken? We can't remember...
dragons.Goal: This dragon will warm your heart!

dragons.Name: Scout
dragons.Description: For many many years Camp Dragonvale has been a place that all young dragons and wizards can go to test themselves and more importantly - form friendships. Under the watchful eye of the scout dragon, the counselor of the camp, they learn and grow together. The scout, once a young volunteer, has been a part of the camp for so long, that they are now almost as one. The fire head keeps the camp fires going for the young adventurers, and the ice head keeps all the beverages cool and refreshing so that its campers never need anything. Pretty cool, right?
dragons.Goal: This dragon will make you do a good turn daily.

dragons.Name: Whimsical
dragons.Description: With their cute buggy eyes and fuzzy hides, whimsical dragons have found their way to the hearts of many valers. Some claim it is a sign of good fortune when they rub up against you. Either that or it leaves valers with such joy, that they simply stop noticing small mishaps and misfortunes. Oh, and head scratches are their favorite.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will eat your homework.

dragons.Name: Soriak
dragons.Description: On his travels through time and space, Kairos stumbled upon a familiar looking whelpling, the runt of its spawn. Sharing many similarities with Kairos, it reminded him of his youth and he quickly grew to adore the little one. Not wanting to leave the whelpling to the whims of fate, Kairos saved it from its timeline and brought it to the Vale, handing it over to the Wizards to be looked after. They were disappointed to see it did not share any of Kairos' time warping abilities, but he still loves the soriak dragon, his little brother from another broodmother.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will make you look back with a smile.

dragons.Name: Maw
dragons.Description: Superstitious Valers believe these dragons to be ancient deities of feasts and prosperity, while others just see them as rampant gluttons. So when you hear a knock on your door on Halloween, you best hope it's not a maw dragon, one handful of candy is never enough for their insatiable appetite. With their monstrous mouths and massive teeth, they can gnaw through buckets of candy without a care in the world. Some valers have gone as far as to have special containers next to their doorstep just for that - buckets of candy for this scenario labeled with the text "Break in case of maw dragons!".
dragons.Goal: This dragon will devour all your candy!

dragons.Name: Malefice
dragons.Description: Not originally from the Vale, these dragons made their way here accompanied by a caravan of travelling Wizards and Merchants from faraway lands. Intrigued by their unsettling look, our Wizards inquired about the nature of these insectoid dragons. Their hair stood up when the travelers spoke the dragon's name... malefice. Not to appear like cowardly fools in front of their visitors, our Wizards struck a deal with them to keep some malefice dragons at the Vale. Now these dragons roam around freely, probably plotting the doom of the Vale and rubbing their claw thingies together.. menacingly.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will put one leg in front of the other five.

dragons.Name: Gatren
dragons.Description: For a long time Wizards believed the gatren dragons to be very old, long-lived or perhaps even ancient dragons, who had been slumbering in the cave systems of the Vale for years at a time. The stalagmites on their backs take ages to form and in order for that to happen, they would have had to be standing still for a very long time. Until one day, a baby gatren emerged from the caves, with its very own baby-stalagmite formation. This opened a whole new can of cave worms for the Wizards. Do gatren dragons age very slowly in the dark, are these just spinal growths serving as a form of crude camouflage or a means of communication via echolocation?
dragons.Goal: This dragon is pretty patient.

dragons.Name: Kwall
dragons.Description:
The Haunted Harvest begins!

Knowing what shenanigans his questionable decor might unleash when the Harvest begins, Whitbee and the other Wizards barricaded the blue portal he had made. They took shifts monitoring it to make sure no more horrific dragons come pouring out into the Vale. One day, as Whitbee stood watch, a knocking on the barricade was heard...from the inside of the portal. Unsure if it was real or just his imagination, Whitbee knocked on it himself, hoping nothing would reply. Instead of the silence he was hoping for, what he got in response was much worse, the portal began sparkling and the planks started violently shaking as something was trying to brute force its way through to his side. He quickly sounded the alarm and all the other Wizards rushed in, they turned over whatever furniture they could and took cover behind it, wands aimed at the portal ready for whatever it is that comes out. After a few minutes, the planks could no longer hold the beast and it made its way through. Much to their relief, it wasn't the eldritch horror or doom bringer they were expecting. Instead, it was this cute, bulbous, innocent looking bundle of ectoplasm. Sure, some of its inner workings should not be visible to the naked eye but when it stuck its tongue out like a puppy, they decided to let it stay. Kwall, they named it, after the sound Lumi made when she first saw it. Had this whole ordeal happened at night, however, this would have been an entirely different story.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will see-through any lie.

dragons.Name: Wendigo
dragons.Description:
The Haunted Harvest trick or eating!

After kwall's spooktacular entrance through Whitbee's portal, the Wizards decided not to repair the barricade on the portal, but still keep a watchful eye on it. This time the portal began sparkling at dawn and the Wizard who was there all but expected another cutesy dragon to pop out. Instead, what came out, might as well have come out of somebody's darkest nightmare. A ferocious, hunched over beast that looked as if it had just fought death itself..and won. The dragon, with an eerie glow in its eyes, started thrashing around, knocking over barricades and furniture with intense rage and fervor. Gardenia was alone on watch and did her best to stay out of harm's way until backup arrived. She threw a few treats its way as distraction but the dragon paid no attention to them. It hadn't come looking for treats, and this was no mere trick. When the others arrived, the sun had just risen and they were baffled as to why Gardenia would sound the alarm and hide in fear over such a cute and fuzzy dragon, even its horns look like candy canes. When she came out of hiding she could not believe her eyes, the horrific beast that was rampaging moments ago was now nomming on the treats she threw at it earlier. In a panic she quickly described how just moments ago it looked entirely different and was ramming and smashing everything trying to catch her. They scoffed and joked about her having to catch some sleep instead.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will scare your troubles away!

dragons.Name: Ocular
dragons.Description:
The ocular dragons are born with a singular eye that sees not only color, but allows it to see through the most convincing of illusions, past the most concealing of spells and through the most broken of timelines. The spectrum of colors ocular dragons can see is incomprehensible, but if you can imagine a color you have never seen before, that would be it. And that... is what the ocular dragon sees.
But, as you can imagine, having one eye hinders their depth-perception, and that is where the spiky protrusions on their bodies come into play. If they slam into something, it might be painful, but nowhere near as much as it would be for whatever they ran into.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will see your point.

dragons.Name: Iden
dragons.Description:
The Haunted Harvest really takes off!

After the last portal breach, the Wizards decided to still keep it open but to install barricades around the perimeter of the portal. That way they would be able to see what comes in and decide on whether or not to let it stay. The portal started sparkling again and everyone was there this day, aiming their wands at the portal and waiting in bated breath to see what would make its way through. The dragon that came in was white and fluffy, almost like it was riding in on a cloud or pillow of feathers. It had a quick look around and simply flew over the barricade the Wizards had prepared for its arrival and escaped. All that hard work and anticipation just to have it fly over them. The other two dragons that had arrived either made no attempt to fly away or simply couldn't, no one saw this coming. Gardenia had had enough of Whitbee's portal bafoonery, threw her wand at him and stormed out. Later that day she found where the new arrival went after making its escape, straight to the other two of course. They were all playing and jumping together cheerfully, this put a smile on Gardenia's face. In a sigh of relief she thought maybe it wouldn't be so bad having them around for Harvest... as long as the sun never goes down again. Who knows what the new dragon has hidden in store for them for when night falls, hence the name - iden.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will mess up your hair.

dragons.Name: Nox
dragons.Description: Gwyddion's Field Notes on Dragons of the Rift: "I am the first of the Wizards to bear witness to this paradoxical specimen. This dragon grows horns from a very early age, probably to stop it from floating away, as many things in the Rift have a tendency to do. Its body appears to be made up entirely of some sort of Rift energy, as it frequently disappears into what can be described as a self-made portal, which likely leads to an unidentified location somewhere else in the Rift. Need to study this.. nox dragon further"
dragons.Goal: This dragon will vanish into thin air.

dragons.Name: Neyvee
dragons.Description: These dragons are perfectly built for fishing, with their hydrodynamic bodies, as well as flippers and tiny wings to help them maneuver and propel themselves through the water. Neyvee dragons can catch hundreds of fish together, and there are very few other fishermen or anglers that can compete with them in the open waters. On land there aren't as many fish as you can imagine, so there their mobility is not as essential and is limited to bouncing on their bellies and attempts to lift themselves off the ground with their tiny wings. But they likely do that just to get to the last few fallen crumbs of dragon fruit cake that are stuck under them.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is bouncing with joy.

dragons.Name: Longcicle
dragons.Description: Wandering the highest mountains and the coldest peaks, these dragons like to play in the snow and to sleep on pointy mountain tops and spires by coiling their bodies around them. They only make their way to the Vale when the winter comes along, and some see them as welcomed guests, and others as a menace. You see, there aren't many mountain tops down in the Vale, so when all the tall planters are taken and the lamp posts are too bright to sleep under, the longcicle dragons often turn to one obvious alternative; the chimneys on the Wizards' rooftops. Sure it might look cute on the neighbor's roof, but when you start hearing snoring and creaking directly from above, you might consider those new Igloo alternatives everyone has been on about.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is coiled to spring into action.

dragons.Name: Lyuba
dragons.Description: These dragons were first brought to the Vale by the Wizard Koody, from the faraway frozen wastelands of Seebear, where there are lots of.. well, bears and other creatures adapted to the cold climate. Koody was out and about looking for the best spot to set up camp, for he wanted to observe the aurora borealis. He was told that at this time of year, this time of day, localized in Seebear, he would be able to see it. With his camp set and fire lit, he sat back and looked up to the night sky to enjoy the spectacle. He had heard stories of how beautiful it was but no one ever mentioned it would make sounds similar to that of a dragon breathing and yawning. Realizing what was actually making the noise, he turned towards the source and saw a little baby lyuba dragon that had gotten lost from its herd, and had cuddled next to his fire. His heart melted at the sight and made himself a promise, that he would help with finding its herd the next day. The lyuba dragons were so happy to see Koody returning the calf, that they welcomed him into the herd, which eventually led them to the Vale.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is pals with the grove dragons.

dragons.Name: Ketu
dragons.Description: Out in the cold tundral wilderness, the Wizard Atten Burrow was looking for the elusive ketu dragons. He had tried everything to lure them out, from mimicking their calls with magical items, to trying to bait them out with illusions, and everything in between. He had seen only mere glimpses of them, they were either too fast for him or he would somehow alert and scare them away. One night at his camp, Atten thought he would try out these "Iceberries" everyone was talking about, only to grimace like a child eating a sarjin pepper before throwing them into the distance. He went to bed frustrated and hungry that night, but he awoke to a pleasant surprise. Several ketu dragons had found the Iceberries he threw away and were looking around for more. Lucky for him, he had plenty of those to go around, and soon, the ketu dragons were around him like starwing dragons to a lamp.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is showing off its bushy tail.

dragons.Name: Snowball
dragons.Description: One day, two little Wizzlings were greatly enjoying the Winter season and the abundance of snow, and they had done everything there was to do: snow angels, snowmen, fortresses, you name it. The two best friends sat down together to think of what to do next. One of them had the idea of building their own snow dragon-friend and both jumped with excitement to gather all the twigs, rocks, snow and coal they could get their hands on. Once it was complete, with a bit of wizardry they animated the snow sculpture and there before them stood their new dragon-friend, who they decided to name Snowball. With the spell being done by novices, the snow would start melting to slush during the day, but there was plenty of snow around for it to eat and get back into shape at night.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will blend in with the snow.

dragons.Name: Yanghis
dragons.Description: If Pi Roh couldn't pull off a firework show so beautiful that it would blow everyone's minds, he would instead bring a dragon that could. Introducing.. the yanghis dragons. Less showy-offy and more hissy-clawy than their relatives - the ignis dragons. They are constantly together, as if inseparable and in constant synergy, one would think they are two halves of the same entity.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will pop all the balloons at the party.

dragons.Name: Yeti
dragons.Description: A group of exploring Wizards had stumbled upon a cave that was said to be inhabited by a yeti dragon, and ventured deep into the cave system. One of the novices had to reignite their torch soon after, and by accident conjured a fireball instead of a spark, sending it flying far into the cave. The group waited for the fireball to land before proceeding, but instead of the fireball landing, what they heard was the sound of the eldest Wizard slapping the novice by the neck. Further down they started to smell something strange, something like burnt hair. By the time the realization hit them, one of the Wizards had bumped into something steady and fuzzy in the darkness. Looking up they saw a yawning yeti dragon, towering above them with charred brows and hair. The lonely dragon, thrilled to see it had visitors, smiled from horn to horn, exposing a big toothy grin. Thinking it was about to turn them into tonight's meal, the Wizards quickly dropped everything and ran to the exit, arms flailing in the air. Still sleepy, the yeti dragon went after its new friends to hug and play with them. These dragons had adapted perfectly to their environment, thick fur to keep them warm, strength to push over boulders and snow out of their way, and they had no need for wings in these tight spaces so it was quickly catching up to them. The eldest Wizard hastily conjured a teleportation spell to get them out of there, sending them all directly back to the Vale. They only had a second to celebrate and cheer when they realized, the teleportation spell that supposedly saved them also took the yeti with them to the Vale, which gave them all a group hug with a smug smile on its face.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will make you icecream.

dragons.Name: Angler
dragons.Description: The angler dragons are most active during the early hours of the day, when there is little to no noise and nuisances, and as a result they have remained largely undiscovered by the Wizards of the Vale, who like to sleep in a few extra hours. They use their hooked tails to catch fish, even in the cold of winter they saw holes through the thick ice sheet, allowing them to continue fishing. The dragons will move away from their fishing spot as soon as someone approaches them, not because they are scared, but because the noise of their uninvited visitor will likely scare away any potential catch.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is a master on the grill.

dragons.Name: Canna
dragons.Description: A characteristic of the canna dragons is that they always appear like they are in a hurry. Due to their rather chubby physique though, they aren't that fast. That was concluded by the great wizard Kojntas after studying them for centuries. He also discovered that they have evolved to use their tail as a makeshift boat to get to places faster, also with the help of a random stick. Too bad they lose it from time to time. That's probably the reason why even after this super cool evolution they are still pretty much stuck in the same place.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is rowing to the top!

dragons.Name: Murano
dragons.Description: Taking inspiration from the Butterfly Pavilion's magic-imbued stained glass, the wizards set out to try other enchantments on the glass. Light imbued glass simply made the interior way too bright, and the water imbuement simply made all the glass drip to the floor. It is when living flame was used on the glass that the murano dragon came to be, as the glass started to melt in a bright flash of light, making everyone turn their gaze away. When the light dimmed down, they were shocked to see that imbuing the glass with living flame had actually turned it into a living dragon.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is not to be clowned with!

dragons.Name: Scuttle
dragons.Description:
Another dragon made manifest after an attempt to conjure an oceanic island in the sky.
The group of wizards and witches responsible for these experiments is believed to be a branch of Icy Torrent. And while their methods and identity remain unknown, their goal is as clear as ice - bring the beauty of the oceans below, to the skies above. Regardless, the scuttle dragons are cute and harmless, preferring to scuttle away from any inconveniences they find themselves in. Curiously, they are one of wizard-chef Ramsee's favorite dragons.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is past all of this.

dragons.Name: Giddle
dragons.Description: The giddle dragons love to prank wizards whenever presents are being exchanged, regardless of the occasion. Unattended presents quickly becomes snacks, as they devour the contents and hide in ambush inside the boxes. Later, when the wizards open their gift, instead they find a cuddly dragon blowing raspberries in their face and running off giggling.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is such a present!

dragons.Name: Grace
dragons.Description: Elegant swimmers and gentle creatures, the grace dragons can make any pool of water seem serene. While one head eats, the other keeps a watchful eye. While one head sleeps, the other stands vigil. While Tolzar dangles the keys to one of his contraptions, both heads follow as if hypnotized.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is twice as cute!

dragons.Name: Entwined
dragons.Description: While researching these dragons, there was a great debate amongst the wizards if they should be categorized separately. Attempts to separate the entwined dragons by force have left many wizards with charred eyebrows, and clever use of magic has made both dragons sad and lonely after spending time apart from their partner. The dispute was then quickly ended, as they appear to be seemingly inseparable, since they find partners as soon as they hatch, with their tails and fates forever entwined.
dragons.Goal: These dragons are together forever!

dragons.Name: Masque
dragons.Description: Always there to steal the show at a party, the masque dragon flaunts and struts its way into the spotlight. Everyone cheering and clapping, thinking this is just another dragon in a fancy costume, but they don't know that the fancy costume itself is the dragon. Another glittery mystery for the researchers - who is behind the masque?
dragons.Goal: This dragon is a showstopper!

dragons.Name: Canvas
dragons.Description: With their ever-changing coat, the canvas dragons have caught the attention of the more artsy wizards. Many are envious of the skill and finesse they show with their brush-like tails, but what exactly they use to paint on themselves is still a mystery. Are chemicals released that create beautiful colors when mixed together, or does the tail somehow triggers pigment-carrying cells in their skin? We don't know, but they sure love to show off their masterpieces.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is hot on the top of the charts!

dragons.Name: Magnolia
dragons.Description: It is widely known that magnolia dragons come from a very big and ancient, and especially difficult to pronounce family. There are scrolls reporting sightings even before the discovery of busby and flowerhop dragons. We guess they must have hid very well until now, because it's really hard to miss their huge, fluffy, pink tails.
dragons.Goal: Just some-bud-y to love.

dragons.Name: Peoni
dragons.Description: The peoni dragons are likely distant relatives of the giddles, and they also love to play tricks on other dragons and Valers. They take a deep breath and jump in the water, letting the beautiful peony-like blossom on their backs float above them. When anyone or anything comes near to have a whiff of the innocent looking flower, they suddenly jump out, giving them a good scare. Most of the time, however, they give themselves away by having fits of laughter from the anticipation, sending bubbles to the water's surface.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is the peoni one for you!

dragons.Name: Wolper
dragons.Description:
With a hip and a hop, in the Vale the wolper dragons decided to stop.
They wave at others to say hi, and they flap their ears to fly high in the sky.
It is either colorful flowers or eggs they are after, and with their arrival they bring joy and laughter.
How they came to be - nobody knows, too fast to catch and study I suppose.
dragons.Goal: Hip to the hop to the top!

dragons.Name: Snooz
dragons.Description: The snooz dragons had gone unnoticed for a very long time, hiding above plain sight. They float high in the sky napping on their soft, cloud-like tails, remaining unbothered by the commotion down in the Vale. That is until one day Tolzar flew his Optical Oracle high above the clouds. On the way back down he snagged one of the clouds and slowly dragged it behind him all the way down to the Vale. When they landed, the dragon woke up with a mighty yawn and looked around confused at its unfamiliar surroundings. Thinking it was just a dream, it went back to sleep. Much to its surprise, the dragon slept incredibly well with the soothing sounds of chirping birds and running water. So well in fact, that it opted to stay in the Vale.
dragons.Goal: This is dragon is Zzz...

dragons.Name: Narcis
dragons.Description: The narcis dragons spend far too much time looking at themselves in the reflections of their tails. They often walk around entranced by their own mirror image, bumping left and right into dragons and buildings. Legend says sometimes they stare so intensely at their tails, that their reflections start moving as if with a mind of their own. Until the sun goes down, and they can no longer be seen.
dragons.Goal: It's not always all about appearance.

dragons.Name: Kroki
