dragons.Description: Kroki dragons sport these glowing vines that are not only aesthetically pleasing, but also function as a way to attract insects. To keep them lit, however, they must eat a lot of fireflies. Luckily, they are perfectly built just for that, buzzing around catching everything in sight. And no, their eyes aren't big because an ancestor was spooked by a loud BOOM or anything like that, it just helps with insects.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has big eyes the better to see you with!

dragons.Name: Dargon
dragons.Description: Dragon dragons, uhm I mean dARgon dragons are very special. They seem all sweet and cute, but they're no joke. Seriously, get close and see for yourself.
dragons.Goal: Perfect addition to your park!

dragons.Name: Florea
dragons.Description: Caregivers by nature, the florea dragons look up to Gaia and will selflessly do whatever they can to aid the Vale. They move around quickly and energetically, attending to things that a Legendary Dragon might not have the time to, like cozying up the nests of other dragons and making sure their eggs don't roll out. And most important of all, making sure those pesky visitors keep their hands to themselves and don't go around touching what they aren't supposed to! It is with pride and joy that they carry out their duty, doing the best they can to follow in their idol's steps. Their task isn't as grand as Gaia's, and we cannot expect a small dragon to fill boots that big, but a small dragon can have a very large heart.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is of great help to the Vale!

dragons.Name: Fushi
dragons.Description: Spring brings not only a pleasant change in the weather, but also a change in the whole scenery. Everything is greener, with soothing sounds and smells filling the air. On such a morning exactly, Gerhadr woke up in a great mood and had the perfect idea - to create a magnificent and colorful dragon companion. After trying the whole day to blend different types of herbs, plants and other unknown substances, and with each attempt being somehow less successful than the last, he threw everything in an old planter in frustration, promising himself to clean it up in the morning. However, the next morning he was awoken not by the pleasant sounds of chirping, but by a loud thud, so he quickly jumped out of bed to investigate. He hurried to the room where he experimented the previous day and noticed the planter he was planning on throwing away was gone. He wondered for a moment if he misplaced it without remembering, but upon closer inspection found it shattered on the ground. And the reason for it - a fushi dragon. A dragon created from a bunch of random ingredients put in a bit of dirt overnight. You might think it's a recipe for disaster, but that fushi dragon rolling in the dirt with such joy surely can't be trouble. R-right?
dragons.Goal: This dragon is the best companion!

dragons.Name: Glasswing
dragons.Description: The pretty glasswing dragons awe and inspire Wizards and Valers alike, with visitors coming from far off islands just for a chance to observe and paint them. Artists often end up running out of materials before they can finish, however. Either because the dragons are so very colorful, or because everyone spends so much time looking at them, that all the paint just dries up.
dragons.Goal: Stay glassy!

dragons.Name: Davinese
dragons.Description: Always coming up with new gadgets and inventions, Tolzar's well of innovations eventually ran dry, so he sought out to find new inspirations. While taking a stroll through the Vale, many new ideas came to his mind. Some were nice, but some were stale, so they were left behind. Only one idea would stay, when he saw a group of dragons play. A bunch of davinese dragons were having tons of fun with another group, jumping around and running about, but could not follow their friends high in the sky, to hang out with those that could fly. Tolzar immediately got busy and fashioned a harness, one with wings that gave them flight. He watched with joy as the davinese dragons joined the others in the clouds, flying far out of sight.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is soaring!

dragons.Name: Fluffles
dragons.Description: These dragons give off immense cuteness and cuddliness, that surprisingly isn't lost when they grow up. Wizards and wizzlings alike can barely resist hugging them on sight. Just be careful not to get any of your hair stuck on them, that would be rather unfortunate.
dragons.Goal: This dragon likes to stick to a plan(t)!

dragons.Name: Undau
dragons.Description: Some wizards call these dragons undau collectively, others choose to call one head Un, the other Dau. Some call them the opposite. Either way, two heads will always be better than one, and most definitely better than none. Undau dragon's heads form deep bonds, perhaps closer than those of siblings. And they may not share the same brain, but they definitely share the same stomach, and this becomes evident as soon as they start eating, or rather.. devouring. No relation to scouts.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here in stereo!

dragons.Name: Lunk
dragons.Description: Having to rely on their hands and tails to move around, by the time these dragons grow up, they have built up immense strength. So much so, that some wizards have even documented them in a study called "Lunk dragons: Pumping Metal". If you ever need a hand or two moving a house, these dragons are the ones to call. Just don't bring a unicycle, drives them mad.
dragons.Goal: This dragon can lift a habitat!

dragons.Name: Brizoni
dragons.Description: Feeling right at home beneath that stone, brizoni dragons pick, shape and carry boulders from a very early age. Smoothing and evening them out over time. When the dragons grow, so must their boulder, making the process of picking and shaping start over again. It's not clear why they do this but some have even learned to balance themselves on their boulders. When brizoni dragons play, they always carry their team to victory.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to rock and roll!

dragons.Name: Binky
dragons.Description: Always there to liven up the party and brighten up the mood, binky dragons are often invited to wizzling birthday parties. You may have to get a spare birthday cake, because it may end being juggled and gobbled up along with its orbs. They think they are very cheeky and nobody sees them do it, but it's just that wizards let it slide, they've earned it. Give their flower a whiff, I dare you.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to entertain!

dragons.Name: Fuefuego
dragons.Description: Fuefuego dragons show incredible talent and prowess in acrobatics from the very moment they hatch. Jumping and rolling around the place like pinballs. This was quickly noticed by the wizard Havel Canevel, who took it upon himself to train them to even greater heights, performing head-spinning spins and intricate tricks. He still hasn't managed to teach them how not to leave trails of soot on the carpet.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to jump hoops!

dragons.Name: Lageto
dragons.Description: Attending the circus and enjoying the show, the Wizards Benson and Jerram thought they had enough of the salty popcorn and wanted something sweet for a change. So they went out in search of ice cream, excitedly sharing what flavors they would get, how many scoops they would eat and how many sprinkles they would...sprinkle on them. "-Sprinkles?!" One of them exclaimed, disgusted at the mere thought of putting that stuff on his favorite dessert. The two Wizards instantly started arguing, which way is "right". Seeing the argument is going nowhere, they came up with an idea - they would let their companion lageto dragon decide for them. The dragon would be blindfolded and two giant buckets of ice cream would be presented, one with sprinkles on top, and one without. Thinking it would just pick one and devour it, proving once and for all which way was better. Instantly upon the removal of the blindfold, their companion went ballistic in excitement, jumping into the  buckets and making a mess gobbling everything up. With the dragon covered in all sorts of flavors and toppings, looking happier than ever, the Wizards realized there is no right way, as long as you enjoy it. Both Wizards are still on the same page about Nubbleberries on pizzas though - they hate it.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will melt your heart!

dragons.Name: Prestige
dragons.Description: No one even saw the prestige dragon walk in or around the circus, but no one questioned its entrance on the stage. It just looks like it belongs there. Performing magical tricks and illusions that no dragon should be capable of. This dragon will leave the audience awestruck and scratching their heads, that's a promise. In turn, some more observant audience members are starting to question, why are rigel and lightning dragons moving backstage so often. And if there is just one prestige on stage, or perhaps more?
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to fool you!

dragons.Name: Ahoy
dragons.Description: Ahoy! - a signal word, often used to call to a ship or a boat, which are a regular sight in the Vale, especially the flying kind. But did you know the origin story of that word? Well, it all began with a brave Wizard-explorer by the name of Esesh. He loved to travel and visited a lot of known and unknown places, but as the years passed, his vision started to let him down a bit. On one of his trips to yet another exotic island, a long-tailed dragon grabbed his attention. He didn't know what to call it at first, but took it along on his voyages and trained it how to drive the tip of its tail on the ground, launch itself and balance on top of it in order to keep an eye for other ships and land. Esesh even tried giving it his spyglass to help it spot things easier, but the dragon, not knowing what to do with it simply threw it overboard. With time, more and more wizards started taking such a dragon on their trips, because it really seemed to enjoy balancing on its sturdy tail and being on the lookout for potentially approaching difficulties. Nowadays, almost all ships and boats have it onboard. And hence why when brave wizards would shout “Ahoy!” to call on a ship or a boat, the dragon would respond to that instead, as if they're calling its name. Next time you're thinking of using this exact signal word, remember that you're calling to a dragon, not a vessel.
dragons.Goal: This dragon sees everything!

dragons.Name: Ikatako
dragons.Description: From the depths of the oceans these dragons swim up to stalk their unsuspecting prey. Staying submerged beneath the waves, ikatako dragons wait for their moment to strike and.. tickle the soles of any unfortunate swimmers with their tentacles. On land, when they are out of the water for a while they can get a bit squidgy, so whenever they see a barrel of water, they jump right in to keep themselves in shape. Whatever shape that may be.
dragons.Goal: This dragon can open any jar!

dragons.Name: Zilla
dragons.Description: Frozen in the icebergs of Seebear eons ago, these ancient dragons have made a ground-shaking return. Their icy prisons, weakened by the coming of summer, have thawed and shattered, letting these living fossils loose upon the world. Zilla dragons hail from a much different and fierce part of history, but even they can't help relaxing in the warm waters of paradise. Just make sure they are nowhere near any yeti dragons.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will stomp your sandcastle!

dragons.Name: Gawk
dragons.Description: A friend to any wizard, captain or wizard-captain, the gawk dragons make for life-long companions. They are well-known for their speed, loyalty, intelligence and tendency to screeeam for no reason in the middle of the night. Not to mention how seamlessly they join in whenever sea shanties are sung. Just be mindful of their presence when having a private conversation, they will hear the most inappropriate part and will repeat it at the most awkward moment.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will sing your favorite theme song.

dragons.Name: Lazuli
dragons.Description: Playful and good-natured, these magnificent dragons are seen as an omen of good fortune by many sailors. The lazuli dragons would often follow ships out at sea for a while, either to feed their curiosity, or to make sure the sailors are safe before diving or flying out of sight. It is also said that feeding them a bit of fish salami as a treat brings even better fortune.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will bring you the best of luck!

dragons.Name: Trove
dragons.Description: The bane of any crew - the stowaway. These dragons would often sneak into ships and hide in some dim corner or cubbyhole. Sometimes sitting in the most awkward and contorted positions for hours, even days, just waiting for the unwitting host crew to set sail to find their next treasure trove. As soon as the dragon caught a whiff of gold, no matter how far it was buried under the sand, it would scurry out of its hiding spot and make a mad dash to the treasure, long before the crew have even had a chance to react, let alone disembark. If they don't get caught beforehand that is, in which case they are often jettisoned from the ship or fired from the cannons as punishment. The trove dragon doesn't seem to care, there are always more ships in the sea.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will sniff out your lost keys!

dragons.Name: Alure
dragons.Description: One day on their way back from the Shimmering Isles, the wizard Samjack and his celtic dragon companion were sailing home with a crew of sailors. Entering a thick fog on their way, they all started hearing a delightful tune that would gently caress their ears as if an angel had softly whispered into them. Only the celtic dragon wasn't enjoying it, covering its ears from the sound. Entranced by the tune, the captain ordered the helmsman to steer towards the source of the singing. Getting closer and closer, the alluring song became gradually louder and louder. And there, deep in the fog they discovered the source - a dragon as beautiful as a dream and as scary as a nightmare. With only the celtic dragon not under the alure dragon's charm, it tore off the sails of the ship and started dragging it backwards with all the strength it could muster. Once the crew were out of the fog, it could finally rest and take a breather. The sailors fashioned a new makeshift sail and made their way home and to this day they wonder, what would have happened if not for the help of that wizard's companion.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will charm you!

dragons.Name: Yarr
dragons.Description: Yarr dragons first got thar sea legs thanks t' the Wizard-Cap'n Reefheart. Nah t' be outdone by his nemesis Esesh, Reefheart brought along yarr dragons on his ship fer thar ability t' read the night sky 'n find thar way home by way o' stars 'n constellations. Natural leaders 'n tacticians, these dragons smartly climb thar way up the hierarchical chaos that be a pirate crew, t' become First Mates, sometimes even Captains o' ships. Occasionally they might step in the barrels o' grog or lemons, which ain't a problem as long as thar aren't any ikatako dragons hidin' inside.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will read you the stars!

dragons.Name: Enfis
dragons.Description: Invited or not, enfis dragons often end up as companions to crew-mates and captains aboard ships. Their unassuming appearance, along with their friendly and curious nature would bring any unsuspecting sailor's guard down. By the time the ship's crew notices the slime trails left behind by the dragon, it has already made its home below deck and the sailors have already slipped more times than they can count, broken more barrels than they can repair and spilled more beanstalk juice than their hearts can bear. You might think a “Wet Floor” sign might be pointless on a seaworthy ship, but you would be surprised.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will spill some beanstalk juice!

dragons.Name: Burrow
dragons.Description: Armed with a keen sense of smell, a light source of their own and most importantly, an affinity towards anything earthly, burrow dragons often... burrow to forage for food or dig out curious stones, crystals and minerals. This set of skills is often utilized by the scouts to help save wizards and dragons stuck in cave-ins. Any precious rocks they find along the way they just keep for their collections.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will find that thing you dropped that one time and thought to be lost forever.

dragons.Name: Aperture
dragons.Description: To the naked eye, the portals of these dragons may look like plain magic or an innate ability to teleport, but being made of pure water and ice, these dragons possess a far more amazing talent. Sensing and using the water molecules in the air, they somehow disperse their mass and perfectly reshape themselves a short distance away. For this reason, aperture dragons love to shower in the rain, as this is the most literal form of refreshing. Just ask their best buddies, the atramento and rigel dragons.
dragons.Goal: This dragon really loves the cold water!

dragons.Name: Zipzap
dragons.Description: Having studied the aperture dragons obsessively, the genius-wizard Teslan created a machine in his tower to mimic their portals. After successfully teleporting objects and plants, he felt he was ready to move on to actual dragons. The first few attempts were a flop, as he needed way more power to teleport something that big, so a couple lightning dragons aided him by supercharging the machine. The complex machinery could not take the heat and in a blinding flash, the machine was no more, but from the rubble arose a dragon infused with pure electricity and power. With their innate ability to generate electrical current, zipzap dragons quickly became Teslan's new favorite. They get a kick out of using their tails to discharge into the ground, think of it as the dragon equivalent of cracking your back.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is zipzapping to the top!

dragons.Name: Chimmit
dragons.Description: One day, a grumpy and disgruntled dragon made its way to the camp through the water, mud and sand, offended by the foolish and silly way in which the Scouts were trying to fish. So ineffective were the Scouts then, that the aquatic dragon thought it might as well teach them. If they are going to do it, might as well do it properly! Ever since then, Scouts have earned their fly-fishing badges in droves, and the chimmit dragon has been recognized as the best angler! On this side of the world at least.
dragons.Goal: This dragon can catch anything (but its own lure)!

dragons.Name: Chuck
dragons.Description: As they get older and the aching in their hearts to get their claws busy and express themselves becomes stronger, these dragons will usually turn towards the fine craft of woodworking. Seemingly built perfectly to cut, hold and shape wood, chuck dragons will regularly make little statuettes of themselves or the wizards that brought them up. Having gone through so many logs and planks, they can identify and age any tree and stump they come across. Any scout wishing to earn the woodcarving badge will find chuck dragons to be more than suitable mentors. And yes, chuck would chuck as much wood as a chuck could chuck if a chuck could chuck wood.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is so crafty!

dragons.Name: Chomp
dragons.Description: With their big feet they will stomp, with their big claws they will chop and with their big mouth they will chomp down on the best cuisine in the Vale. These dragons have a surprisingly developed taste for fine food and instinctively know when it is cooked and seasoned to perfection, making them a desired assistant by the wizard-chef Ramsee, with whom they share a soft spot for scuttle dragons. Intimidated at first, wizzlings and hatchlings quickly warm up to the chomp dragons. Friendly and gentle, they let Scouts sneak snacks to their tents for a late night munch.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has an exquisite taste!

dragons.Name: Wilderness
dragons.Description: No need for a tent with this one, the sky above, the horizon around and the ground below is all shelter this dragon needs to survive in the wild. A friend to all things wild, they require so few nutrients to survive, that some wizards believe these dragons feed on the energies of the wilderness itself. Nowhere in the world is too far away from home, as the entire world and every dragon lover's heart is their home.
dragons.Goal: This dragon can survive anything!

dragons.Name: Tien
dragons.Description: Setting the scene - imagine the most epic (but socially distant) party that has ever happened in the Vale! Celebrating a DECAde of park ownership called for the most exquisite of party activities that the wizards could think of. One of them was a giant baby fire dragon piñata, filled with delicious berries and beanstalks, everyone's favorite! Wizards and dragons alike tried to knock it down from the Sakura tree, but to no avail. Until a large and magnificent dragon, unknown to the magicfolk, approached the piñata and started slashing at it rapidly with its sharp wings. Perhaps, this dragon was a result of a special summoning spell done by a very hungry and impatient wizard. We might never know its origins, but it surely needed a name. Everyone shifted their attention towards the new elegant and shiny dragon and got to brainstorming a name for it. "Let's name it Ten, after the anniversary! It also has a ten sign on its chest!" someone shouted. Another yelled "No, that's just an X. It looks like it's made out of tin, so let's name it that!". And so half the folks started chanting "Ten", the other half "Tin" and they couldn't make up their minds. Until someone suggested they just combine the two and name it tien. Minds were blown and dragons were named tien. We leave it up to you to decide though - is it a roman numeral ten on its chest, or just an "X marks the spot" type of situation.
dragons.Goal: A fast and shining new addition to the Vale!

dragons.Name: Infernus
dragons.Description: A cheerful and playful camper, this dragon would spend most of its time swimming around in the campsite lake. Gently spraying those passing by or forcefully tipping the boat over if they pollute the water. Once the dark clouds came rolling in and everything started going awry, it hid in the only place it knew would be safe - deep underwater. As bottomless pits were forming and thorny vines were sprouting, the lake began slowly turning into lava. With the dragon still inside, it started morphing and absorbing the properties of the lava lake, turning into the infernus dragon, still as cheerful and playful as ever, but with the new ability to have its own hot tub.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will bring the pool to a rolling boil!

dragons.Name: Funis
dragons.Description: As soon as the clouds grew larger and the sky got darker over the Vale, campers would trip over the ropes of their tents left and right, thinking they were simply having trouble seeing them with so little light. Little did they know, the ropes of their tents had come to life, blindly and instinctively striking at their legs as they passed. A single string of rope is nothing to be afraid of, but when they merge together into a funis dragon, they form a mighty bundle.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is one dangerous noodle!

dragons.Name: Etch
dragons.Description: As if beckoned by a mysterious force, some etch dragons made their way here, following the aura of the enveloping darkness and dread in the Vale. The wizards had only read about these dragons in pre-cataclysm texts. Quiet and reclusive in nature, but unnerving and suspicious in their appearance. Originating from the swamps of Catchafaya, where they are well suited for their home environment, although they do have to compete for insects with the local Kroki dragons every now and then.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will take care of the bugs!

dragons.Name: Heavy Metal
dragons.Description: You have probably heard of the metal dragons, but have you heard of the heavy metal dragons? No? Weird. They were first noticed by the great explorer Jorsten Seabound. And we say noticed, because he made sure to keep his distance upon discovering them. These dragons breathe out an enormous fire cloud every once in a while, and that's why Jorsten watched them from afar, to prevent his beard from catching fire. He also noted in his journal that the heavy metal dragons, contrary to what folks would imagine, love to hang out on beautiful flowery fields. Why - no one knows. Probably because their sick riffs require a lot of open space, and because they look intimidating, but are real sweethearts.
dragons.Goal: This dragon's riff will be heard throughout the Rift!

dragons.Name: Punk
dragons.Description: Punk dragons are often mistaken for a metal dragon, and whenever that happens, they let out a screeching roar in frustration. Some Wizards don't see the difference really, and some just don't care. Having crawled out of the Pit of Despair, the punk dragons came to do one thing and one thing only.. to make a Pit of Mosh.. a mosh pit. They wanted a friendly mosh pit, okay?
dragons.Goal: This dragon will thrash around tirelessly!

dragons.Name: Techno
dragons.Description: Techno dragons feel a rhythm in nearly everything, including life itself, and following the rhythm of life has brought them to the Vale. As soon as they heard of the parties that take place here annually, they knew they had to make it over. Hitching a ride on Whitbee's boat successfully led them here, despite being surrounded by ghouls, monsters and creepy crawlies through the entire trip. Something tells me they won't be going back home the same way they came.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will party all day and all night!

dragons.Name: Umbra
dragons.Description: Little campers and wizzlings tell the creepiest stories around the fire, and this one is no different. Rumor has it that you can summon a dragon if you sit alone in your tent at night, you need just a lantern and a mirror. If you start chanting the dragon's true name and turn off your lantern just as you chant it the fifth time, a shadowy figure will then claw its way out of the mirror, possess the tent, spit you out and take the form of a spooky dragon. The true name of the dragon is a closely kept secret, but campers call it umbra, for its shadowy appearance.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will leave you speechless and tentless!

dragons.Name: Khamsin
dragons.Description: Don't let the big grinning teeth and open maw intimidate you, khamsins are real sweethearts. If puddles in the road are rocking your carriage, they will fill them up gladly. If the barn needs a new coat of paint, they will sandblast the old one right off. Very useful these dragons, unless you ask Kairos that is. With the habit of filling up potholes with sand, whenever they see an hourglass running out, they just have to top it off. Who knows how many times Kairos has had to reverse time to save his empty hourglasses. Only he would probably.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will take you to see a sand dune.

dragons.Name: Razortail
dragons.Description: The nurses of the Vale are well familiar with this dragon and its razor-like thorns. As well as the wails of those unfortunate enough to blindly stumble on their thorny tails. I think you can see where the name came from. The dragons aren't bothered by people stepping on their tails, though; they like to poke fun at those who do. Anyone else have a feeling of déjà vu all of a sudden?
dragons.Goal: This dragon will strike with ferocity!

dragons.Name: Sow
dragons.Description: Standing in the field as a boring scarelokilure one day, walking and roaring as a dragon the next. Sow dragons were made manifest all around the fields of the Vale when the horrors and nightmares of Into the Dark eceded. With the overwhelming darkness enveloping them, they no longer just stand still, they also instill...fear. Albeit in their own slightly goofy way.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will protect your crops.

dragons.Name: Country
dragons.Description: Originating from the swamps of Valouisiana, these dragons have gone mostly unnoticed until the other Melody dragons started rollin' on to the Vale. There always has been a community of wizards and witches that appreciates the country dragons, like the great Wizard John Dragoncash being one of them, but now it was time for a wider audience. For if you come down to the Vale, you don't have to worry, people in the Vale are happy to welcome you.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is the quickest claw in the west.

dragons.Name: Huddle
dragons.Description: One day a couple of wizards were inspecting the fields and came across a rather curious patch of wheat. It was growing at an immense speed! Taller, thicker, it was almost ten feet! “Curious!” they thought… but didn't seem to mind it a lot! Surely enough a glorious dragon appeared and even though it was weird, it was not feared! They named the dragon huddle after the clumsy wizard Duddle. Apparently he tripped over some rubble, fell into a puddle and in the kerfuffle accidentally enchanted the nearby wheat stubble.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will outgrow the competition!

dragons.Name: Squish
dragons.Description: Every wizard-farmer's favorite little helper. Squish dragons are always there to rake the soil and lovingly look after the crops their wizard friends have sown, especially the pumpkin patches, they love those. No one knows exactly why that is, but some speculate it's because pumpkins remind them of themselves and their kin. Others assume squish dragons just like eating lots of squash, to the point where the dragons themselves start resembling them. Just don't feed them any pumpkins after midnight.
dragons.Goal: This dragon can't wait to go to the pumpkin patch!

dragons.Name: Jamjam
dragons.Description: Constantly surrounded by so many bearded Wizards, jamjam dragons feel right at home in the Vale, and they are a favorite among the little wizzlings. So warm and fluffy, you can hug them for hours and not get tired of it. Some, however, are afraid of the tiny present-stealing gnomes that live inside the big bushy beards they have. Reaching out and grabbing the presents right off of anyone who hugs the dragon. The Wizards know better than to believe that made-up nonsense.. it..it's made-up, right?
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to show off its beard!

dragons.Name: Chaiko
dragons.Description: Despite their look, chaiko dragons are actually very friendly, especially with the sugarplum dragons. But when they spot their favorite treat, and see there is competition for it, then their mean look starts to make more sense. You see, they go nuts for nuts and will have these strange rattle battles with one another for the right to eat the treat. Even squirrels don't have the courage to steal nuts from them.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is going nuts!

dragons.Name: Snowflake 7
dragons.Description: The illustrious Arendella's snowflake dragons are truly a gift that keeps on giving. This one is perhaps the most unique of the bunch and its arrival is a very special omen, for the magical essence of winter has returned, and many miracles are sure to follow this one.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is bringing the magic!

dragons.Name: Chorister
dragons.Description: A merry looking dragon, sometimes seen, or rather, heard singing the soothing song of its species. And with the winter magic's return, this has become an even more regular sight. Almost like the dragon has felt it and wants to spread joy to all those around. The Wizard Noel adores the chorister dragons for their singing, if only he could capture it in a bottle or record it somehow. Oh, and a fun fact for you: a group of flying chorister dragons is called a choir.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here for a singalong!

dragons.Name: Weaver
dragons.Description: Originating from the Ice-Risen Vault caves, weavers are very social dragons and often form close bonds with others of their kind by bringing each other gifts and tokens of appreciation. A particularly shiny rock, some tasty treats or perhaps a pretty colorful feather. Each gift, neatly wrapped in soft silky strands, very hard to open these presents. They were drawn to the Vale by the overflowing essence of magic, maybe they could wrap that as well? Who knows.. But it seems that by observing the Wizards exchanging gifts, the dragons figured that these T-shaped bags Valers put on must be greatly appreciated presents, if they gift them so often. That's how they got into the habit of making sweaters for the Wizards, occasionally making socks as well, seeing that the humans need tiny sweaters for their feet as well.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to make you a present!

dragons.Name: Glitz
dragons.Description:
Glitz dragons will turn any celebration into a spectacle with just a swish of their tail and a flash of sparkle! Be it a birthday party where the wizzlings forgot the candles, a wedding with no confetti or meeting the coming of the new year.
Be mindful of nearby dragons when using fireworks! Some may get startled, and funnily enough glitz dragons are no exception.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to sparkle it up!

dragons.Name: Zero
dragons.Description: The zero dragons were awakened from their seemingly endless slumber, when they were interrupted by the cold essence of the winter's magic. Having spent so much time asleep, these dragons have kept their primal features over time, making them stand out like an exhibit come to life. With resistance to cold, size isn't everything and even these giants shiver and freeze over at the slightest breeze, only being able to break free thanks to their immense strength. And no, they don't think it's rude to use the leftover ice for a slushy.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to break the ice!

dragons.Name: Zumi
dragons.Description: Lumi was most excited of all to see the winter's magical essence return, and for being such a good sport, the Wizards of the Vale decided to give her a very special present. A small and cute dragon, much like herself, that she could call her own. Zumi, they would call it. With eyes closed and arms stretched out, she was handed the little rascal. Realizing what it was, she opened her eyes in excitement and instantly gave it a big ol' hug. The dragon was happy as well to have met its new best friend, licking her face and wagging its tail. In this magical moment, filled with joy and happiness, the winter's essence manifested into a giant orb of ice, gently floating above the dragon. The Wizards could sense great magical energy emanating from it, while the zumi dragon didn't seem to pay it much attention, almost as if it was always there. It had immense power at its disposal, but it seemed more interested in making small snow sculptures with it instead.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is rolling into the Vale!

dragons.Name: Buttercup
dragons.Description: To impress the love of his life, a Wizard of the Vale traveled far and wide around the world in search of the perfect gift. Eventually, his adventures brought him to the Sandara Desert, where he hoped to find the shiniest gold and most brilliant lapis! To bring home a trinket of immeasurable quality, brandishing his beloved's favorite colors. He scoured nearly every stand of every merchant at the bazaar, when he noticed an intriguing item, resting on a fluffy blanket. He reached for it to have a closer look, only to realize he had grabbed the horn of a beautiful sleeping buttercup dragon. First he was scared, but his fear quickly turned to excitement, when he realized he had stumbled upon the perfect gift. And so, the buttercup dragons were introduced to the Vale.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to be cute!

dragons.Name: Lullaby
dragons.Description: If sleeping in was a lifestyle, lullaby dragons would be the living embodiment of that, as it is the one thing they love most, and for them there is no better way to spend their time. Wizards wonder if these dragons even have a sense of time with all that sleeping, but no one can deny the benefits. Like the warmth of the blanket, the joy of taking a quick nap, a relaxing snooze, an energizing power nap, a rejuvenating beauty sleep and a calming drowse...just five more minutes please.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to have a nap!

dragons.Name: Lightmare
dragons.Description: In service to the balance of the dreamworld, lightmare dragons roam without rest to keep nightmares in check. Catching and absorbing their darkness, slowly transforming them into pleasant dreams that they then release into their surroundings. Ironically, these dragons do not sleep, for if they did, the dark energy absorbed over time would likely manifest in an untold number of nightmares. They do give nightmare dragons an occasional hug by accident.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will catch the bad dreams!

dragons.Name: Lumineux
dragons.Description: When waves of nightmares manifest and wash over the dreamland, lumineux dragons quickly move to action. They huddle together with other inhabitants of their realm, protecting them by radiating a pleasant aura of warmth and serenity, keeping the nightmares away. With hearts of gold, these dragons can illuminate even the darkest of the dreamland's corners.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to protect you!

dragons.Name: Orlena
dragons.Description: The venerable orlena dragons are thrilled to get acquainted with their new subjects in this material-plane. Having spent most of their time in the bizarre land of dreams surrounded by dreamy, floaty, cloudy dragons, they probably feel more at home here in the Vale. And with them they bring the overwhelming power and emboldening force of love. Able to bring forth the kind and gentle touch of a rose petal, as well as the sharp pain of its thorns.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is proud to be here!

dragons.Name: Cupido
dragons.Description: Love is a strong force in ours and in the dream world, and if any other force comes close to that, it would be the willpower, or rather lack of it, to get out of one's bed after a good night's sleep. Cupido dragons have come up with a simple solution - bring your bed everywhere with you. That way you never have to get out of bed to play your role, and what an important role they have! For it is said that when someone falls in love, they have been blessed by a cupido dragon with a bolt of love. How sweet!
dragons.Goal: This dragon loves its bed!

dragons.Name: Astraline
dragons.Description: With the way to the dreamland open, a group of dragons fueled by curiosity ventured into the realm of dreams, to see what all the fuss was about. Soon they emerged happy and cheerful, seemingly floating weightlessly around, as if still in a dream. It seems as if they absorbed some of the dream's mysterious properties but did not get enough time to practice. This brings a slew of questions regarding the dreamland. Does time there flow at the same rate as here? Is there even such a concept as time there? What do those who dream in the land of dreams dream of? No one is brave enough to go and document their experience, but one can dream.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to tumble aimlessly!

dragons.Name: Mesmer
dragons.Description: With the arrival of the mesmer dragons, everyone affected by the hypnosis mysteriously awoke from their slumber, as if by the snap of a finger. Although no one could sense any malice in the actions of these odd dragons, it was clear they were behind the exodus of dragons from the dreamland. They are so in tune with their home-world's laws and properties, that they were able to not only open a way between our worlds, but to also hypnotize the Wizards without having to even set foot here. Why they did it and why the Wizards had to be asleep we may never find out, but at least the dragons are happy to have more lovely friends around. Curiously, everyone that went under their spell later awoke with a vague memory of a place called "Lemnos". No one seems to know where it is, only that it's somewhere in the dreamland.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is hypnotizing!

dragons.Name: Bellflower
dragons.Description:
The master plant wizard Treppide was on a quest to find and devour,
The most delicious plants near the bell tower,
But instead he found the bellflower.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is blooming on the top!

dragons.Name: Hyperion
dragons.Description: The brave Wizard Kael studied the great texts of old to find the strongest dragon he could summon. The scriptures mentioned hyperion dragons - beings of immense power from an unknown world. The spell seemed easy to follow, but its cost would prove to be too great, even for someone as skilled as Kael. Halfway through the incantation, he fell exhausted, leaving the summoning unfinished. He awoke to find a hyperion dragon seemingly stuck between two planes of existence, constantly trying to come through to our world.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is out of this world!

dragons.Name: Luck
dragons.Description: These dragons often have their naps interrupted by Wizards and wizzlings who think they have stumbled upon their lucky charm. And a pretty massive lucky charm at that. Only it's not a four-leaf clover, it has only three leaves! And it's not even a clover, it's a dragon's tail! Maybe the luck dragons don't count themselves as lucky in that regard.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is a sign of good luck!

dragons.Name: Redbeard
dragons.Description: A group of wizzlings set out into the forest to find and capture a redbeard dragon. An elaborate plan was cooked up to lure one and take all its gold to buy as much candy and treats as they could eat. The kids would practice and repeat their plan among themselves until perfection, before trying it on a real dragon. With each new test run, the dummy gold they would use as bait kept vanishing without a trace. Unbeknownst to them, a redbeard dragon was already onto their schemes and was sneakily snatching their would-be bait. With their instinct to find, keep and hoard gold, it isn't too absurd to suggest the redbeard and yarr dragons are related in some way.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to make a deposit!

dragons.Name: Triple Rainbow
dragons.Description: Much to the surprise of Zamora, triple rainbow dragons do exist, as it appears nature has indeed found a way. And although thought to be pretty tough to find, there have been plenty of sightings of this curious dragon recently. After seeing it with her own eyes, Zamora has spent most of her time in her study pondering upon this discovery. For if we assume that one is chance, two is coincidence, and three is a pattern.. what would the fourth be?
dragons.Goal: This dragon is headed in the right direction!

dragons.Name: Arcrider
dragons.Description: The arcrider dragons are living proof that looks can be deceiving. Despite their calm and friendly appearance, they can actually be super high-energy mischievous beings. They would never miss a chance to surf down a beautiful rainbow, and are constantly wandering off looking for one, determination obvious in their eyes. Rumor has it, their only goal is to become better arc riders, but it's also noted that they love to party with the party dragons.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is determined!

dragons.Name: Quaa
dragons.Description: Quaa dragons mean well and are of kind nature, but this did not stop them from quickly becoming a menace to the Wizards of the Vale. What qualifies them as a nuisance you ask? Well, whether Valers are having a quality time quilling on their porches, or napping wrapped in cozy quilts, quaas have trouble staying quiet. It's a good thing they aren't quadrupedal, for their stomping would be quite quaking. It is hard to quantify the times they have been shooed away, it might be in the quadrillions, but they just don't quit. Wanna hear the most annoying sound in the Vale? QUAA!
dragons.Goal: This dragon does not quit!

dragons.Name: Fae
dragons.Description: Sprightly dragons filled with joy, glamour and sparkle. The mystical fae dragons watch over and protect their fairy brothers and sisters wherever they go. Ironically, these protectors are easily startled and often phase out of existence, to an unknown location, realm or perhaps even plane of reality. No one knows for sure where they go, but many would love to see the magical places that faes travel to to get away from everything, for it must be truly spectacular.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will jump realities!

dragons.Name: Niamh
dragons.Description: Elegant and peaceful, blooming and beautiful, a near incarnation of the spirit of spring itself. The appearance of these dragons is a telltale sign of the seasons changing. And you can tell it's springtime when the birds are chirping, the flora is sprouting and the allergies are annoying. Niamh dragons are so intertwined with nature, that some Wizards think they just sprout out of the ground when spring comes around.
dragons.Goal: This dragon brings good news!

dragons.Name: Smigi
dragons.Description: Originally discovered by the Wizard and Witch duo, Jules and Lillian, smigis were often seen swinging and gliding in the wild, thanks to their amazing acrobatic skills. The duo would chase after the dragons, trying to get close enough to study them, only able to catch up when the dragons got tired. The smigis weren't running away out of fear, however, they simply had fun running along with their new bipedal friends. The dragons would curiously wonder why the wizards walk on their hind legs, but they didn't judge. It is the sounds of cheering and laughter that brought them to the circus, excited by the possibility of showing off their agility, as well as making new strange friends.
dragons.Goal: This dragon loves swinging into action!

dragons.Name: Scryer
dragons.Description: Mysterious and nomadic dragons, scryers are always heeding the call of their eerily glowing orb, leading them to places unknown. This time, they were led to the Vale and immediately caught the curiosity and attention of the Valers. Especially the Wizard Jerrsy, that little devil. Imagine this, Wizards fighting a dragon for a mysterious purple orb. You would think they learnt their lesson after the clairvoyant dragons.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is mysterious!

dragons.Name: Stage
dragons.Description: Wizzlings love stage dragons for their colorful look and friendly demeanor. Always cheerfully greeting and waving to everyone as they pass by. Even if you are the absolute biggest, baddest and scariest dragon out there, stage dragons will wave hello if you walk by them. They will even wave if you walk by a second time. And even the third time. Okay, maybe waving doesn't actually mean the same thing to them, or they simply forget immediately who they just passed. Either way, they are perfect candidates for welcoming guests to any event.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is a cheerful greeter!

dragons.Name: PonkiPong
dragons.Description: Ponkipong dragons always hatch as a set of two, and believe it or not, these little bundles of joy are actually twins. Wherever they go, they are always together running and jumping, hopping and bouncing. While observing them in the wild, the Wizard Nysen noticed how much his little apprentice wizzlings enjoyed watching the ponkipongs. They were far more entertained by their acrobatics than his boring lectures on magic and proper wand safety. The more the children would cheer, the more daring the dragons' tricks would become, as if motivated by their enjoyment. Seeing the joy in the wizzlings' eyes made him bring a few dragons to the Vale, despite ruining his lecture.
dragons.Goal: These dragons will cheer you up!

dragons.Name: Jumpiplop
dragons.Description: How jumpiplops made it to the Vale, you ask? Well, while exploring the swamps of Catchafaya in search for new weird and curious dragons, Wizard-Dragonologist Jeremy would every now and then hear splashes in the otherwise eerily still and quiet waters. By the time he'd turned around to see what creature broke the silence, only the remaining ripples could be seen, dancing in the water. Some splashes were more daring, being seen a second too late right next or behind him. Frustrated by this, the moment he heard a splash nearby he leapt into the water to grab at the creature. He was astonished to see a dragon unknown to him quickly swim away, climb up a tree and jump back into the water, making the splashes. This also might explain the name he chose for it.
dragons.Goal: This dragon loves splashing about.

dragons.Name: Morphimagus
dragons.Description: In the vast and expansive libraries of the Vale, it is easy to misplace or lose something if you're not careful. Some apprentices even manage to get lost themselves in the many weaving and overlapping corridors and floors. This is where morphimagus dragons come in. These kind but shy creatures, who prefer not to be the center of attention, wander the libraries and assist the senior wizards with maintaining and arranging the unimaginable number books and tomes. It is when apprentice wizards look and snoop around that the dragons' stage fright-or-flight instincts kick in, taking the form of something inconspicuous. Who would find a wizard's hat to be out of place in a library full of wizards?
dragons.Goal: This dragon is easily scared.

dragons.Name: Puffles
dragons.Description: Puffles are often approached by Wizards and other dragons alike under the assumption they will be nice and cuddly. But despite their soft outward appearance, their coat hides the truly ferocious beast they are underneath. Sometimes you can catch glimpses of the scary claws, leathery skin so tough it can shrug off the sharpest of rocks and gnarly horns that would worry even the diamond dragons. Just don't make any loud noises around them as they might pull a scaredy-turtle.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is not to be cuddled with.

dragons.Name: Prestina
dragons.Description: The crowd is packed, the stage is set. A thick puff of smoke appears, but no one is yet to be seen. Crowd members are looking all around, above and below, behind and in front, trying to find whoever or whatever is on stage. When suddenly two peculiar boxes, colorful in pattern, float gently onto the stage and from them pop out two dragons, bowing gracefully to the viewers. And so the show begins! Performing one trick after another, the duo leave the crowd in awe after each brilliant performance. Every Wizard, Witch and wizzling trying to figure out the magic tricks, only to fall short of the truth. For as someone once greatly put it, when you are looking for the secret behind the trick, you won't find it. Because you aren't really looking, as your mind wants to be tricked. With one final act, the show ends, the dragons bow gracefully once more and disappear just as they came in. One might ask if the dragons are siblings, two of the same but in clever disguise, or twins even. Only one thing is for certain - one is a prestina, and the other, in turn, is prestige.
dragons.Goal: This dragon knows some magic tricks.

dragons.Name: Spinky
dragons.Description: A friendly but scaredy dragon, often spotted floating on the water's surface due to their natural buoyancy. When they feel threatened, spinky dragons will initiate their definition of fight or flight. Ballooning up to twice their size and showing off their spines to shoo away any threat.. and then, if things get spiky, fleeing by taking 'flight' by releasing all the air they've held up. Just be careful they don't 'fly' into the beach volleyball court.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is very round.

dragons.Name: Valeodon
dragons.Description: Ancient rivals of the zilla dragons, these two titans would duke it out in the waters of Seebear. Sending destructive tidal waves to distant shores and shattering icebergs in their wake. It has been ages since then and neither seems too keen on continuing their brawl, they appear content sharing the beautiful beaches and soothing waters together. Seems the Vale IS big enough for the two of them.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has a strong jaw!

dragons.Name: Sea Shanty
dragons.Description: Any ship crew needs a bit of tomfoolery and entertainment every now and then, to keep the morale high and the moods lifted. The crew love listening to sea shanties on their voyage for treasures and paradise, such as "Wizardman", "Sunken Sailor" and by far their most favorite - "Sea Shanty Two". Imagine their surprise when the only ones who got to enjoy them were the crabs hiding away in the ship's hull.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has great rhythm!

dragons.Name: Euryale
dragons.Description: With innate magical abilities themselves, these dragons appear almost attracted to other sources of magic, being able to sense them from all the way down in the abyssal depths. The ship's crew got a voyage of a lifetime, struggling to keep their footing and sealing holes in the hull as fast as they could, while their entire ship was being dragged around violently. It is only when barrels full of treats started falling overboard that the shaking ceased. And thus, a new rule was put in place: "The crew will bring extra treats, in case of any euryales it meets!". Maybe that's the 'magic' they were so attracted to.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to lend a hand or two.

dragons.Name: Corsair
dragons.Description: Originatin' from the faraway islands o' Fort Royale, corsair dragons 'ave made thar way t' the Vale wit' Esesh, the life-long nemesis o' Reefheart 'n his yarr dragons. Corsairs 'ave but one desire - t' sail the seas, ride the waves, enjoy the wind, find shiny-shiny loot 'n bring misfortune t' thar nemeses. Aye, that be more than one desire but ye get the picture.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has an adventurous spirit!

dragons.Name: Curse
dragons.Description: Sometimes the greed for treasure and riches can be rewarding, but sometimes it can play a cruel trick and end up biting you, in more ways than one. Curses often come with warnings, but some choose to ignore them. "Whoever digs up this treasure shall have eternal riches. But just as the treasure pays the wielder's debts, so is the wielder in debt to the treasure." And this dragon is one such case, forever cursed to exist between the realms of reality, but never fully belonging to either.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to haunt you!

dragons.Name: Crawler
dragons.Description: Every now and then Wizards studying the oceans spot these dragons crawling out of the crushing depths in droves. Marching upon the sandy shores like an invasion from the deeps. It is unclear why the crawler dragons do it and how they are so well coordinated in their arrival, but Wizards speculate it must take days to reach the shores with all of the ocean's water weighing them down. This might work in the dragons' favor, however, since they would need some time to adjust to the new pressures reached with each passing step. Originally the Wizards meant to name them Snap Snap Snappy dragons, but in the last moment someone came along with a more.. sensible idea.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will drag you to the depths.

dragons.Name: Kann
dragons.Description: These colorful dragons were first discovered by the Wizard-Explorer Indy, on one of his many adventures (we don't talk about that last one). Judging by his memoirs, it seems that they were protecting something precious to them from intruders, as when he entered the chamber it was absolutely packed with angry, hissing dragons. "Kanns... why'd it have to be kanns?", he mumbled to himself. It doesn't mention what it was that they were guarding, it could be treasure full of gold, artifacts of power or their most precious possession, their younglings.
dragons.Goal: This dragon enjoys basking in the sun!

dragons.Name: Gravity
dragons.Description: Timeless beings with immense power, first named by the great Wizard Nutone, gravity dragons are part of the celestial forces that shape the cosmos, giving rise to new stars and planets wherever they go. Their countless travels across the stars have led them to places and sights beyond our wildest imaginations, but none have captured these dragons' attention as much as the Vale itself. The view here may not be as awe-inspiring as a galaxy merging with another, or as colorful as a nebula, but often there is beauty in simplicity.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is a force to be reckoned with!

dragons.Name: Ariesian
dragons.Description: Wizards are afraid to get close to these dragons to study them on account of all the heat and horns and whatnot. But from their appearance and demeanor it becomes clear that ariesians' hearts burn with fiery determination and courage. They now call the Vale their new home with confidence, and have made many new fiery friends in the process. You will find that unlike the cansian dragons, ariesians would much rather not go near the water.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to bring up the heat!

dragons.Name: Cansian
dragons.Description: As dragons born of the cosmos, the concept of liquid water is a bit alien to them, but cansian dragons somehow felt naturally attracted to it from the moment they fell to the Vale. They enjoy splashing around playfully and are more than happy to share their swimming pool with others. Wizards observing them were worried cansians might not know which side is up in the water, but it seems they quickly had that figured out.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is scuttling into action!

dragons.Name: Pisceian
dragons.Description: Very friendly dragons that at a very young age bond with one another, creating friendships that last seemingly forever. Pisceians are so in touch with the elemental waters, that they not only follow the ebb and flow of the tides, but they also feel the very pull of the moon. They are sensitive creatures and will pick up on any disturbance in their pool, throwing them into a frenzy should anything threaten the serenity of the water.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is going to spin to win!

dragons.Name: Geminian
dragons.Description: Feeling right at home here in the vale, geminian dragons have no trouble getting along with others around them. If there is anyone they would have a gripe with, it would be each other. As the saying goes, two heads are better than one and you will find their minds are much sharper than their teeth.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to do a headcount.

dragons.Name: Aquarian
dragons.Description: Looking at the aquarian dragons, you would think they spend most of their time in the water, but they seem to prefer staying high up in the clouds. Only occasionally dipping their toes in the water, likely just to quench their curiosity, for they have not seen such a thing where they come from.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to splash around!

dragons.Name: Taurian
dragons.Description: The taurian dragons' sturdiness and stubbornness are only matched by their bulky stature, meeting any and all headfirst. As immovable as the very earth itself, they have proudly claimed the Vale as their new home. Not that anyone was contesting or preventing them from doing that, it's just what they do.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to visit the china shops!

dragons.Name: Vaul
dragons.Description: While things were pretty normal in the Rift, if you could call it that, seemingly out of nowhere a fierce looking dragon pierced the dark veil, right on the eleventh anniversary of the Vale. Cutting headfirst through the thick enveloping fog, like a knife through butter. No one knows where it came from nor what dragon it used to be, before the chaotic magic transformed it. Even Wizards and Witches with the wildest of imaginations can only speculate as to what vaul dragons looked like before, and sadly we might never find out.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to cut through the competition!

dragons.Name: Vampir
dragons.Description: The little vampir dragons immediately made their way to the caves of the Vale upon arrival. Feeling most at home where the light is low and the ceiling is high. Wizards studying them have noticed a pattern where mobs of hatchlings swarm on one giant stalactite, 'Mobbing time' they've coined it. If a vampir dragon hangs in the Upside Down, is it still upside down?
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to hang out!

dragons.Name: Dortal
dragons.Description: One shudders to think what harsh and unforgiving environment spawned this dragon. Infused with the dark energies of the Upside Down, dortal dragons are blessed and cursed at the same time. Possessing the unique ability to transport things to and from the other dimension using their portals, but unable to travel through it themselves. A sad consequence of this is that in a traveling pack of dortals, there will always be one left behind.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to bring you something!

dragons.Name: Grimoire
dragons.Description: Whitbee was up to his usual shenanigans, with a very bright little dragon helping him in the libraries of the castle. Spending this much time around numerous books and tomes, the dragon had become familiar with a few magical symbols. But at the wrong place at the wrong time, it had to pick up one of the worst books imaginable, catching a glimpse of its cursed texts. This unfortunate event transformed the dragon into what we see today, with a grim and misshapen body that tells a story of what took place on that fateful day.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to read your misfortune!

dragons.Name: Brood
dragons.Description: There are some things true in our world that remain true in the Upside Down as well. Eggs still need to be incubated, but why leave them at a hatchery, when you can become the hatchery? Brood dragons are able to carry their young with them from before they are even hatched. Wizards speculate the broods travel in massive swarms, changing locations often and transforming the land in their wake. Fortunately they seem capable of this only in the conditions of the Upside Down, as they are unable to do so here in the Vale.
dragons.Goal: Brilliantly breeding broods, brings bundles of buzzing babies.

dragons.Name: Rotblossom
dragons.Description: The Upside Down has taken carnivorous plants to a whole new level, but they still need sunlight to thrive, and rotblossoms are no exception. As soon as the sun goes down, these dragons go from looking like they could take on a glacier dragon, to looking like they can't take on a staircase. One feature that really stands out and has captured the imagination of the Wizards is the dragon's terrible claw and what its function might be.
dragons.Goal: A night and day difference.

dragons.Name: Amalgamate
dragons.Description: Amalgamate dragons bring a new meaning to the concept of Twin dragons, and these dragons are like none the Vale has seen before. Fully in sync with each other's thoughts and feelings, they will often react or reach for something simultaneously and in the same manner. Are two minds really better than one, when they are by all means one and the same?
dragons.Goal: This dragon's got the synergy!

dragons.Name: Kage
dragons.Description: The puppeteers of the Upside Down, working as the unseen force behind many of the events that transpire there. Orchestrating atrocities the uninitiated might consider to be just an accident. So sly and cunning, even those who know of the kage dragons' ploys and plots may not be absolutely sure they know everything. The Wizard Pyann found that them leaving their bizarre home world and coming to the Vale has stripped them of this ability. Unless that is exactly what they want you to think.
dragons.Goal: The dragon behind the curtain.

dragons.Name: Hydnellum
dragons.Description: Hydnellum dragons are horrific looking monstrosities, said to have had a role to play in the crossing between the Upside Down and the Vale opening. And judging by their outward appearance, many Wizards seem to agree. Now they don't want to appear shallow when judging just by their look, but the Wizards are also afraid they might end up having to judge the dragon from the inside... of its belly.
dragons.Goal: This is not a dragon you want running after you!

dragons.Name: Maze
dragons.Description: Wizards found these curious dragons while wandering the many corridors of the Hidden Garden's mazes. They can get out at any point by just flying out but they seem to prefer the solitude of the labyrinths. Maze dragons are so well camouflaged here that you would be forgiven for thinking they are part of the garden itself. And in a way, they really are.
dragons.Goal: No, this dragon is not made of corn!

dragons.Name: Bushwhack
dragons.Description: Clearly an oddity in the Garden, bushwhacks stick out like a sore thumb. They aren't its sworn protectors, nor are they its gate keepers. No, they are dragons who got lost in the Garden and in a panic tried to brute force their way through the many bushes, thorns and flowers, only to get tangled up beyond all reason.
dragons.Goal: This dragon needs a pair of hedge clippers!

dragons.Name: Fomhar
dragons.Description: With the leaves around us turning red like fire, so does the fomhar dragon's heart. A living embodiment of autumn whose arrival marks a change of scenery in the Vale. What might be beautiful for us, must be heartbreaking for a spirit so in tune with nature. But fret not, for what falls must also rise, the sun, the rain and the flora.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will make you fall in love with nature!

dragons.Name: Keyper
dragons.Description: The wizards of old who made the Hidden Garden entrusted the keyper dragons with keeping the key to this tucked away paradise. Knowledge and responsibility passed down from generation to generation, assuring their role as keepers. To be granted access to the gardens, one would have to achieve incredible feats of strength, knowledge and wisdom. Or have really tasty dragon treats at hand.
dragons.Goal: This dragon doesn't need a keychain.

dragons.Name: Standstone
dragons.Description: Ages ago, ancient magic turned these seemingly simple statues into living, breathing dragons. Now the standstones serve the role of protectors over the Garden, keeping out all who would enter. As you can imagine, they don't like to move much, but they can if they have to. Especially if zombie dragons waltz in uninvited, as plants can't do much against them on their own.
dragons.Goal: This dragon likes to stand on its parapet.

dragons.Name: Diggy
dragons.Description: The Garden is home to intricate mazes, colorful flowers and wonderful statues, but beauty is in the eye of the beholder. And when the beholder has no eyes, they care not for the garden's beauty. However, the smell can be in the nose of the beholder, and the smell of the treats growing inside have drawn the attention of the diggy dragons. They have been going at it with the protectors of the garden for years, a constant warfare with no end in sight.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to ruin your gardens!

dragons.Name: Everfrost
dragons.Description: What happens when Wizards mix up their spells and conjure an entire habitat's worth of snow at once? A being of pure ice and shattering cold made manifest. Any and all heat around everfrost dragons is quickly snuffed out, any liquids and gasses are instantly frozen and crystallized. Wizards keep their distance, for they know frost doesn't need a mouth to bite.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to break the ice!

dragons.Name: Sugarmitten
dragons.Description: Sugarmittens will huddle up into a ball when winds pick up, always careful not to get picked up themselves off the ground. Small and cute dragons that may not be very well suited to the cold, but they always stick around as they seem to love playing in the snow, as well as the scenery and atmosphere it creates.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to enjoy the scenery!

dragons.Name: Igluit
dragons.Description: When the cold and bitter winds start howling, it is often better to be buried under layers of snow than out in the great wide open. Igluit dragons have mastered the art of shielding themselves from the harsh winds, as well as blending in among the natives of the Frozen Highlands. It is often debated if these dragons evolved to mimic igloos, or if igloos were inspired by them. Visitors would often bump into igluit dragons thinking they are actual igloos, but those who have been around them long enough can easily tell the subtle differences.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will protect you from the cold!

dragons.Name: Aisa
dragons.Description: While aisas can walk around like any other dragon, they would much rather skate along on their big claws. Gracefully and effortlessly sliding across mud, grass and even rocks as easily as if they were ice. And it is with great interest that Witches Harling and Keyrigan studied these dragons. The two of them were completely entranced by the beautiful and smooth performances and wanted to learn this art themselves. Checking the traces aisas left behind, it appears the ground their claws touch is temporarily flash-frozen, thus creating their own skating rink as they go along. With this new knowledge at their disposal, the Witches began their rivalry of who would become the Vale's Queen of the Ice Blades.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will zoom right by you!

dragons.Name: Elkar
dragons.Description: Rigid and hardy dragons that hail from the cold north who are not used to the snow on their backs just melting away. For in the frozen tundras they're gonna be carrying the weight for months, while here the heaters gonna heat and they're just gonna shake it off. Occasionally when it snows, they will let it build up to serve as a reminder of the place they come from and to never forget their true home.
dragons.Goal: Ready for the snowpocalypse!

dragons.Name: Kotun
dragons.Description: Wizards would often tell misbehaving wizzlings stories of wild dragons who like to snack on naughty children. Of course, dragons like that don't exist and these are all just folk tales intended to get rapscallions back in line, right? Well wouldn't you know it! They do exist, and they originate from the northern lands of Icebrand. Their story is older than anyone can remember and it has spread through the world, suffering some.. slight alterations over time. While kotun dragons are very real, the danger they supposedly pose is not, as they are perhaps the most playful of all dragons in the Vale. Just stay away from their bellies, it's a trap.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will unweave your sweater!

dragons.Name: Nature
dragons.Description: Once vibrant and colorful, these dragons were forced by the Cataclysm to evacuate their homelands. Fields of green with colorful flowers, chromatic insects that dot the scenery wherever you land your gaze and pretty birds chirping peacefully. Much different from the frigid wastes in the north, where the cold climate and unforgiving environment would slowly change the nature dragons over time into what we see today. Still beautiful, but in a somewhat harsh way.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will endure the cold!

dragons.Name: Greenge
dragons.Description:
Grumpy wumpy are they, grumping in caves far away.
And the greenge will cringe, during the dinner binge.
Grumpy wumpy why are they? Cheer them up, there's gotta be a way!
Perhaps give them giftly gifts, mayhaps to close those riftly rifts.
Wrapping goes scrunch! Ribbons go rip! Lids go pop!
What is this? A big green grin? The frowny is away, we did it, hooray!
Wizards and big lizards are now best of friend! What a nice happy end!
dragons.Goal: This dragon hates celebrations!

dragons.Name: Divi
dragons.Description: If some people love receiving cute pets as gifts, and some love receiving beautiful bouquets, why not combine the two? And what better way of combining them than splicing a timid and cute dragon, with a wild and fragrant rose. This was probably the thought process of floral Wizards when they conjured up this pretty dragon. And with divi dragons quickly becoming the new hip thing, their numbers in the Vale skyrocketed as people were handing out eggs to one another as gifts.
dragons.Goal: This dragon loves rose oil!

dragons.Name: Pricklefluff
dragons.Description: It seems the same way turtles know to head for the water from the moment they hatch, so too the pricklefluff dragons know to begin their charming escapade of following one another around. With their small size and cutesy look, lots of Wizards are tempted to adopt them as pets, only to change their minds the very next day. Having these two zooming around your tower knocking down potions, books and fine china really speeds up the reconsideration process.
dragons.Goal: These dragons are prickly and fluffy!

dragons.Name: Classical
dragons.Description: Opulent and venerable, classical dragons carry themselves with grace and confidence. The Wizards consider them to be some of the most calm and cleanly dragons out there, so much so that they don't even touch the ground. Thus they are often invited to great balls and ceremonies, events where most other dragons may be.. less than suitable, with their violent and erratic behavior.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is classy!

dragons.Name: Brutiful
dragons.Description: The brutiful dragons would radiate such finesse and beauty, that at night they could be seen emitting a blissful aura so pleasant to the eyes, that visitors would flock to their habitats just to witness it. However, the most recent gathering turned into a horror show when visitors were instead greeted by monstrous brutes lumbering around. Rumors say a mysterious Witch was so envious of their beauty and fame, that she cursed them to turn into grotesque abominations at night. Although they may not resemble their otherwise pretty form, visitors would still gather around their habitats with joy, for beauty is truly in the eye of the beholder.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has a dark secret!

dragons.Name: Lovesick
dragons.Description: When the Wizard Havafix was brewing a new batch of love potions, its amazing smell caught the attention of a curious dragon. It was so enticing that instead of calmly approaching and taking a sip, the dragon just beelined for the potion with no intent of slowing down. Seeing it quickly approaching, the Wizard backed away just in time to avoid getting splashed. The dragon slammed into the cauldron and started gulping down mouthful after mouthful. By the time Havafix came back to check, the cauldron was empty and all that remained was the satisfied lovesick dragon, laying there in bliss.
dragons.Goal: This dragon needs a potion brewer!

dragons.Name: Nomnoter
dragons.Description: Every year there are hundreds of valentine cards that go missing and never reach their intended recipient, sadly this would often leave many valers needlessly heartbroken. To prevent the same from happening this time around, the Vale tasked a group of Wizards to investigate and get to the bottom of this mystery. Starting from the messengers, moving on to the envelope makers, the clues ended up leading them to the master of post's storage. Looking through carefully, they noticed the giant pile of letters moving up and down, as if the whole thing was alive and breathing. Sure enough, digging down they found a nomnoter dragon at the bottom of the pile, fast asleep after it had gorged itself on all the tasty love letters its heart could desire.
dragons.Goal: Love is in the air and it smells good!

dragons.Name: Mesmerus
dragons.Description: Ever since moving to the Vale from the land of Lemnos, the mesmer dragon has remained linked to that mysterious place, its true home and font of power. With each passing day it built up more and more of its strength, finally allowing it to take on its true form of mesmerus. A dragon with much of the same capabilities but far stronger and, some might say, far prettier than its previous form.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is mesmerizing!

dragons.Name: Lovonone
dragons.Description: There once was a lovely couple, the Alchemist-Wizards Solus and Lunara, who were so deeply in love that they wished to use their knowledge to achieve an even greater form of unity. Namely, to merge into one singular being, allowing them to be truly inseparable and together, for as long as stars do shine. In a cruel twist of fate, their experiment led to the exact opposite effect, tying one to the realm of dark and one to the realm of light, where they remain forever bound and searching for one another, but never again able to be together.
dragons.Goal: There can be no light without darkness, and no darkness without light.

dragons.Name: Glassia
dragons.Description: It is said that glassia dragons find their mates based entirely on the worth of their character and soul. These qualities seem to be reflected in the condition of the rose they nurture in their chest. A dragon that is kind and gentle will have a pretty and flourishing rose, while naughty ones have withering roses. Allowing the truly pure of heart to shine among the rest, and making it near impossible to hide one's true nature if it were evil and rotten.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has nothing to hide!

dragons.Name: Ancestor
dragons.Description: Trees have their rings and these dragons have their beards, a sign of age and experience. Even the beardiest of Wizards can grow envious of them. But while with trees you count rings, to tell an ancestor's age you have to measure the length of their beard, add the amount of random junk tangled in there and then multiply by the number of braids. Its an overly complicated method that even those who invented it don't fully understand it.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to share its wisdom!

dragons.Name: Ichigo
dragons.Description: In nearly everything that makes up the world around us, one can find opposites: good and bad, light and dark, fire and water. For some, these opposites extend to more trivial things, such as vanilla and chocolate, or cherries and strawberries. Not to be outdone by team Cherry with their cherry blossoms, team Strawberry sought to make their own, which would be softer, prettier and better in every way. Only their magic caused the strawberries to blossom too much to the point of developing sentience, giving rise to the ichigo dragons. Part of them saw this as a success, while others saw it as the opposite - a failure.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to sweeten up your day!

dragons.Name: Dapplethorn
dragons.Description: Much like their distant relatives, the dapplethorn dragons sport gorgeous large wings. These wings provide a wide variety of uses, from intraspecies socialization, to acting as camouflage while soaring the moonlit sky in their nocturnal adventures. A friendly and social bunch who will let you pet them, just be mindful not to poke yourself on their many spines.
dragons.Goal: So pretty it causes butterflies in other dragons' stomachs!

dragons.Name: Chikipea
dragons.Description: It is said that when spring makes its way to the Vale, the plants grow taller, their roots expand thicker, leaves get stronger and flowers bloom bigger. Chikipea dragons took this a bit too literally, for as they grow, they remain small and cuddly looking, but their rootlike tails and leafy crests will continue growing to make up for it. Despite all this wild growth, they haven't sprouted a pair of wings to fly with yet, but it seems nature finds a way regardless.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to kick up some wind!

dragons.Name: Somnig
dragons.Description: Kind and gentle dragons that are generally uninterested in the world around them and its events, somnigs probably slept through the Cataclysm. You see, they much prefer to spend their winters napping in cozy caves where no one will bother them.
