Waking up after having slept for so long must be a rough experience, or their biological clock is thrown off by the late arrival of Spring this year, as they all look somewhat groggy. But I guess we all would be if we spent the last few months snoozing it out.
dragons.Goal: This dragon loves to take naps!

dragons.Name: Bumi
dragons.Description: Knowing that Lumi has a small cute dragon to call her very own, a group of Wizards and Witches decided it would be a kind gesture to gift her sister a small dragon as well. The group led by the Wizard Shane and the Witch Lesley, two of the first to ever set foot in the Vale, joined all their collective magic to draw upon the little spring they had around them. And so, their magic coalesced into a cute and cheerful little dragon they named bumi, the perfect companion for Blumi.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to bring the spring!

dragons.Name: Crackle
dragons.Description: Hatching with these dragons is really a matter of perspective, for some they are already hatched and for others, they may never hatch at all. The shells of the crackle dragons grow in size with them and they don't seem to mind this when they are young. However, as they grow older, spending so much time shelled up in their own little prison has made some of them very grumpy, and others explosively grumpy. Wizards have tried helping them out of their predicament only to be scared away by muffled growls and hisses, besides, we can't fret over every egg.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is walking on eggshells.

dragons.Name: Solary
dragons.Description: With the combined efforts of all the Wizards and Witches, a manifestation of the sun itself was summoned to the Vale, helping bring forth the spring. Solary dragons cast light where it is darkest and warmth where it is coldest. These beings of light may not get along with the dark dragons too well, but even they know one cannot exist without the other.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is bringing the light!

dragons.Name: Cherrie
dragons.Description: In an attempt to strengthen the spirit of spring in the Vale, Blumi and the Wizards conjured everlasting cherry trees that are perpetually blossoming. Little did they know that this sign of renewal would draw the attention of a dragon rarely seen in the Vale. Cherrie dragons originate from the eastern Isles of Nipong and don't usually make their way here. They always perch on cherry trees and usually stick to them, with little reason to roam around and explore, making picnics under the trees an even sweeter experience.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is another win for team Cherry!

dragons.Name: Ignaqtus
dragons.Description: During Elemental Studies class, the Wizards wanted to demonstrate to the wizzlings how fire reacts to water and why they are considered to be opposites. As the streams of fire met the streams of water, instead of steam forming with explosive force, the elements kept building up. The water wasn't extinguishing the fire and the fire wasn't vaporizing the water. Suddenly a bright flash appeared with a loud boom, knocking the wizards back and shattering all the windows, vials and potions in the classroom. From the blinding light a majestic dragon appeared, a being of fire and water in perfect harmony, which they called ignaqtus. And they say you shouldn't cross the streams..
dragons.Goal: This dragon brings harmony to the elements.

dragons.Name: Invento
dragons.Description: Taking inspiration from his previous work with the davinese dragons, Tolzar began seeking others he could help with his ingenuity and craftsmanship. While aimlessly wandering about, he stopped to observe a pack of dragons playfully enjoying the shallow end of a local pond. He noticed they were unable to go any deeper, despite their best attempts, on account of their short and stubby legs. This looked like just the job for him! He quickly fashioned a pair of fins for them and before he knew it, the dragons were already splashing and diving in the deep.
dragons.Goal: This dragon brings the splash!

dragons.Name: Mushry
dragons.Description: Mushry dragons love to nap in caves for so long, that mold and all kinds of fungi grow on them. They don't seem to mind this, but Wizards will sometimes chase after them trying to get the rarest mushrooms for their potion brewing. Some mushrooms have strange side effects and can be dangerous, so all Wizards and Wizzlings are advised to avoid them, unless absolutely sure of their origin and effects.
dragons.Goal: There isn't mushroom for more.

dragons.Name: Jackpot
dragons.Description: The Vale is home to numerous dragons, and their numbers keep growing year after year, amassing a wonderful roster of dragons. This has not gone unnoticed by Tolzar, despite spending most of his time locked away on his own. Turns out he has been up to something all this time, patiently waiting to reveal a secret project once the time is right. Well, that time has finally arrived and he eagerly introduced to the Vale his latest creation, the jackpot dragon. It is meant to mark a milestone in the Vale's history as the 777th dragon, a being made of pure ingenuity, magic and luck.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is really lucky!

dragons.Name: Scribe
dragons.Description: With so much magical energy swirling around the school corridors, it was only a matter of time before something whacky and magical happened. And sure enough it did. So did the fumes from a bubbling cauldron turn into a spooky ghost to haunt the school? No. Did the books in the library start flying around on their own? Well kind of, but that was intentional. Did a student trip while carrying lots of magical scrolls, then his muttering of some forbidden spell in frustration brought the scrolls to life by accident? Actually, yes. The Wizards decided to call it a scribe dragon and were wondering if other types of paper could be animated as well. Luckily they had the foresight to know where this would go and scrapped the idea before it got out of hand.
dragons.Goal: This dragon always wins in rock, paper, scissors!

dragons.Name: Professo
dragons.Description: In Mrs. Murphy's School of Spellwork and Sorcery, even young dragons have a thing or two to learn, like not walking into an open flame or not to swim in the cauldrons. And who better to teach them than a fellow dragon, a professo dragon no less. What they lack in size, they make up for in wisdom, for their intelligence is as fierce as the roar of hyperions and their minds sharper than the claws of chomps.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to teach you!

dragons.Name: Construct
dragons.Description: Enchanting Studies can be pretty important and are vital for any self-respecting Wizard or Witch, be it for solving serious problems or general conveniences. It is where students learn how to make their broom capable of flight, or how to make a ferris wheel turn endlessly seemingly on its own. In a show of his prowess in this field, Wizard Bybon enchanted giant boulders to be seemingly light as a feather and bound them together, turning them into the construct dragon you see before you.
dragons.Goal: The weld tool is amazing.

dragons.Name: Margento
dragons.Description: When a dragon spends enough time in the School of Spellwork and Sorcery, they are bound to learn a few spells here and there. And the margento dragons deploy the magic they have learned in a variety of ways, from conjuring majestic wings to carry them high in the sky, to summoning roaring arcane images of themselves. A feat that even some of the most experienced Wizards and Witches are still incapable of.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has magic claws!

dragons.Name: Oasian
dragons.Description: When you are a quick flying dragon that can get to an oasis in minutes, life is easy. But when you aren't as quick and can't fly, it can be a bit tedious having to go every time you're thirsty. So why not just bring the oasis with you? Wizards believe the oasian dragons may have distant relatives in the Palagos Islands that are capable of the same trick.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will be here.. eventually!

dragons.Name: Nubis
dragons.Description: Thought to be the guardians of the Beacon of the Sun, these dragons themselves can become beacons of the Sun. Channeling power directly from it to warm those in need or to temporarily blind those who wish them harm. They walk tall with pride knowing their role in the Sandara deserts, but remain humble in the presence of others.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to bring the light!

dragons.Name: Alayzem
dragons.Description: Dragons buried under the ancient sands for centuries, if not millennia, have been reawakened by the activity and commotion above their sandy tombs. Wizards are curious to find out what these dragons looked like before the sand altered them, but they can only speculate. They are friendly dragons despite their appearance, just cover your eyes when the sand starts shifting.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has resurfaced!

dragons.Name: Saharus
dragons.Description: Saharus dragons possess full control over the sands from a very young age and can effortlessly swim through it, much like we would swim through water. As they bring the sands of the Sandara desert with them, it is best to wear protective goggles when interacting with these dragons. And it is important that they are enchanted ones, for normal goggles do nothing!
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to sandblast!

dragons.Name: Mantasu
dragons.Description: Thought to only exist in myths and legends, these dragons surprised the Valers with their appearance. The Wizard Veezir claims that they come from the farthest edges of the Easter Continents, a land of harsh terrain, terrible conditions and scorching heat. Despite their fierce appearance, they are very cuddly and playful. Just mind the tail.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to sharpen its tail!

dragons.Name: Tutan
dragons.Description: One of Veezir's favorite dragons, the tutans sensed the activity around the Beacon of the Sun and have made their way to the Vale from the dunes of Sandarra. There they make their lairs in pyramids to hide from the scorching heat, but here the sun is more forgiving and they are willing to withstand it, as long as they are near the Beacon. Whether they wish to bring it down, protect or rule over it is unclear, but they seem drawn to it like many others.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to rule!

dragons.Name: Efreet
dragons.Description: The Cave of Wanderers holds many treasures and curiosities, and with the djinni dragons no longer granting wishes, Ala Din continued his search. He was thrilled to find another pretty lamp and immediately shined it up, but this was not like the lamp he had previously seen. From inside appeared not a djinni, but an efreet dragon, a seemingly polar opposite. Before the traveler could even think of a wish, the two dragons stormed out of the cave the moment they saw one another. Disappointed he didn't get a wish, Ala Din returned to his search for treasure, wondering if the dragons he saw were bitter rivals or long lost friends happy to see each other again.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to be spicy!

dragons.Name: Aurum
dragons.Description: The Beacon of the Sun's will manifested in physical form, these dragons will do everything in their power to protect the Beacon, those who worship it, and those made shiny by its glory. They may be suspicious of the Tutan dragons, but they do their best to get along with everyone else, so that they may bear witness to the shininess.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to shine bright!

dragons.Name: Leonian
dragons.Description: Boldly leading the arrival of the remaining zodiacs, leonians lead the pack with contagious confidence and pride. They are friendly to their new friends from the Vale, but very few are deemed worthy to get close to marvel at them. An exposed belly may be a sign of trust, or a fierce trap waiting to be sprung.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here with pride!

dragons.Name: Scorpionian
dragons.Description: Being used to joyfully flying through the stars, the scorpio dragons ironically don't use their many legs to get around. Instead they zoom around carelessly floating in the sky, propelled by some mysterious force, or through sheer will alone. They may wildly swing their tails around in a display of power, but they mean no harm to anyone.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to surprise everyone!

dragons.Name: Capricornian
dragons.Description: Friendly dragons that came to the Vale determined to call it their new home, working hard to make it as comfy as possible. Wizards often can't tell taurian and capricornian dragons apart, for they both have horns and like to charge at others. Rule of thumb, if you see it swimming or flying, its capricornian.
dragons.Goal: This dragon loves capricorny jokes!!

dragons.Name: Sagittarian
dragons.Description: These dragons were eager to come to the Vale, finally getting back together with the other zodiacs. Cheerful and curious wanderers, flying around exploring every nook and cranny, seeking knowledge in any place they can find it. Some Valers believe the shooting stars we see at night are shot by distant sagittarian dragons.
dragons.Goal: This dragon always hits the mark!

dragons.Name: Virgonian
dragons.Description: Despite being from out of this world, from a place of nothing but emptiness as far as the eye can see, the virgonian dragons seem in tune with the beautiful nature surrounding them. Almost as if they are already familiar with it, as unlikely as that may be. They hesitantly took a risk coming here with their zodiac friends and it appears to have paid off, finding a new home with much to see, lots to learn and many friends to make.
dragons.Goal: This dragon brings grace to the Vale!

dragons.Name: Shadowflash
dragons.Description: With so many stars falling in the sky, the energies of the shadowy cosmos and the blazing trails mixed in a flashy implosion in the night sky. A beautiful display that gave birth to the shadowflash dragons. With this event taking place neither down in the Vale, nor up in space, Wizards argue whether or not these dragons are to be considered alien or local. The dragons don't really care either way, they're just happy to be here.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is dark, but flashy!

dragons.Name: Librian
dragons.Description: The most fair and just of the zodiacs, with an almost innate sense of morality. They can be sensitive and forgiving, but also cold and harsh. While exploring the Vale and meeting new dragons, the librians will judge others in their own mysterious way to determine who they will befriend or avoid.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will weigh your actions!

dragons.Name: Lambovian
dragons.Description: Dragons brimming with starlight and cosmic magic, lambovians offer a glimpse into what the endless space above us could hide. Shiny and beautiful, they quickly became one of Noel's favorites and he is eager to scour the skies for more like them. How he intends to call them over to the Vale is a different beast entirely.
dragons.Goal: This dragon brings the starshine!

dragons.Name: Nacre
dragons.Description: To celebrate the 12th anniversary of the Vale, the Wizards got together to look for the biggest pearl they could find. Going on expeditions down to the surface, looking in the deepest seas and oceans. Sifting through countless clams, Nogard happened upon a particularly sizable one, with a massive pearl hiding neatly inside. Just as he was about to leave with his prize, a nacre dragon rushed in to snatch it from his hands only to return the pearl gently back inside the clam. After giving it some thought, Nogard figured the only way to get the pearl would be to get the entire clam with it. And sure enough, the nacre dragon followed them all the way to the Vale, enjoying its new home and diligently protecting its pearl.
dragons.Goal: This dragon likes shiny objects!

dragons.Name: Magma
dragons.Description: Digging their way up from the depths below, these dragons pass through multiple layers of molten rock and mysterious green sludge. This cursed spa treatment seems to alter their appearance irreparably and we may never know what they looked like originally, but they are welcome to the Vale nonetheless.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is magmalicious!

dragons.Name: Eww
dragons.Description: One of Whitbee's experiments gone wrong. Or right, depending who you ask. These dragons were made by playing around with the sludge surrounding his castle and feel right at home there. They are friendly and curious, just don't leave your keys near them or you might have to get icky getting them back, hence the name.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is oozing with excitement!

dragons.Name: Shackle
dragons.Description: These fierce dragons are from an alternate dimension, brought here by Whitbee to try and save them from the unknown entities that locked them up in the first place. It is still unclear if they were simply being restrained, or if they were being studied by evil versions of the Vale's Wizards. Only time will tell if bringing them here was a mistake, a classic Whitbee move.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is unstoppable!

dragons.Name: Infinitum
dragons.Description: The Pyromancer Kornix sought to conjure an everburning flame, one that feeds off on its own energy to sustain itself. Going through mountains of old tomes and scrolls, he finally found an incantation that might just do the trick. With all the preparations made and reagents gathered, he began chanting the spell that would summon this eternal flame. In a sudden flash, the book itself took off the pedestal, floating mid-air, its pages turning rapidly and bursts of fire shooting from between with intense heat and ferocity. But the pages would not burn, instead they started flying off, as if an invisible hand had ripped them out one by one. Before his very eyes, in a blinding whirlwind of runes, pages and flame, the infinitum dragon took shape. Freed from its prison, it was now free to roam the Vale, burning endlessly and effortlessly.
dragons.Goal: Things are heating up in here!

dragons.Name: Greymatter
dragons.Description: Curiosity got the better of these dragons when they stumbled upon Whitbee's lab. Copious amounts of colorful potions, weird mixtures and glowing candy corn everywhere, like walking into a fully stocked candy store. What they ate and how much of it is a mystery to the Wizards and they cannot reproduce the effects, but it appears to have given the dragons massive brains. They will now probably be smart enough to watch the theatrical play "Trick and Mort", a tale about Mort Encha and her trick dragon.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to bring the smarts!

dragons.Name: Machina
dragons.Description: Tolzar was working on one of his kooky ideas again, this time to bring one of his machines to life. He put his ingenious mind to work, poured countless hours into it, but no matter what he did and how hard he tried, he couldn't make it work. His machines would get up and walk only to shut down seconds later, or roar once and give up. It wasn't until the last one ran to Whitbee's castle unsupervised and broke down just under his window. Inside was Whitbee dealing with his own experiments, throwing a bunch of potions out the window in frustration, landing exactly on the broken dragon. It seems that whatever was in that mixture was exactly what Tolzar needed all along to make his creation spring to life.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will show up at the best possible moment!

dragons.Name: Tickles
dragons.Description: Unfortunate enough to find themselves in the sewers under the shady castle, these dragons have sprouted all kinds of tentacles. Some for seeing, some for eating and other just for thinking. Upon closer inspection it seems that the growths on their backs control the dragon, and not the other way around. Whatever parasite was in those tunnels, it is best to stay as far away from it as possible.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is a jack of all trades!

dragons.Name: Fortified
dragons.Description: With the stone walls of the castle constantly in contact with the mysterious green sludge, and who knows what else Whitbee has thrown out there, it was only a matter of time before something happened. Luckily for him, instead of crumbling down and taking the whole castle with it, one of the walls surprisingly developed a consciousness. Overwhelmed by its surroundings, it rearranged its stones to match the two most prominent things it noticed, all the dragons and the huge castle.
dragons.Goal: This dragon brings heavy fortifications!

dragons.Name: Exterrean
dragons.Description: The hivemind commands all and all command the hivemind. These dragons are alien to the Vale and seem to communicate with each other telepathically, feeling each other's emotions and intentions. Trying to tap into their hivemind communication, one of the Wizards had a vision of several worlds ravaged by swarms of these dragons, falling one by one to their sheer numbers. They may act nice now, but who knows what will happen if the hivemind learns of the Vale.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will eat everything in its path!

dragons.Name: Pikeleaf
dragons.Description: Pikeleaf dragons enjoy basking in the sun for hours at a time, like all plants would. But being in the light without any shade makes them develop a resting frowny face. They may look angry, but do not let that mislead you, as they can be some of the nicest dragons around.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is enjoying the sun!

dragons.Name: Waterwalker
dragons.Description: The swamps of Catchafaya have lots of nasty insects roaming around, with the only place safe from them being underwater. It seems the waterwalker dragons have developed a way to hide from insects, and any other unwanted attention, by staying submerged under the water. Wizards believe they are so well adapted to that lifestyle, that the flowery crowns help them breathe and stay submerged longer.
dragons.Goal: This dragon can stay undetected!

dragons.Name: Liveloch
dragons.Description:
In the heart of a tranquil lake, liveloch dragons are awake,

A sentinel in liquid blue, ripples left in their wake,

Their scales shimmer in the sun, guardians, no mistake,

Mystical creatures, the depths, their home they make.
dragons.Goal: Plop! The dragon has risen!

dragons.Name: Pollenizer
dragons.Description: Pollenizer dragons with hearts full of purpose, a symbol of nature’s enduring beauty. Their delicate touch brought forth the most vibrant blooms and the sweetest fruits, weaving magic through the Vale’s numerous nooks and crannies. The pollenizers continue their tireless journey, painting the world with the brilliance of life and color.
dragons.Goal: This dragon brings a flowery scent to the Vale!

dragons.Name: Shaper
dragons.Description: In a cozy Frozen Highland village, shaper dragons emerge from the vast snow dunes to pay a visit to the folks. Their claws may be as sharp and cold as ice, but their hearts are filled with the warmth of a hundred hearths. Slashing at the ice they sculpt wonders, creating crystalline masterpieces. And the children gleefully watch as the shaper dragons turn whole ice blocks into a mist of fine snow within minutes.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is the master of ice sculpting!

dragons.Name: Icecarade
dragons.Description: The icecarade dragons rule over the frozen spans with elegance, sporting sharp but fabulous icicles. Valers admire and respect the dragon's beauty as it resembles winter itself in a way, beautiful, chilling and not to be underestimated. For the icy breath of winter may spread serenity and peace, turning towns into wintry havens of magic, or barren frozen wastes.
dragons.Goal: This dragon brings natural grace to the Vale!!

dragons.Name: Grandeur
dragons.Description: One summer day near a calm mountain lake, the Cryomancer Fries was teaching his students techniques used in conjuring the chill of winter and casting cold spells. Freezing just enough of the lake's water to walk on, while also doing his best to not disturb the local grandeur dragons. Everything was going swimmingly until a particularly clumsy pupil overcharged their spell, unleashing a frosty explosion of cold and ice, the size of which could have devastated a small town. Fries reacted quickly and protected the students, but the surrounding area and the dragons were forever altered. The lake's waters turning to solid ice and the grandeurs having their feathers and coats wintryfied.
dragons.Goal: This dragon comes to bring a little grace to the Vale!

dragons.Name: Toboggan
dragons.Description: The gingerbread dragon delighted in sliding on its sugary belly, transforming the snowy expanse into a sweet-scented ice rink. With each sugary swirl, toboggan dragons leave a delectable trail, inviting other dragons to join the festive glide.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is sliding right to your park!

dragons.Name: Snowdrop
dragons.Description: Amidst the Frozen Highlands, a snowdrop dragon unfurls its wings adorned with radiant bulbs that flicker like stars in the night. As the dragon soars through the starlit night, the enchanted bulbs cascade, transforming the realm into a winter wonderland aglow with festive cheer.
dragons.Goal: This dragon brings the light on its frozen wings!

dragons.Name: Cubicle
dragons.Description: In the heart of the winter celebration, these dragons find themselves trapped in an icy cocoon, a prank gift from the mischievous Wizard Osheya. A gift that some would call a curse, as the dragon's breath crystallizes into frosty prisons around them. This has not broken their spirits and they remain cheerful, sliding around the Vale leaving behind trails of fun and laughter. Theirs is an inspiring tale of unity and perseverance that brings warmth to all during the winter season.
dragons.Goal: The Vale needs more ice!

dragons.Name: Dancey
dragons.Description: А dragon trio emerged – three comically bad dancers. Undeterred by their clumsy moves, they spun through the snow-covered hills, spreading laughter and merriment. The trio twirled together, a whimsical dance of unity, creating a heartwarming spectacle under the snowy sky, where even the clumsiest steps became a cherished part of the holiday celebration.
dragons.Goal: This dragon needs some dance lessons!

dragons.Name: Snopaw
dragons.Description: While exploring the cold tundras, Wizard Atten Burrow stumbled upon these curious dragons, with some swimming about in the ice-cold waters while others would swipe snow at each other. A playful snowball for them, but an avalanche to your average Wizard. Either their hides are so thick that they don't freeze, or they just enjoy a bit of cold, as it doesn't seem to bother them either way.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will drag in snow on its paws!

dragons.Name: Floristry
dragons.Description: In Cadberry Meadows, the floristry dragons delight in gathering flowers and decorating themselves with colorful disguises and bouquets. Every day they parade through the meadows, spreading joy with their entraning flower fashion shows. These playful antics turned the once-ordinary glen into a haven of joy and happiness, teaching everyone that even the simplest of things can make life more magical.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will grow a garden for you!

dragons.Name: Spite
dragons.Description: Once upon a time, these dragons felt greatly upset seeing all around them with companions of their own, while they remained alone. Fueled and somehow empowered by their growing spite, the anguished cries they would let out were near palpable. The never ending spite and anger gradually transformed them into the fierce and unwelcoming dragons we see today. With help from the wizards, witches and other dragons, they are slowly discovering the joys of companionship once again!
dragons.Goal: This dragon will maliciously snatch every rose from your park.

dragons.Name: Fluffydoodle
dragons.Description: Fluffydoodle dragons often dream of the grandest most sugary flowers imaginable, how they flutter around them, gathering candy petals and marshmallow leaves. Then using these ingredients, transforming the flower into a marvelous masterpiece. And with all fluffydoodle dragons tuning into the same dream, that would be a sweet and sugary flower we can only imagine.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will sweeten your park with cotton candy showers.

dragons.Name: Helianthus
dragons.Description: Shy plant-like dragons with faces that remain unseen by the Valers, as they are only revealed to collect precious sunlight. By collecting it for themselves, they can remain in solitude longer, without having to come into the light of day. They have been seen tending to other plant life on cloudy days by emitting their collected sunlight on lesser flora, providing the sunlight they need to survive. We may not know if their faces are beautiful, but we know their hearts definitely are.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will be your beacon in the night.

dragons.Name: Lovey
dragons.Description:
In a world of magic, a dragon seeks its soulmate.
Longing for a friend, who seems to be late.
"Where is Dovey?" echoes through the night.
With whispers of hope, the future looks bright.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will guide each heart toward its destined soulmate.

dragons.Name: Loveydovey
dragons.Description:
The two inseparable dragons, reunited after a game of hide and seek.
The one got lost, worried and scared, things were looking bleak.
The other searched, combing over the forest, hope growing weak.
The two now back together, brought together by their love unique.
dragons.Goal: These dragons will spread love in your park forever.

dragons.Name: Rubrum
dragons.Description: Word of the upcoming Flower Festival had reached far away lands, lawns and gardens, catching the attention of the beautiful rubrums. Dragons native to the faraway east, like the Isle of Nipong. News of their arrival created a buzz of excitement in the Vale, as the local gardeners had only read about them in tomes and scrolls. With their extraordinary appearance, magnificent scales and petal-like collars, they quickly became among Gardenia's favorites.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will cheekily stick out its tongue, then run away.

dragons.Name: Blossom
dragons.Description: With so many dragons and wielders of magic gathered in one place, the energies around the Flower Festival gathered and took physical form. Colorful petals from all around flew out in unison, coming together in a whirlpool of wonder. The petals spinning and clashing slowly adhered to one another, forming what appeared to be a body with beautiful flowery scales. A new majestic blossom dragon was formed from the dance of these petals, a living bouquet.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will swirl all the petals in your park.

dragons.Name: Pangolian
dragons.Description: Originally trained by the Ranger-Wizard Smokee to keep vigil over the many forests of the Vale, these dragons keep a watchful eye for any dangers and fires in their green sanctuary. Why he would train a fire-breathing dragon to prevent forest fires is beyond our understanding, but all critters of the forest rest easy knowing they are under the dragons' protection. Despite their rugged exterior, they have a soft spot for everyone in the vale!
dragons.Goal: This dragon will teach you how to fight fire with fire!

dragons.Name: Chipichipi
dragons.Description: As generations passed, a tale of a dragon known for its love of cookies inspired a beloved tradition. It was said that leaving warm chocolate chip cookies on the table would lure the chipichipi dragons over. Those lucky enough to encounter them witness a true spectacle as the dragons would celebrate by juggling their delicious loot and would stash it for later in their pouches.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will leave a trail of crumbs to your park.

dragons.Name: Glider
dragons.Description: Lurking within the thick shadows of the trees' lush crowns, cuddly dragons with wings of blankets hoard all the nuts and berries for themselves. Swooping down from treetops and snatching what they can form unguarded picnic tables. Their behavior may seem selfish at first, but they share the hoards with their squirrelly brethren and other critters of the forest.
dragons.Goal: Beware, this dragon will plunder all the nuts and berries from your park.

dragons.Name: Mosser
dragons.Description: Embraced by tranquil slumber, these mossy dragons awoke from the undergrowth of the Vale. Having smelled the tasty goodies brought by picnic goers, they shook off the bark, flowers and squirrels from their backs and made their way over. These dragons sure love a good nap, but it seems they love a good snack more.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has slept for a long time in your park before meeting you!

dragons.Name: Melovine
dragons.Description: Amidst the sprawling treat farms, Valers often catch glimpses of the elusive melovine dragons, rummaging about in the fields. Under cover of night, the dragons would secretly visit the farms, carefully selecting the most plump, juicy, fragrant, mouth-watering pumpermelons to practice their mesmerizing tricks with. Farmers later find their pumpermelons scattered around in the morning, they remain mostly unharmed, so nobody really minds them.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will gather and protect the pupmpermelons in your park.

dragons.Name: Barkskin
dragons.Description: Brought to the Vale by the Wizzling prodigy Daniel, these dragons are an infinite source of sticks and branches to play-fight with. Be it with imaginary pirate-wizards with hidden treasure, huge evil dragons, or incomprehensible monstrosities from the rift. Barkskins spread enchantment wherever they tread, as with their every step, the grass grows taller. With every swipe of their tail, the flowers glow brighter. With every breath, they keep our memory evergreen.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will tend the grass around your park.

dragons.Name: Basket
dragons.Description: Nestled amidst the undulating hills and verdant forests, a colony of playful little dragons were dubbed "the basket dragons". Points to whoever already guessed why. This title stems from a habit hatchlings have to sneak into picnic baskets and gorge themselves on whatever bounty happens to be inside. With their bellies full, they would sometimes burst the baskets open and skedaddle dragging the basket's remains with them, often for life.
dragons.Goal: Check your baskets for any stowaways before packing up!

dragons.Name: Honeybrew
dragons.Description: Gather 'round, fellow wizards and witches! Hear the tidings of great import! The wizard Kai, with a keen eye and adventurous spirit, unearthed a treasure among the dragons. With their thick pelts and radiant hues, the honeybrew dragons possess a rare gift: a discerning palate matched only by their deep understanding of mead and honey. Let them be the ultimate judges!
dragons.Goal: This dragon will judge all the mead that you have in your park!

dragons.Name: Jester
dragons.Description: Jiggle, jiggle, jiggle! Amidst the waves of visitors flocking upon the medieval festivities, the Jester dragons command attention! Poised to fill the air with laughter through their performances, adorned with bells jingling joyfully and a mischievous ball trailing in their wake. Hold your drinks tight and brace your knees, for the jester dragons have descended upon the scene.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will provide the best fair performance in your park!

dragons.Name: Plate
dragons.Description: Deep within the Dramoria Mines, the famous wizard-smith Andre and his dragon companion shared an unbreakable bond. One day, the blacksmith noticed his friend admiring the suits of armor decorating the halls. Inspired by the dragon's ambition, Andre crafted a suit of plate armor fit for his scaly friend. With the armor forged and donned, the dragon transformed into a formidable guardian, proving that true strength lies not only in scales but also in the courage to pursue one's dreams. Soon, whispers of a brave dragon spread among wizards and witches, calling it plate dragon.
dragons.Goal: This dragon needs a frequent polish!

dragons.Name: Arcane
dragons.Description: Nestled in the veils of time, these dragons are renowned for their vast knowledge of the arcane. Their scales give off an almost magical shade of purple, glimmering softly in the moonlight. They are constantly on the lookout, inspecting visitors to find someone worthy among the crowd, someone deserving to wield the power of their knowledge. Perhaps one day they will find their perfect candidate.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will sprinkle the essence of magic into your park!

dragons.Name: Darkarm
dragons.Description: These dragons will instinctively guard any bridge they happen upon. Be it visitors, wizards or witches, none may pass through their cherished passage. Some valers choose to carefully sneak past the darkarms, others try to wrestle them, but for the dragons it is nothing but a flesh wound and they will be ready for the next encounter in no time. Then there are some valers that just can't be bothered and look for an alternative route.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will move for no wizard!

dragons.Name: Kingstone
dragons.Description: Kingstone dragons blend in with their rocky surroundings so well, that only experienced witches and wizards can spot them. Novices can spot them too, but only after accidentally waking the dragons by stepping on their tails. Presumably the swords on their backs are there to make them easier to see, but no one really knows who put them there. Valers only know that they are impossible to pull out and the dragons aren't too keen on letting strangers try, for they are not worthy.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will spread some stones in your park!

dragons.Name: Nimue
dragons.Description: An ancient legend passed down from one generation to another, speaks of mystical dragons that only reveal themselves to the worthy. Within the forgotten depths of a hidden lake, cloaked in shimmering scales and veils of silky foam, the nimue dragons protect many secrets. What lies beneath the water's surface still remains a mystery. Some say it's a sword, others claim it's a staff, while a few believe it's loyal keepers ready to safeguard their lakes from whatever dangers may come.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will call the lakes of your park its home

dragons.Name: Armor
dragons.Description: Through the halls and stairways of his tower, Nogard was carrying a tray of sparkling scrolls, glowing potions and curious reagents for research. On his way, his attention was drawn to a beautiful decorative piece, a set of dragon armor displayed as if worn by a dragon. With his attention elsewhere, he tripped, sending the contents of his tray flying and crashing into the set of armor. Annoyed, he stomped back down to get more and by the time he returned, the displayed set had begun walking around and acting like a real dragon. His favorite decoration might not be in his halls anymore, but it will be in the visitor's hearts!
dragons.Goal: This dragon became animated just to visit your park!

dragons.Name: Redfrill
dragons.Description: These dragons we originally brought to the Vale thanks to the witch-explorer Vam Pierce's quite impressive discovery, as they usually prefer the very depths of the Crimson Sea. Out of curiosity the redfrills followed her to the surface, where they have since decided to stay, captivated by the beauty of the vale and its clear skies. Beauty is in the eye of this beholder.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will give you an inkling.

dragons.Name: Shelly
dragons.Description: The valers enjoying the beach would wonder where all the shells are going, but the answer is the same as it ever was. The shelly dragons are using the giant clams and shells to decorate and form a sort of beautiful house around themselves, ready to go into the blue again. Letting the waves go by, with the water flowing underground, they often need new ones as the water is always dissolving, always removing their protective shells.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will steal all your shells.

dragons.Name: Kelpie
dragons.Description: Sticking to the Kelp Forests of the waters, kelpies rarely interact with outsiders, as they are very shy. These dragons hold on to stems and branches of algae with their tails to blend in and stay hidden. It also helps with not drifting away in their sleep, which is how most of them make their way to the Vale.
dragons.Goal: This dragon can be very kelpful.

dragons.Name: Quadruple Leap Year
dragons.Description: The fourth leap year in the Vale calls for a four headed dragon. And as we all know, four heads are better than one, better than two and even better than three. Perfect examples would be the beauty of the four seasons, the melody of quartets, the stability of four limbs (usually), the luck of four-leaf clovers, the four fundamental forces, and the four dragons of the apocalypse.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is leaping the shark!

dragons.Name: Sipho
dragons.Description: They may look like regular dragons to the visitors, but the aquamancers of the Vale found that siphos are actually colonies of different marine organisms, which bond and grow together. Likely due to their surroundings, their shape and behavior naturally mimics the appearance of cute dragons. They are cheerful, friendly and perfectly safe to pet and play with, unless you are a small fish that is.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has one huge, or many tiny secrets!

dragons.Name: Grin
dragons.Description: Deep within the darkness of the seabed, an old breed of dragons dwells for centuries. Known for their sharp grins illuminated by glowing bubbles that dangle ominously in front of them, these dragons provide a foreboding sight. Most sea creatures keep their distance, fearing the old stories that tell of these sea monsters' deadly hunts. But in truth, the grin dragons simply wish to meet someone new.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will shed omnious light upon the deep-sea life!

dragons.Name: Leviathan
dragons.Description: These dragons inhabit the deepest parts of the oceans shooting up from the abyss sinking unsuspecting ships passing above. Eventually Tolzar found that this behaviour was not fully intentional and the ships were just unlucky. The leviathans simply cannot control their buoyancy very well, and sometimes take up too much air at once, rocketing them up towards his sub. Nautical adventures in the zones they inhabit are a bit risky, but we promise you they mean you no harm!
dragons.Goal: This dragon is transparent like a ghost!

dragons.Name: Aquatech
dragons.Description: While exploring the depths with his trusty submarine, Tolzar noticed strange lights appearing in the darkness around him, flickering rapidly on and off. What he thought to be grin dragons luring him out, turned out to be the awakening of something long forgotten, As the lights grew bigger and brighter, they illuminated the area around him, revealing ancient guardians of the deep. Mysterious dragons, staying dormant to protect their creator's legacy. He could only catch a glimpse of the ancient sunken civilization before slowly being hoisted up to the surface by a mysterious aura around the sub. The aquatech dragons would not reveal their secrets so easily, but they would stay to enjoy some of ours.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will gravitate towards you!

dragons.Name: Ogre
dragons.Description: One day, Nogard was cleaning the basement when he discovered a hidden tunnel leading to a dungeon overgrown with moss and vines. Amidst the thick shadows, multiple pairs of eyes watched him intently. Realizing he was surrounded by a horde of hungry ogre dragons, he conjured a heap of treats to calm them down. Nogard tried leading them outside into the light, but many preferred to stay in their comfy dungeon. Seeing them out and about is a rare sight, thought to bring good luck!
dragons.Goal: This dragon may be in your basement!

dragons.Name: Moppey
dragons.Description:
In halls so grand and wide, the grumpy moppey dragons stride.

With tail in tow, they sweep and mop,
through endless rooms, they never stop.

Worn out brooms, but never slack,
they clean the floors and don't look back.

With every swipe slosh and sweep,
they labor on, while others sleep.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will clean your park!

dragons.Name: Hex
dragons.Description:
Exchange students come from afar, jungles, lush, and bizzare.

Scales of night, a dragon's charm, hexes swirl without alarm.

Wings of shadow, magic bright, mystic eyes that pierce the night.

Cursed flame, a fearsome sight, in the jungle, fear the bite!
dragons.Goal: This dragon brings jungle hexes!

dragons.Name: Treebark
dragons.Description: Towers and roofops make for a good roosting place apparently, or at least to the elusive treebark dragons. ''Scourge of the Chimmneys'', some would call them or that they enjoy the anti-tile lifestyle. Valers have been trying to get them down from rooftops for awhile now, and only recently did they actually succeed. The key was to build dummy houses and towers, with brand new roof tiles which the dragons wouldn't be able to resist. Valers do not mind their prescence, as long as they don't cause anymore leaky roofs amd broken chimmneys.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will roost on your rooftop!

dragons.Name: Feiya
dragons.Description: Known for their playful demeanor and endless pursuit of various games and pranks, the feiya dragons are among the most cheerful of all. They adore vanishing in plain sight with the help of their vibrant scales, blending seamlessly into habitats rich with colorful flora that mirrors their hues. Renowned for their boundless energy, feiya dragons are lively companions. So if you want one, be ready for long walks and endless adventures. Prepare comfy boots!
dragons.Goal: This dragon will spring fairy dust in your park.

dragons.Name: Quamera
dragons.Description: A fierce storm ravaged the Vale, chaos and destruction reigned supreme, until the quamera dragons came to intervene. Each head absorbing the violent energies of the strom cloud, letting out roars feral and loud. Not long after their arrival the dragons succeeded, the storm's onslaught had been impeded. With elemental powers the dragons were imbued, when the threat was subdued.
dragons.Goal: This dragon would make a very loud quartet.

dragons.Name: Nottub
dragons.Description: Playing with time magic is one of the most dangerous pursuits for the wielders of magic, human or dragon. Despite its complexity and risk, some still attempt to harness time itself. And intentionally or not, something did emerge from the nottub dragon's efforts. With the help of the Wizard Benjy, they managed to score an achievement in terms of time manipulation in their own unique way. Who said reversing time is not possible?
dragons.Goal: This dragon needs adult supervision!

dragons.Name: Doily
dragons.Description: For the celebration of the Vale's 13th anniversary, a great gathering of the elder wizards was organized. A group of dedicated and focused practitioners of magic, all united by one common goal: creating the ultimate doily. For some, there is nothing better to decorate your house with it. It looks pretty under any dessert and any cup of tea, even on their Home Optical Oracles. As the weaving of magic and spools of lace went on, the wizards used up more magic than the incantation called for, and a most peculiar kind of doily came to be, a doily dragon.
dragons.Goal: This dragon can make anything look pretty!

dragons.Name: Spelldome
dragons.Description: Some dragons have a deeper connection to the magic weave than others, like spelldome dragons who excel in creating protective barriers. This makes them highly sought after as assistants in the studies of magic. For you see, these anti-magical properties are perfect in training wizzlings, like a water bucket near a fire pit. Either despite, or because of their close connection to the magic weave, these drgons are not particular fans of magic itself, but a treat is a treat.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will protect you from magic!

dragons.Name: Alchemy
dragons.Description:
Alchemy Dragon Potion Guide by Solus and Lunara:
Reagents:
* Dragon's Breath Essence - For unparalleled magical potency and dragon core.
* Moonstone Shards - To imbue the potion with lunar wisdom.
* Unicorn Horn Dust - For purity and precision in alchemical reactions.
* Wyrm Scale Powder - To enhance the potion's resilience and strength.
* Elder Tree Sap - To stabilize and amplify the potion's effects.

Note: Don't forget the fire and the cauldron, and definitely don't knock all potions and ingredients of the table!
dragons.Goal: This dragon will brew the strongest concoctions in your park!

dragons.Name: Polarus
dragons.Description: The polarus dragon was created completely by accident in alchemy class. A young wizard was melting and shaping some metals for a habitat, when it suddenly started getting stirred rapidly and violently inside the crucible. To stop it from spilling over he quickly cooled it down with cold magic, but the magnetic dragon that had passed by already had its effect on it. And so, a new dragon came into existence. We need to find a way to lessen the dragon's powerful effect even more!
dragons.Goal: How does this dragon work?

dragons.Name: Jiaolong
dragons.Description: As suddenly as lightning strikes, these dragons descended from cloudy skies of the Far East, to join their fellow dragons in the Vale! Their arrival was foretold in ancient murals and myths, but no one could have predicted they would sleep in for their own prophetic arrival. Accustomed to the soft, fluffy clouds above, they bring a few with them, to feel cozy and remind them of home.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will rain thunder on your park!

dragons.Name: Dragpir
dragons.Description: Hiding on top of the highest trees deep within the misty forests, the dragpir dragons have long eluded the gaze of wizards and witches. Cloaked in feathers and fur that blend seamlessly with the night, they silently hunted for jewellery and magical items. The only clue to their approach was the loud screech they emitted as they began their descent
dragons.Goal: This dragon will screech in your park at night!

dragons.Name: Spooker
dragons.Description: To give his beloved cat a good scare, Whitbee decided to place a special order. ''A box of tricks to spook her'', he wrote in his orders. Somwhere along the way his mesage got lost in an unwitting game of crystal ball. On the day of delivery, six big boxes arrived and a group of spooker dragons burst from them, giving Whitbee the scare instead. This might not have been what he ordered, but he welcomed them nonetheless! The first dragon in the Vale to make its way here via mail!
dragons.Goal: This dragon will scare-jump you!

dragons.Name: Awoo
dragons.Description:
Through the woods it stalked alone,
Roaming lands but not its own.
When the full moon lit the sky,
Piercing the night with its lonely cry.
A family's love brought it peace,
From its wild ways, it found release.
Now it watches, brave and strong,
Where it once did not belong.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will alarm you when there's a full moon!

dragons.Name: Drack-o-Lantern
dragons.Description: Every year the Hatless Wizard patrols above the Vale, looking for pumpkins to swoop down and steal. No one knows what evil rituals take place in his lair, but whenever he returns, the same pumpkins come raining down from above! Twisted and corrupted, they turn into grotesque dragons as they crash into the patches they come from. "I have come once again, time to hide and cower! My dragons you cannot restrain, for unstoppable is my power!", he yells at the top of his lungs! Little does he know, all it takes is one calming spell to turn these monsters into friendly drack-o-lanterns!
dragons.Goal: This dragon will haunt all the pumpkins in your park!

dragons.Name: Candycorn
dragons.Description: During the spooky season, Whitbee places cauldrons around filled to the brim with candy corn and other sweets. Trick-or-treaters often help themselves to a handful from the top and move on, but for some this is not enough. The wizzlings delved too greedily and too deep, they awoke in the sweetness of the cauldron, sugary flame.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will fill your cauldron with candy corn!

dragons.Name: Yaga
dragons.Description: An ancient legend speaks of a trail of treats winding deep into the misty swamp, where the yaga-dragons dwell. Many curious valers have followed the path, lured by its promise, only to disappear without a trace. What truly happens within the dark heart of the swamp remains a mystery. But the question lingers... Do you dare follow the trail of treats?
dragons.Goal: This dragon will not stop cackling in your park!

dragons.Name: Bruntal
dragons.Description: Far away in the Hatless Wizard's lair, magical experiments take place that even the wisest in the Vale do not know the nature of. Spells and rituals so loud and smelly reagents so obnoxious, that even his pet dragons couldn't stand them anymore. Escaping from his lair and moving to the Vale, these dragons now have a new, calmer place to call home!
dragons.Goal: This dragon will protect your park from evil wizards!

dragons.Name: Dracomancy 1
dragons.Description: The floating skull of a dragon, filled with rage and violent thoughts. An ancient evil long buried in the hopes of stopping its return.
dragons.Goal: This dragon's return was inevitable!

dragons.Name: Dracomancy 2
dragons.Description: As more pieces are uncovered, something twisted and unnatural is starting to take shape yet again. The air around is hard to breathe, waters below are tainted, and flowers wither in its presence. Dig deeper to aid in its return, it is too late to turn back now.
dragons.Goal: N/A

dragons.Name: Dracomancy 3
dragons.Description: Valers recoil at the sight of this monstrosity, the hairs on their necks stand up whenever this unspeakable horror is near. The ritual is almost complete, uncanny how the knowledge of its steps seem to come.. naturally to you.
dragons.Goal: N/A

dragons.Name: Dracomancy 4
dragons.Description: Freed from its earthly prison, the ancient evil arises and brings despair and decay wherever it goes. Your role in this is unquestionable, but the memory of it and steps you took to summon this abomination are gone. Wizards who have the strength and will to help do their best to contain this evil. Whitbee is particularly intrigued, as he recognizes the danger posed by this... dracomancy dragon!
dragons.Goal: This dragon's return was inevitable!

dragons.Name: Gingerbread
dragons.Description: Once upon a time, there was a wizard-baker who was rumored to have started the tradition of creating gingerbread houses. Valers would wonder where the idea came from, until one day a curious traveller happened upon the inspiration that started it all. A group of jolly gingerbread dragons, dancing and playing in the cold. They tumbled through the snow , like sweets in powdered sugar, bouncing and sparkling as they rolled, their candy-coated frames bringing joy to all.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has pretty sweet foundations!

dragons.Name: Eaves
dragons.Description:
A quote from a Dragonvale wizzling's tale:

Did you hear that, child? The soft thumping on the roof? Yes? Be not afraid. It's not a monster lurking in the chimney or a krampus dragon lurking around. We have a little guardian - a small dragon with a fluffy tail that sweeps the roof and clears the chimney, keeping everything nice and clean. They're our quiet protector, making sure we stay safe and cozy through even the coldest of nights.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will really... soot you!

dragons.Name: Tectonic
dragons.Description: Seismancers of the Vale tell us that the plates of the world sometims shift, revealing new curiosities in their wake. During one such shift, Lumi found herself near the epicentre of a great tremor. As the shaking subsided, she cautiously approached the chasm that had formed in the ground. To her astonishment, a dragon emerged from the depths, breaking free from the ground itself. As sleepy as anyone would be from an eternity of slumber, the dragon was just as confused to see her, as she was to see it.
dragons.Goal: This dragon's camouflage is of a wizardry level!

dragons.Name: Lavaloch
dragons.Description:
In the heart of a fiery lake, these dragons bake,

An ember in liquid fire, they will never tire,

Heat so strong, but they mean you no wrong,

They would light up the sky, if only they could fly!
dragons.Goal: This dragon will incinerate your park!

dragons.Name: Iceclaw
dragons.Description: While exploring the Frozen Highlands of the North, these dragons unwittingly ended up in a fierce, unrelenting snowstorm. Stranded and freezing for days, frostbite began to slowly set in. Their bodies may have been broken, but their spirtis were not! The frost can bite, but so can they! Summoning magic from  deep within, they used the cold around them to mend instead of hurt, and so, the iceclaw dragons made their triumphant escape!
dragons.Goal: This dragon punches harder than icebergs!

dragons.Name: Flamegobbler
dragons.Description: Flamegobbler dragons are heat-loving, spice-craving, flame-taming marvels. Unlike other dragons, they evolved to gobble fire and lava, transforming it into a harmless ash in their belly. Praised for preventing environmental devastation, these dragons are invaluable in containing wildfires - or simply sharing a bowl of the spiciest food. Not only they can prevent forest fires!
dragons.Goal: This dragon can gulp down the fire in your park.

dragons.Name: Pyros & Glacius
dragons.Description: Some dragon breeds mix about as well as water and oil, or in this case: ice and fire. Compelled to compete and outdo one another, pyros and glacius dragons exemplify this from the moment they hatch. Locked in an endless dance of one-upmanship, we can't help but wonder if are they truly distinct breeds, or two sides of the same coin? Such is the enigmatic nature of friendship and rivalry.
dragons.Goal: These dragons are endlessly driven to outshine the other.

dragons.Name: Aquadruple Leap Year
dragons.Description: The fourth leap year in the Vale called for a four headed dragon. And the rule of four follows the alchemical elements as well: fire, earth, air, and water working and weaving in harmony. However, with the eruption of Mount Valsuivius, the fire element gained too much power and threatened the balance. Its polar opposite element of water answered the call to bring back harmony, empowering these dragons to fight back!
dragons.Goal: This dragon is water incarnate!

dragons.Name: Earthcore
dragons.Description: With the eruption of Mount Valesuvius, the earth below was shaken to its very core, awakening primordial powers unseen before in the Vale. Visitors initially reported monstrous and terrifying creatures emerging from cracks in the ground, wreaking havoc in their wake. It soon became clear they were a new breed of dragons - ones born from the earth's core itself.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is piping hot but only in its core.

dragons.Name: Volcano
dragons.Description: Using some tech from Tolzar, Pyromancer Crackle wanted to find the hottest spot on Mount Valesuvius after its eruption, to study and harness its energies. Closing in on the hotspot, he was surprised to find a living dragon playing in the lava. The little fellow immediately dashed towards Crackle like a true blaze runner, but it was too cold outside the lava pools so it quickly ran back in. The Pyromancer quickly came up with a solution: conjure a mini pool for the dragon to stay warm in, mimicking the volcanic activity it needs!
dragons.Goal: This dragon has a seismic sense of humor.

dragons.Name: Lilypond
dragons.Description: In a lot of villages, Valers would often visit lakes and ponds on Valentine's Day. Legend says heart-shaped lily pads would magically appear that were able to fulfill wishes. One day, a little girl made her big wish by one of these pads: to have a friend help prepare a surprise for her parents' anniversary. But to her own surprise, upon hearing the wish, the pond of lilies itself rose up to her aid!
dragons.Goal: This dragon will take care of all the lakes in your park.

dragons.Name: Hasu
dragons.Description: Even the mightiest, fiercest and most powerful of dragons need some time to relax and unwind. And among them, there's a special dragon known for its unique way of relaxing, something the Valers have named "dragoga". This practice has been adopted by many observers, lots of whom believe that it significantly improves mood and recovery. Many claim that the "hasu pose" is the most relaxing of all, especially at the beach.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will bring a relaxing atmosphere around you!

dragons.Name: Smoothie
dragons.Description:
Much like the chomps, these dragons evolved and specialized in their favorite activity: making smoothies! And following Kaleni around, they learned a thing or two, like his recipe for the Best DragonVale Smoothie:

• 14 Ounces of Coconut Milk (1 1/2 cups)
• 1/2 Dragon Fruit
• 2 Cups Nubbleberry juice
• 1/2 Pumpermelon
• 2 Tablespoons of Honey
• 1/2 Teaspoon Pure Magic Extract

Note: Don't forget to serve cold with ice!
dragons.Goal: This dragon will show you the best smoothies ever!

dragons.Name: Maracas
dragons.Description: While strolling along the beach, visitors might hear a rhythmic sound, like seeds rattling in a hollow shell. The curious who dare follow the enchanting melody often discover hidden gatherings of maracas dragons. Nestled in lush foilage, these lovely dragons create an unforgettable tune, turning even the stiffest of dancers into masters.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will bring an exotic rattle to your park!

dragons.Name: Waapawaapa
dragons.Description: Kojntas was thrilled to find his beloved canna dragons had a convergent evolution buddy, their distant relative the waapawaapas. The first of many discoveries to come, was that despite being more suited to tropical conditions, these dragons behave in much the same way. Even down to their stick-losing habits.
dragons.Goal: This dragon's love is like a ship on the ocean!

dragons.Name: Shy
dragons.Description: In his initial studies of these dragons, Wizard Reed Aktid classified them as Dragon-960 in project "Study, Catalogue, Pet", but they later became known as just shy. Their shyness is so intense, he found them challenging to study and catalogue, as the dragons seemed to sense whenever they were being watched or even talked about. Upon sensing this, they would go feral and immediately move aside a bit while making sure not to inconvenience anyone in their path. Petting is allowed, as long as you don't make a big deal out of it.
dragons.Goal: This dragon doesn't mean to be a nuisance!

dragons.Name: Hollow
dragons.Description: Before teleporting away after a date, tree-shaper Eepius left behind this normal, inconspicuous looking dragon as a lovely gift. Attached was a note with some instructions: "This dragon needs a loving home. If you hear it giggling - the dragon was probably clearing its nostrils. If you hear it snoring at night - you didn't. Please leave food every morning and look away, it is a shy eater. " So, not to be rude or anything, his date took the dragon and showed it around the Vale, getting it accustomed to its new home, with the other dragons.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will squeak and creak its way to your home!

dragons.Name: Koholahola
dragons.Description: These playful dragons love to splash around and spray any Valers that pass near their habitats. As playful as they may be, a pod of koholaholas sleeping in unison is an eerie sight, and unintentionally spook some visitors. Rumors say that they originate from the moon and were summoned here by the great wizard Wilzeek. Take that not with a pinch, but with an ocean's worth of salt.
dragons.Goal: This dragon has finally come to light!

dragons.Name: Flamindos
dragons.Description: In the same fashion they can lean one leg on the other and still stand, these dragons know they can always lean on each other in times of need. Even if said need is just 5 more minutes of sleep in the morning. Their bodies are built perfectly for hugs and embracing their fellow flamindos. Valers could learn a thing or two from these gentle and loving dragons.
dragons.Goal: These dragons will dance gracefully together!

dragons.Name: Caramelo
dragons.Description: Famous confectioner Ortreat was in his lab concocting his latest sweets and treats - caramel candy mixed with sparkles of candy magic. A recipe simple on paper, but very easy to mess up in practice. And mess up he did, but not resulting in chocolate exploding all over the lab, or being encased in a candy bubble. He got off easy this time with just a very sticky beard, when the caramelo dragon burst out of the heated vial.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will stick to everything!

dragons.Name: Sourtail
dragons.Description: Native to the mysterious Candy Land, these dragons were drawn to the Vale by its pleasant scenery and treat variety. Apart from their name, there is nothing sour about these dragons, as they are some of the sweetest ones out there. They love chasing after each other's tails around and playing with Wizards and Wizzlings alike.
dragons.Goal: This dragon can be sweet and sour.

dragons.Name: Swirly
dragons.Description: Candy Land is home to many dragons, some sweet as candy, some small as a bonbon, some cute as a gumdrop. And some are all of the above, like the sweet, small and cute swirly dragons. Moving to the Vale has its benefits, like near infinite food, friends and pets, although it has its minor downsides too, like often being chased around by Wizzlings who mistake them for giant lollipops.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will make your head swirl!

dragons.Name: Jiggly
dragons.Description: Sugar, sweetness, and a delicious treat... These were the perfect ingredients chosen to create the perfect little dragon. But in a twist of fate, Ortreat accidentally added one more unexpected ingredient: Strawberry Jello. And so, the jiggly dragons were born! With their gooey, wobbly powers, they became a fusion of berry, jello, and irresistable tastiness.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will make you jelly!

dragons.Name: Legit
dragons.Description: These normal dragons appeared in the Vale seemingly out of nowhere, but if the Wizards can interact and even talk to them safely, they must be one of the friendly types. Due to their many legs and wings that are purely for display rituals, the dragons were called legit, because they leg it everywhere. And if you drop a coin near them, specialized hidden limbs for grabbing reach out and take them, hoarding the gold and shiny, as normal dragons do.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will raise no suspicion!

dragons.Name: Cupcake
dragons.Description: Ortreat's apprentice confectioner, the Witch Katelyn, was trying to make her favorite treats, cupcakes. But every attempt seemed to fail, some would burn, others would be too undercooked, some tasteless or even completely lacking in structure. She felt almost as if she was jinxed or something. Getting pretty tired of this, she spiced up the recipe with arcane magic, but that didn't work out either, or at least not in the way she hoped. Instead of her favorite sweet cupcakes, out the oven came an equally sweet dragon, her new favorite.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is so sweet, like a cupcake!

dragons.Name: Bakey
dragons.Description: The renowned baker Ro Pansino was shocked to find a dragon in Candy Land also making its own candy, so she had it studied over the next few days. She was even more shocked to learn that it too would get annoyed when forgetting to add that crucial ingredient, just like any true Valer. Or would preheat the hearth too late. Or get distracted and forget when exactly they put the tray in there. Lots of forgetting all around, but you can't be mad at them when they are this cute.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will bake you the best treats!

dragons.Name: Mimicake
dragons.Description: Ro's famous Dragon Fruit Cake is a fan favorite among Valers, wizards, witches and dragons, for some especially. Like our little mimicake dragons. Valers aren't sure if the cake's design was inspired by them, or if the dragons' appearance changed over time from consuming so many cakes. Ro is always happy to bake more for her number one fans!
dragons.Goal: This dragon will devour all your cakes!

dragons.Name: Fragolita
dragons.Description: With so many dragons coming from Candy Land, Ro and Ortreat wanted to lure out the ultimate sweet dragon, to impress the denizens of the Vale. Ortreat used the ingredients that created the jiggly dragons, while Ro stabilized the mixture with her secret ingredients. The smell was so irresistible and mouthwatering, they had to stop dragons from jumping into the tasty mixture, even some Valers too. Later that day, they saw a bunch of the mixture suspended above them, as if a crafty wizard was floating it away to eat by himself. Little did they know, it was an actual fragolita dragon, having made its way here as soon as the aroma had reached its den.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is the sweetest of them all!

dragons.Name: Novem
dragons.Description: When the wizard Kael tried to summon Hyperion, the energies from the portal sent out shockwaves through the otherworld. Upon sensing this bridge between our worlds, the novem dragons rushed through in the nick of time. A world in constant turmoil, violent magical storms, jagged rocks and lakes of toxic gasses breeds dragons that are built to survive it, so they should have no trouble here. But have they arrived to terraform our world to resemble theirs, or to get away from it all in the comfort of the Vale?
dragons.Goal: This dragon will bring darkness!

dragons.Name: Dousa
dragons.Description: Like a princess of the ocean, these dragons ferry themselves with grandeur and magnificence. But even they can get a bit shy sometimes, as they have been seen hiding from sight in their gorgeous manes. As spotted by the wizards who found them, Earny and Burny, some dousas even swim into swarms of actual jellyfish, to hide in plain sight.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is pretty, but still packs a sting!

dragons.Name: Redbelly
dragons.Description: Another one of Vam Pierce's discoveries from the depths of the Crimson Sea, where bizzare dragons seem to be a regular occurrence. These dragons have shiny, bioluminescent scales covered in a jelly-like membrane, likely to help catch marine snow deep below. Be sure to wear gloves when petting
dragons.Goal: This dragon may be red, but it is not shy!

dragons.Name: Lucee
dragons.Description: Hiding within the dense kelp forests, lucees will even mimic the sunlight passing through the seed clusters in order to become near invisible! These dragons blend in so well that wizard-divers are often unsure if what they saw was actually there. They may find themselves in beautiful waters, and they may tell themselves "How did I get here? Where is that large dragon? This is not my beautiful diving suit! These are not my beautiful kelp seeds!"
dragons.Goal: These dragons have some bright ideas!

dragons.Name: Maelstrom
dragons.Description: Dragons in tune with the songs of the sea, always ready to answer its call for aid. Whether it be evil wizards dumping alchemical residue in the water, or angler dragons overfishing, the maelstrom will make quick work of them. In the water they may be a force to be reckoned with, but out in the open air they need every bit of help they can get, so they conjure up a whirling piece of home everywhere they go. For us that would be like a wizard conjuring up a dust storm under their feet whenever they go swimming
dragons.Goal: This dragon will whirl your pool.

dragons.Name: Blobert
dragons.Description: The deepest places hold all kinds of interesting creatures, all designed and adapted to withstand the crushing  pressure of these depths. Blobert dragons are an excellent example, as they are not too bothered by the pressure of all the ocean above them. They are so impressive, that the wizard Asch wanted to study them, to learn how to withstand Peer pressure, but he got talked out of it.
dragons.Goal: This dragon can withstand immense pressure!

dragons.Name: Bounty
dragons.Description: As relatives of the gold dragons, they sure do like their treasure, and they aren't going anywhere without it! Wizards have tried inspecting the chest multiple times, curious as to what can be so precious and captivating. But the dragons are fiercely protective and will chase away any who get close to what they own. Although, one could argue in reality it is the treasure that owns the dragon.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will protect your treasure!

dragons.Name: Aykula
dragons.Description: Terrors of the deep, known for sinking countless vessels, like many of Tolzar's prototypes for The Nautilus. While aykulas were engaging in their mindless and destructive fun, Tolzar was engaged in a mindful and constructive study to make The Nautilus impervious to their attacks. It is thanks to them that he perfected his design, as one after another the unmanned prototypes would sink to the bottom, assuming there was anything left to even reach the bottom.
dragons.Goal: This dragon plays with its food!

dragons.Name: Sea Angel
dragons.Description: Cute and curious dragons that are interested in studying the diving wizards just as much as they are in them. They will often flap their wings to get the attention of divers, leading them to shiny pearls, treasures or pockets of air. Similar to how one might lead a hatchling to a treat or to a chew toy. These sea angels grew so fond of their new wizard friends, that they followed them to the surface, where they discovered a whole plethora of new friends to make and curiosities to discover.
dragons.Goal: This dragon will be kind to all your visitors!

dragons.Name: Piggy Bank
dragons.Description: Saving up for the latest flying broom can be a challenge, even for the most frugal of wizzlings. So to speed things up, one of our clever little apprentices spent a wish to have their piggy bank be giant so they can fly. As we all know, one should be careful what they wish for, as instead of a giant piggy bank full of Dragon Cash which would let the wizzling fly, the piggy bank itself came to life and took off on its tiny wings.
dragons.Goal: This dragon is here to invest!
